items.title: La IndyCar vuelve a Europa tras 20 años de ausencia con una carrera en casa para Palou
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes.
items.body:
La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes.
La carrera supondrá el regreso a casa del español Alex Palou, cinco veces campeón de la IndyCar, que nació cerca de Barcelona.
La última vez que la IndyCar compitió en Europa fue en el circuito de Assen, en Países Bajos, en 2007. El campeonato no ha disputado ninguna carrera fuera de Norteamérica desde 2013, cuando se celebró una prueba en Brasil.
Palou, de 29 años, ha ganado los últimos cuatro títulos de IndyCar y también se alzó con la victoria en las 500 Millas de Indianápolis en 2025.
El Circuito de Cataluña acogió este año una prueba de Fórmula 1, pero desaparece del calendario en 2027 y se alternará con Bélgica hasta 2032.
"Llevamos años siendo testigos de su extraordinario talento (el de Palou) y sabemos que sus seguidores en España están deseando verle competir en directo", dijo Mark Miles, director general de Penske Entertainment Corp., propietaria de IndyCar.
"Es una oportunidad increíble, y para mí significa mucho poder correr en casa, en Barcelona; es difícil expresarlo con palabras. Sé que a los aficionados les va a encantar, y creo que vamos a ofrecer un gran espectáculo", dijo Palou.
La carrera de 2027 se celebrará del 16 al 18 de julio.

items.title: S&P/TSX composite down more than 150 points as oil tops US$100 per barrel
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s main stock index was down more than 150 points, despite strength in the energy sector as the price of oil rose to top US$100 per barrel.
items.body: TORONTO — Canada’s main stock index finished the week in negative territory as North American markets felt pressure from higher oil prices and concerns about the AI trade. “The main setbacks for the markets, TSX and North America in general, came really in two forms,” said Allan Small, senior investment adviser at iA Private Wealth.  “One is this idea of a technology pullback ... and this idea that perhaps companies are spending too much on AI and not getting the return on their investment for the capital that they are putting out, and that is a big fear.”  The S&P/TSX composite index was down 185.27 points at 35,788.18.     In New York, the Dow Jones industrial average was down 652.82 points at 52,215.16. The S&P 500 index was down 39.75 points at 7,623.68, while the Nasdaq composite was down 53.52 points at 25,955.34. Small said another risk facing the tech sector is that “AI can’t just go to the moon forever.” “At some point, memory chips, the production of them would have to slow because the market would have enough memory chips.” But falling AI stock prices could also mark a buying opportunity for some investors.  “There are a lot of names that are a lot cheaper than they were just a little while ago, although I will say that for tech, the highs were probably back at the beginning of the summer,” Small said.  He said the second major issue that markets grappled with this week was higher energy prices from the war in the Middle East and fears of potential escalation.  “We’re seeing oil prices move higher on this idea ... that after the U.S. midterms, the war could ramp up once again. We have not seen really any missiles flying for a while now, but President Trump made some comments recently which has led people to believe that there could be renewed hostilities in the Middle East,” he said.  The December crude oil contract was up US$3.80 at US$103.27 per barrel. Higher energy prices are also playing a crucial role in investor expectations that the Bank of Canada will hike its key lending rate next week. Financial market odds for a hike next Wednesday stood at nearly 78 per cent as of Friday afternoon, according to LSEG Data & Analytics.     “My view on that is I think it would be foolish for the Bank of Canada to hike interest rates. I think it would be foolish for the Bank of Canada to focus on inflation when we have an economy that is really not doing a heck of a lot,” Small said, adding that growth has been muted.  The U.S. Federal Reserve is also scheduled to make an interest rate announcement on Wednesday.  “The odds of a hike in the U.S. are down quite substantially ... so it doesn’t look like they’re going to go. The odds are now that if they move, they’ll move in December,” Small said.  The Canadian dollar traded for 71.46 cents US compared with 71.32 cents US on Thursday.   The December gold contract was down US$52.50 at US$4,007.90 an ounce. --- Daniel Johnson, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 23, 2026.

items.title: Colombiano Ecopetrol estima utilidad neta de 4 a 5 billones de pesos en el tercer trimestre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes.
items.body:
La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes.
En el segundo trimestre, Ecopetrol registró una ganancia neta de 6,06 billones de pesos (1.902 millones de dólares).
De acuerdo con la actualización operativa de la compañía publicada en su página de internet, los ingresos totales se habrían situado en un rango de 33 a 36 billones de pesos (10.361 a 11.302 millones de dólares) en el periodo de julio a septiembre.
Ecopetrol no suministró ninguna variación porcentual de las proyecciones.
Por su parte, la producción en el tercer trimestre habría alcanzado un rango de entre 740.000 y 750.000 barriles equivalentes de petróleo promedio día (bpd).
Las proyecciones de Ecopetrol supondrían un incremento en la producción frente a los 705.800 bpd del segundo trimestre de 2026.
Ecopetrol, controlada mayoritariamente por el Estado, es la empresa más grande de Colombia, produce la mayor parte del petróleo del país y posee las dos principales refinerías y gran parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos.
(1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos colombianos).

items.title: Chipmakers Post Longest Weekly Drop Since November
items.summary: A resurgence in oil prices dragged down stocks and bonds, stoking concerns about inflation just days ahead of the Federal Reserve decision on interest rates. Brent crude settled near $117 as a flare-up in Middle East violence threatened supplies. Most S&P 500 firms fell even as selling pressure on tech shares abated. A gauge of chipmakers edged up, but posted its longest weekly drop since November. The Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 1.2%. Treasuries relinquished a portion of the previous session’s rally. Co-Host of Odd Lots, Joe Weisenthal says it's important to the US Economy that tech companies fire on all cylinders. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Rusia dice que tres petroleros cargados con diésel se dirigen a Norteamérica
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tres petroleros que transportan diésel ruso se dirigen a Norteamérica, dijo el viernes el vice primer ministro ruso, Alexander Novak.
items.body:
Tres petroleros que transportan diésel ruso se dirigen a Norteamérica, dijo el viernes el vice primer ministro ruso, Alexander Novak.
Novak, en unas declaraciones recogidas por las agencias de noticias rusas, señaló que los cargamentos formaban parte de un acuerdo para abastecer a los mercados estadounidense y mundial.
"Los tres primeros buques cisterna ya se dirigen hacia la costa oriental del océano Atlántico, con un importante apoyo del RDIF (Fondo Ruso de Inversión Directa)", dijo Novak.
Novak señaló que las empresas rusas podrían suministrar 500.000 toneladas métricas en octubre.
En virtud de un acuerdo anunciado este mes por el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, Rusia accedió a suministrar diésel a los mercados globales, en un esfuerzo por reducir los precios del combustible. El Gobierno de Trump suspendió temporalmente las sanciones estadounidenses sobre el combustible ruso, que tenían por objeto privar a Moscú de ingresos para su guerra contra Ucrania.
El acuerdo anunciado por Trump contemplaba 300.000 toneladas métricas en octubre y más posteriormente.
Una noticia exclusiva de Reuters publicada el viernes, que citaba datos de seguimiento de buques, indicaba que el primer cargamento de diésel ruso se encontraba a bordo de un petrolero con destino a Nueva York.

[フロリダ州フォートマイヤーズ ２３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、フロリダ州の集会で、イランへの対応を終えた後にキューバ問題に対処し、合意をまとめるためルビオ国務長官を派遣すると述べた。

トランプ氏は９月、米国とキューバは合意に達するとの見通しを示し、軍事行動は必要ないと考えていると述べていた。

米国が実施した石油封鎖は、キューバに深刻な打撃を与えている。同国は燃料不足や停電に直面しており、インフラの機能不全が状況を悪化させている。

米国は６０年以上にわたってキューバへの禁輸措置を維持している。

items.title: Swiss drug developer Windward Bio files for US IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings.
items.body:
Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings.
Biotech has been one of the more active sectors in this year's fall IPO market, even as rising bond yields and concerns around the AI trade weigh on broader risk appetite.
Here are more details:
Basel, Switzerland-based Windward Bio is developing long-lasting antibody treatments for asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and inflammatory skin conditions, with the aim of reducing how frequently patients need injections
WIN378, the company's lead drug candidate, is an antibody designed to block thymic stromal lymphopoietin, or TSLP, which is a protein that triggers several inflammatory pathways involved in asthma and other respiratory diseases
Novo Holdings and funds managed by Blue Owl Capital have pre-IPO stakes of 14.5% and 5.9%, respectively, in the company
Windward has secured up to $365 million from investors including OrbiMed, Novo Holdings, Omega Funds and Blue Owl Healthcare Opportunities
The company plans to list its shares on Nasdaq under the symbol "WWB". Jefferies, TD Cowen, Piper Sandler and UBS Investment Bank are the underwriters for the offering

items.title: Colombia's Ecopetrol sees Q3 profit drop to up to $1.57 billion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Colombian state-run energy company Ecopetrol estimated its third-quarter net profit at 4 trillion to 5 trillion pesos ($1.26 billion to $1.57 billion), the company said on Friday, a decline from the 6.06 trillion pesos ($1.90 billion) it posted in the second quarter.
items.body:
Colombian state-run energy company Ecopetrol (ECOPETROL.CN) estimated its third-quarter net profit at 4 trillion to 5 trillion pesos ($1.26 billion to $1.57 billion), the company said on Friday, a decline from the 6.06 trillion pesos ($1.90 billion) it posted in the second quarter.
Total revenue for July-September quarter was estimated at 33 trillion to 36 trillion pesos ($10.36 billion to $11.30 billion), Ecopetrol said.
Third-quarter production is estimated to have reached between 740,000 to 750,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day (bpd), an increase from the 705,800 bpd the company reported in the second quarter.
In September Ecopetrol [USN:L1N45G0ZI TEXT:"appointed businessman Joaquin Gutierrez"] as its chief executive, giving one of the country's most important corporate jobs to a close presidential ally with no known background in the energy sector.
Colombia's right-wing President Abelardo De La Espriella, who took office in August, has promised to strengthen Ecopetrol, boost reserves and secure domestic oil and gas supply, including through fracking.
Ecopetrol is majority state-controlled and Colombia's largest company, generating most of the South American country's oil production.
The company owns the two main refineries and most of the country's oil and product pipeline network.
($1 = 3.185,01 pesos)

items.title: Wall Street mostly loses ground under pressure from rising oil prices
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: NEW YORK — Stocks slipped on Wall Street Friday under increasing pressure from rising oil prices. The S&P 500 fell 0.4 per cent, adding to its decline from a day before. The index is on track for a ...
items.body: NEW YORK — Stocks on Wall Street closed broadly lower Friday as oil prices climbed to their highest level in more than four years, ratcheting up pressure on the market. The S&P 500 fell 0.5 per cent, adding to its decline from a day before. The index posted its second-straight weekly loss. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 1.2 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite slipped 0.2 per cent after giving up a modest gain. Rising oil prices weighed heavily on the market, where nearly three out of every four stocks within the benchmark S&P 500 index fell. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 3.1 per cent to settle at US$116.72. It has surged from less than US$97 at the start of October and is now at its highest level since June 2022. Several AI-related companies rallied, helping ease some of the impact from the broader market slide. Micron Technology rose 2.5 per cent, Intel gained 1.7 per cent, Microsoft added 0.7 per cent, and Advanced Micro Devices closed 1.7 per cent higher. The tech sector’s influence is also capable of quickly switching over to a heavy weight. Stocks that have benefited from the frenzy over AI have been swinging over rising worries about their path ahead. Investors are worried about whether their high prices are justified. Many of those companies have been borrowing to fund investments in AI technology and high interest rates are making those loans more expensive. “Investors appear increasingly focused on the economics of AI, particularly the substantial upfront costs required to build AI infrastructure and the uncertainty around the timing of returns on those investments,” said Angelo Kourkafas, senior global strategist at Edward Jones, in a research note. The latest round of corporate earnings are being closely watched to help get a better sense of whether those investments are paying off, or might pay off. Several influential AI-related companies report their latest financial results next week, including Google’s parent, Alphabet, along with Microsoft and Amazon. Industrial companies had some of the biggest losses. Caterpillar fell 2.4 per cent. American Express slumped 3.7 per cent, one of several financial stocks that lost ground, despite r eporting profits for its most recent quarter that beat analysts’ forecasts. The company did announce its first major job cuts in roughly a decade. JPMorgan Chase fell 1.5 per cent, Citigroup dropped 1.5 per cent and Capital One Financial slid 1 per cent. While higher oil prices weighed down much of the market, they helped boost energy companies. Chevron rose 2.9 per cent and ConocoPhillips gained 3.6 per cent. European markets closed mostly lower. France’s main index fell 0.4 per cent, though yields on French government bonds eased a bit. Treasury yields in the U.S. edged higher following sharp drops on Thursday. The yield on the 10-year Treasury edged up to 4.99 per cent from 4.96 per cent late Thursday. Yields have been rising globally, partly over worries about governments taking on too much debt. Inflation also remains a concern and is stubbornly well above 3 per cent in the U.S. That prompted the Federal Reserve to raise its benchmark interest rate at its last meeting in an effort to cool inflation. Wall Street expects the central bank to hold rates steady at its meeting next week, but is leaning heavily toward another rate hike in December. Wall Street will also get several big economic updates next week, including the Fed’s preferred measure of inflation. The personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, is expected to show that inflation rose at a 3.7 per cent rate in September, sharply above the Fed’s 2 per cent target. The U.S. war with Iran has severely cut the world’s oil supply, driving energy prices higher and fueling a sharp jump in the cost of everything from gasoline to food and clothes. All told, the S&P 500 fell 39.75 points to 7,623.68. The Dow dropped 652.82 points to 52,215.16, and the Nasdaq gave up 53.52 points to close at 25,955.34. --- Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga, The Associated Press

items.title: Costa Rica AG says new joint DEA ops will target politicians, businessmen
items.author: Alvaro Murillo
items.creator: Alvaro Murillo
items.summary: Costa Rica will deepen cooperation with the US Drug Enforcement Administration to target what the nation's newly re-elected attorney general calls "invisible drug traffickers," including business executives and politicians hiding alleged links to the drug trade behind respectable public profiles.
items.body:
Costa Rica will deepen cooperation with the US Drug Enforcement Administration to target what the nation's newly re-elected attorney general calls "invisible drug traffickers," including business executives and politicians hiding alleged links to the drug trade behind respectable public profiles.
Attorney General Carlo Diaz, who has repeatedly clashed with the government of President Laura Fernandez, was re-elected by the judiciary on Monday to another four-year term. In an interview with Reuters on Thursday, he said investigators would show no leniency if those implicated held senior positions.
"This second phase (of DEA cooperation) focuses on people we have termed 'invisible drug traffickers,'" Diaz said, after an initial phase of joint missions targeted members of criminal organizations.
"These are business people, sometimes professionals or politicians, who are successful or highly visible. But behind that facade lies a direct link with these kinds of activities."
Diaz also hailed Costa Rica's ability to extradite its own nationals to the US as a watershed in the fight against transnational crime, saying 6 people had been sent and another 25 extradition proceedings were underway.
The DEA's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Costa Rica's government has previously collaborated with the DEA to arrest dozens of [USN:L6N44A17E TEXT:"drug traffickers"], who Costa Rican authorities deem responsible for a surge in homicide rates over recent years in the long-peaceful Central American nation.
Officials have said the region serves as a key corridor shifting narcotics from South America to the US.
Fernandez, a conservative ally of President Donald Trump, has aligned Costa Rica closely with Washington on security, joining the US president’s [USN:L6N45E0S9 TEXT:"Shield of the Americas"] initiative against drug trafficking and organized crime.
POLITICAL DIVISIONS Diaz said DEA officials had directly expressed concern to him about political and institutional divisions in Costa Rica, which he said were hampering the fight against organized crime. He has repeatedly clashed with Fernandez and her predecessor Rodrigo Chaves, accusing the government of seeking to weaken the judiciary.
Despite backing deeper cooperation with the DEA, Diaz rejected Fernandez's suggestion last month that Costa Rica could benefit from [USN:S0N3ST094 TEXT:"US forces operating on its territory"].
"If we focus on providing the resources the security forces need, they could take control of the territory without needing to bring in armed forces from other countries," he said.
Fernandez’s government has built a 5,100-capacity prison modeled on El Salvador’s security crackdown, an approach Diaz has questioned amid his broader clashes with the government. He said the prison could ease overcrowding but would not itself curb organized crime, stressing that Costa Rica’s criminal landscape differs sharply from El Salvador’s.
The homicide rate in Costa Rica, long considered one of the region's safest countries, peaked at 17.2 per 100,000 people in 2023, or 906 killings.
"This is one of the most complex moments in our history," Diaz said. "(The DEA) is well aware of the situation."

items.title: USDA corrige dados de setembro do milho dos EUA devido a "erro de processamento"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) corrigiu os dados sobre o milho divulgados em setembro devido a um "erro de processamento" que afetou suas previsões de rendimento e produção nos EUA, informou a agência.
items.body:
O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) corrigiu os dados sobre o milho divulgados em setembro devido a um "erro de processamento" que afetou suas previsões de rendimento e produção nos EUA, informou a agência.
As previsões da safra de outubro foram revisadas, validadas e não sofreram alterações, informou o USDA em comunicado.
Em 9 de outubro, o USDA projetou, em um relatório mensal, que os agricultores dos EUA colherão mais bushels de milho do que o esperado anteriormente, surpreendendo os operadores do mercado, que esperavam uma queda na produção devido às condições climáticas desfavoráveis.
(Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

items.title: OPay aims to raise up to $366 million in US IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Digital payments company OPay said on Friday it was targeting a raise of as much as $366 million in its United States initial public offering.
items.body:
Digital payments company OPay said on Friday it was targeting a raise of as much as $366 million in its United States initial public offering.
The filing comes as high interest rates dampen investor appetite for new listings, prompting several companies to delay their IPO plans.
OPay is a digital financial platform offering payments, money transfer and merchant services, with operations in Indonesia, Egypt and Pakistan.
Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Standard Bank and CICC are among the underwriters for the offering.
OPay will list on the NYSE under the "OPAY" symbol.

items.title: Trump diz que EUA vão “cuidar de Cuba” depois de lidarem com Irã
items.author: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: O presidente Donald Trump afirmou nesta sexta-feira que os Estados Unidos cuidariam de Cuba depois de lidarem com o Irã e que enviariam o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo.
items.body:
O presidente Donald Trump afirmou nesta sexta-feira que os Estados Unidos cuidariam de Cuba depois de lidarem com o Irã e que enviariam o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo.
“Vamos cuidar de Cuba após o Irã... depois, vamos enviar Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo”, disse Trump em um comício na Flórida.
Trump previu no mês passado que os EUA e Cuba chegariam a um acordo e que não acreditava que uma ação militar fosse necessária.
O governo Trump já havia declarado anteriormente que seu objetivo é mudar o governo comunista de Cuba.
Um bloqueio petrolífero imposto pelos EUA no início deste ano colocou Cuba sob forte pressão, já que o país enfrenta escassez de combustível e apagões agravados pela infraestrutura precária.
Washington mantém um embargo contra Cuba há mais de 60 anos, e o governo Trump vem intensificando a pressão sobre Havana depois que as Forças Armadas dos EUA capturaram, em janeiro, o então presidente venezuelano, Nicolás Maduro.
O ministro das Relações Exteriores de Cuba afirmou na Assembleia Geral da ONU, no mês passado, que Cuba estaria sempre aberta ao diálogo com Washington.

items.title: La venta de acciones de IA sacude al crédito global y empuja a los inversores a refugios
items.author: Katherine Doherty, Finbarr Flynn, Dipika Lalwani
items.summary: Los diferenciales de los bonos corporativos globales subieron a su nivel más alto desde mayo de 2025, mientras los temores por el gasto en inteligencia artificial y las tensiones geopolíticas impulsar ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los indicadores de los mercados globales de bonos están dando sus mayores señales de aversión al riesgo en más de un año, mientras una venta masiva de acciones vinculadas a la inteligencia artificial y el aumento de las tensiones geopolíticas llevaron a los inversionistas a buscar activos de refugio. El viernes, los diferenciales de los bonos en dólares de empresas asiáticas con mejores calificaciones crediticias se ampliaron a sus niveles más altos desde julio del año pasado, en línea con el comportamiento general de los mercados de crédito. El movimiento refleja un aumento de las primas de rendimiento de los bonos corporativos a nivel mundial, que alcanzaron su mayor nivel desde mayo de 2025, hasta 129 puntos básicos, según un índice de Bloomberg. “El riesgo crediticio ahora marca el rumbo y Asia no puede escapar de la tormenta”, dijo Gary Ng, economista sénior de Natixis. “Existe una clara aversión al riesgo en Estados Unidos respecto de las inversiones relacionadas con la IA y otros factores globales que podrían mantener elevadas las tasas de interés”. Ver más: Jon Gray convierte la IA en la gran apuesta de Blackstone, con US$200.000 millones en centros de datos La creciente preocupación por el rápido ritmo del gasto en IA financiado con deuda está provocando turbulencias en los mercados ante el temor de que la tecnología no genere ganancias con suficiente rapidez. El fuerte desarme de las apuestas por la IA ha generado un debate entre algunos inversionistas destacados: Ken Griffin, de Citadel, advirtió sobre una “burbuja”, mientras que Jon Gray, presidente de Blackstone Inc. ( BX ), dijo que no hay motivos de preocupación porque la demanda es “casi parabólica”. El crédito asiático moderó parte de sus pérdidas el viernes por la tarde, con los diferenciales de los swaps de incumplimiento crediticio de la región ampliándose alrededor de 1 punto básico, frente a 2 puntos básicos previamente en la jornada, según operadores. Aun así, el aumento de la volatilidad llevó al Export-Import Bank of Korea a posponer una venta de bonos en yenes. Norbert Ling, jefe de gestión de carteras de renta fija para Asia-Pacífico de Invesco, dijo que mantiene una visión favorable sobre el crédito como clase de activo. “Los diferenciales más amplios están ofreciendo a los inversionistas una mayor compensación por asumir riesgo crediticio de alta calidad”, señaló. Ver más: Ya no es solo el petróleo o la Fed: la IA ahora mueve al dólar y los bonos En otras partes del mercado, los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos y los bonos japoneses, considerados activos más seguros, avanzaron. Los bonos del Tesoro registraron su mejor jornada en más de dos años, con ganancias generalizadas. “Veo esto como el comienzo de una reevaluación más sostenida del riesgo crediticio”, dijo Lakshmanan R, jefe de empresas de Asia del Sur y Sudeste Asiático en CreditSights, en Singapur. “Es la culminación de múltiples riesgos globales que están golpeando a los mercados uno tras otro”. En ese contexto, Lakshmanan dijo que favorece mayores asignaciones a efectivo e instrumentos del mercado monetario, así como deuda sénior de bancos y del sector financiero. Dentro del crédito, prefiere la deuda con grado de inversión frente a las apuestas de alto rendimiento. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Trump afirma que EEUU "se ocupará de Cuba" después de Irán
items.author: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos se ocuparía de Cuba una vez resuelto el asunto de Irán y que enviaría al secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, para cerrar el acuerdo.
items.body:
El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos se ocuparía de Cuba una vez resuelto el asunto de Irán y que enviaría al secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, para cerrar el acuerdo.
"Nos ocuparemos de Cuba a la vuelta de Irán... y luego enviaremos a Marco Rubio para que cierre el acuerdo", dijo Trump en un mitin celebrado en Florida.
Trump predijo el mes pasado que Estados Unidos y Cuba llegarían a un acuerdo y que no creía que fuese necesaria una acción militar.
La administración de Trump ha declarado anteriormente que su objetivo es cambiar el Gobierno comunista de Cuba.
El confinamiento petrolero impuesto por Estados Unidos a principios de este año ha sometido a Cuba a una grave crisis, ya que el país se enfrenta a la escasez de combustible y a cortes de electricidad, agravados por una infraestructura deficiente.
Washington lleva más de 60 años manteniendo un embargo contra Cuba y el Gobierno de Trump ha intensificado la presión sobre La Habana después de que, en enero, el ejército estadounidense capturara al entonces presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro en una incursión mortal.
El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Cuba dijo el mes pasado ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que Cuba siempre estaría abierta al diálogo con Washington.

items.title: Açúcar bruto registra primeira alta na bolsa ICE em 6 pregões com força do petróleo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram pela primeira vez em seis sessões, à medida que os preços do petróleo se recuperaram e as preocupações climáticas relacionadas ao El Niño persistiram, enquanto o café registrou queda.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram pela primeira vez em seis sessões, à medida que os preços do petróleo se recuperaram e as preocupações climáticas relacionadas ao El Niño persistiram, enquanto o café registrou queda.
AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou com alta de 0,11 centavo, ou 0,5%, a 20,24 centavos por libra-peso, após cair pela quinta sessão consecutiva na quinta-feira e fechar em queda de 1,6%. O mercado registrou perda de 3% na semana.
* Consumidores e operadores provavelmente entraram no mercado como compradores, vendo uma boa oportunidade após as recentes quedas, já que não faltam fatores de alta no mercado, disse o consultor Michael McDougall.
* Entre esses fatores estão o excesso de chuvas associadas ao El Niño no Brasil, principal produtor, e novos aumentos nos preços do petróleo , o que pode levar as usinas de cana a reduzir a produção de açúcar e intensificar a produção de etanol como combustível.
* Além disso, a Índia prorrogou o prazo para permitir a importação isenta de impostos de 1 milhão de toneladas métricas de açúcar bruto de 31 de outubro para 31 de dezembro, dando aos importadores mais tempo para trazer a commodity para o maior país consumidor de açúcar do mundo.
* Os preços do açúcar na Índia, que também é o segundo maior produtor mundial de açúcar, estão disparando, já que o país enfrenta chuvas de monção abaixo do normal devido ao fenômeno climático El Niño.
* O açúcar branco subiu 0,2%, para US$534,80 por tonelada métrica, embora tenha registrado uma perda semanal de 3,6%.
CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 5 centavos, ou 1,6%, a US$3,0745 por libra-peso, após ter atingido na quarta-feira uma máxima de seis semanas de US$3,1820. Ele registrou alta de 0,6% na semana.
* O café está sendo impulsionado por estoques da bolsa extremamente baixos e por um real forte , o que desestimula os exportadores do Brasil, principal produtor, a vender café cotado em dólares, uma vez que isso reduz os retornos em moeda local.
* Os estoques de arábica na ICE caíram novamente na sexta-feira para 227.978 sacas, perto do nível mais baixo em 27 anos.
* Os operadores estão acompanhando a eleição presidencial deste domingo no Brasil, que poderia consolidar novos ganhos para o real caso o candidato da oposição, Flávio Bolsonaro, vença, conforme indicam as pesquisas.
* O preço do café robusta caiu 1,8%, para US$3.242 a tonelada. O mercado de robusta registrou queda de 5% na semana.
CACAU * O cacau de Londres fechou com alta de 15 libras, ou 0,3%, a 4.311 libras por tonelada, após ter fechado com queda de 3,9% na quinta-feira.
* O cacau de Nova York ficou praticamente inalterado, a US$5.592 por tonelada.
* Ambos os mercados registraram uma queda semanal de 1%.
(Reportagem de May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

items.title: 米国株式市場＝主要3指数軒並み下落、ハイテク株は持ち直し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lewis Krauskopf　Tharuniyaa Lakshmi　Ragini Mathur

[２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lewis Krauskopf　Tharuniyaa Lakshmi　Ragini Mathur

[２３日 ロイター] - 米国株式市場は主要株価３指数が軒並み下落して取引を終えた。一方、ハイテク株は持ち直し、市場をけん引してきた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄にとって波乱の１週間を締めくくった。市場の関心は、来週予定される企業決算や連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）に移っている。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は小幅な下げにとどまった。前日は、巨額のＡＩ投資を支える資金調達コストへの懸念が強まり、１日として６月以来の大幅下落となっていた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の大半のセクターが軟調で、一般消費財や金融はいずれも１％を大きく超える下げとなった。一方、エネルギーセクターは２．５％上昇し、過去最高値を付けた。サウジアラビアでのイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が高まり、北海ブレント原油はこの日、４月下旬以来の高値を付けた。

この日は通信関連銘柄が下落し、通信サービスセクターの重しとなった。宇宙開発企業スペースＸが全米で少なくとも８万カ所の携帯電話基地局の利用を確保するため、通信インフラ企業と協議していると報じられたことが材料となった。

ＡＴ＆ＴとＴモバイルはともに約８％下落し、ベライゾンは１．２％安。一方、スペースＸは１．９％上昇した。

アメリカン・エキスプレスは３．７％下落し、ダウ工業株３０種の重しとなった。同社は、２０２６年通期の利益予想を市場予想を上回る水準に引き上げた。また、事業再編の一環として世界の従業員の５％に当たる約３５００人を削減する計画を発表した。 

来週は、アルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムのＡＩ「ハイパースケーラー」３社の四半期決算発表が予定されており、各社の設備投資見通しが市場の注目を集めそうだ。

マン・グループのチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジスト、クリスティナ・フーパー氏は「ＡＩ関連銘柄を疑問視する動きの余波は依然として残っている」と指摘。「来年、ＡＩデータセンター拡張への投資がこれまでの予想よりも少なくなる可能性は確かにある。だからこそ、市場に様子見姿勢が広がっているのだと思う」と述べた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．７２対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５４億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

来週は、アルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムのＡＩ「ハイパースケーラー」３社の四半期決算発表が予定されており、各社の設備投資見通しが市場の注目を集めそうだ。

マン・グループのチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジスト、クリスティナ・フーパー氏は「ＡＩ関連銘柄を疑問視する動きの余波は依然として残っている」と指摘。「来年、ＡＩデータセンター拡張への投資がこれまでの予想よりも少なくなる可能性は確かにある。だからこそ、市場に様子見姿勢が広がっているのだと思う」と述べた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．７２対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５４億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

items.title: African Champions League holders knocked out in second round
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Holders Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa were bundled out of the African Champions League in the second preliminary round on Friday, beaten on the away goals rule by Wiliete from Angola.
items.body:
Holders Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa were bundled out of the African Champions League in the second preliminary round on Friday, beaten on the away goals rule by Wiliete from Angola.
The second leg at Loftus Versfeld in Pretoria finished 1-1 five days after the two sides had played out a goalless draw in Lubango in the first leg last Sunday.
Sundowns went ahead after 11 minutes through Tashreeq Matthews but Angola international Mabululu equalised four minutes into the second half.
Wiliete then produced a stout rearguard action to reach the group phase for the first time.
The lineup for the next round, where 16 teams will be divided into four groups, will be decided on Sunday when the last of the preliminary round matches are played.
Sundowns qualified for the group phase in the previous 11 editions of the Champions League and their defeat ranks among the competition's biggest shocks.

items.title: Justicia argentina archiva investigación contra presidente Milei en escándalo de criptomoneda
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La investigación penal sobre el papel del presidente argentino Javier Milei y su hermana Karina en un escándalo relacionado con una criptomoneda viral fue archivada el viernes, según consta en registros judiciales.
items.body:
La investigación penal sobre el papel del presidente argentino Javier Milei y su hermana Karina en un escándalo relacionado con una criptomoneda viral fue archivada el viernes, según consta en registros judiciales.
Según el periódico local La Nación, el juez federal Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi dictó la orden luego de que el fiscal Eduardo Taiano solicitara el sobreseimiento.
En febrero de 2025 se designó a un juez para investigar el papel de Milei en la promoción de una criptomoneda que se desplomó.
Milei había recomendado la poco conocida criptomoneda $LIBRA en una publicación en su cuenta de X, lo que provocó un breve repunte. Posteriormente, eliminó la publicación y negó cualquier vínculo con la criptomoneda, cuyo precio pronto se desplomó.
La investigación había analizado un posible fraude relacionado con el lanzamiento de la criptomoneda.
En el momento del desplome de la moneda, Milei afirmó haber actuado "de buena fe" y acusó a sus rivales políticos de intentar aprovecharse de la situación.

items.title: Petrolera NABEP aumenta producción en el Lago de Maracaibo en Venezuela
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La petrolera North America Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) ha incrementado la extracción de crudo en su mayor proyecto activo, Petrozamora, hasta alcanzar los 115.000 barriles diarios (bpd), dijo el viernes su director ejecutivo, Alejandro Betancourt.
items.body:
La petrolera North America Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) ha incrementado la extracción de crudo en su mayor proyecto activo, Petrozamora, hasta alcanzar los 115.000 barriles diarios (bpd), dijo el viernes su director ejecutivo, Alejandro Betancourt.
La compañía, que en agosto firmó un acuerdo clave con Estados Unidos, planea incorporar al proyecto ubicado en el Lago de Maracaibo, al oeste de Venezuela, dos campos adicionales, Bachaquero 3 y Ceuta 4, en el transcurso de los próximos cuatro meses, añadió Betancourt durante un evento transmitido por la televisión estatal.
En julio, Petrozamora registraba una producción de unos 100.000 bpd,de acuerdo con cifras independientes consultadas por Reuters.

items.title: Trump says US will 'take care of Cuba' on its way back from Iran
items.author: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Friday the United States would take care of Cuba after dealing with Iran and would send Secretary of State Marco Rubio to finish the deal.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Friday the United States would take care of Cuba after dealing with Iran and would send Secretary of State Marco Rubio to finish the deal.
"We'll take care of Cuba on our way back from Iran ... then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," Trump told a rally in Florida.
Trump [USN:L1N45I044 TEXT:"predicted last month"] the US and Cuba would reach an agreement and that he did not think military action would be necessary.
The Trump administration [USN:L1N45L02I TEXT:"has previously stated"] its goal is to change Cuba's communist government.
A US-imposed oil blockade implemented earlier this year has put Cuba under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and [USN:L1N44002K TEXT:"blackouts"] exacerbated by failing infrastructure.
Washington has maintained an embargo on Cuba for more than 60 years and the Trump administration has been [USN:L1N4590T5 TEXT:"stepping up pressure"] on Havana after the US military in January seized then-Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in a deadly raid.
Cuba's foreign minister told the UN General Assembly last month Cuba would always be open for dialogue with Washington.

items.title: Ravens list QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) as questionable vs. Bengals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was listed as questionable for his team's home game Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals because of a left ankle injury.
items.body:
Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was listed as questionable for his team's home game Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals because of a left ankle injury.
Jackson was limited at practice for a third consecutive day on Friday because of an injury he picked up against the Tennessee Titans back on Oct. 4.
The two-time MVP quarterback missed the second half of the Titans game and the following two games -- a Baltimore win at Atlanta and last week's loss in Cleveland -- while recovering from the injury.
"He's still got a lot of work to do in order to be able to play on Sunday, but he's really working at it behind the scenes," Ravens offensive coordinator Declan Doyle said Thursday. "It's great having him in the meeting room. And it's another thing to be able to have him out there on the field with us and continuing to push and his teammates seeing him push and all that stuff."
Jackson has six TD passes and one interception plus a rushing touchdown in 14 total quarters played in 2026. In his stead, Baltimore turned to Tyler Huntley at quarterback the past two weeks.
Jackson is 11-2 as a starter against Cincinnati in his career with 3,699 total yards (2,868 passing) and 26 TDs (two rushing TDs).
The Ravens are one of three 4-2 teams in the AFC North and lead the division in points (156) while ranking last in points allowed (132). Baltimore has 116 points and 14 touchdowns with Jackson at quarterback this season, compared to 40 points and four touchdowns without him.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Detained migrants have no constitutional right to bond hearings, US court rules
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond.
items.body:
A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump 's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond.
In a 10-7 ruling powered by its conservative majority, the New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals decided that the Constitution's Fifth Amendment due process protections do not require that immigration detainees receive bond hearings.
"To the extent petitioners seek to vindicate a liberty interest to be free from physical restraint in the most abstract sense, they can do so at any moment by agreeing to leave the country," US Circuit Judge Cory Wilson, a Trump appointee, wrote in the decision.
The ruling, if left to stand, would eliminate a key avenue for detained migrants in the three states under the 5th Circuit's jurisdiction — Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi — to argue for release, especially if the US Supreme Court decides the administration's detention practice complies with immigration law.
The Supreme Court this month [USN:L1N45N0KS TEXT:"agreed to consider"] the issue, which has divided lower courts. Numerous lawsuits by migrants arguing they were being unlawfully detained have flooded the courts as US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, implemented Trump's mass deportation agenda.
The Supreme Court is considering only whether such hearings are required by statute, not by the Constitution, the issue the 5th Circuit addressed with Friday's decision.
While the 5th Circuit in February had adopted the administration's reading of immigration law as requiring mandatory detention, a 2-1 panel of the court in July held that ICE could not constitutionally detain people for more than 90 days without providing hearings to argue for release on bond.
The decision, which came in lawsuits by two Mexican citizens and one Honduran, carried particular importance because Texas and Louisiana, within the 5th Circuit's jurisdiction, house the nation's largest numbers of immigration detainees.
But the full 5th Circuit agreed to rehear the case, and on Friday reversed course, concluding that detained immigrants are not constitutionally entitled to proceedings in immigration court beyond what Congress provided by statute.
"This ruling opens the door to more people being locked up for no reason, with devastating consequences for them, their loved ones and their community," Ellie Norton, a lawyer for the non-US citizens in the case at the National Immigration Project, said in a statement.
James Percival, the general counsel for the US Department of Homeland Security, in a social media post hailed what he called a "big win in the 5th Circuit on mandatory detention for illegal aliens."
Among the dissenting judges was US Circuit Judge Dana Douglas, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, who wrote that "unchecked, executive authority to arrest and detain, indefinitely, echoes fearfully from history."

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nicole Jao

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Nicole Jao

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は３ドル超上昇し、約半年ぶりの高値で取引を終えた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビア攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が強まった。アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）当局も原油流出を報告した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．５５ドル（３．１４％）高の１バレル＝１１６．７２ドルと、４月２９日以来の高値。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．８０ドル（３．８％）高の１０３．２７ドルだった。

週間では北海ブレントが６％、ＷＴＩが２．３％上昇した。

ＬＰＬファイナンシャルのチーフクロスアセットストラテジスト、アダム・ターンクイスト氏は「フーシ派が、エネルギーインフラを含むサウジ各地で一連の攻撃を実施し、供給混乱への懸念が相場を押し上げた」と述べた。

ＵＡＥの気候変動・環境省は、ウンムアルカイワイン沖でタンカーからの原油流出が確認されたと発表した。流出の原因は明らかにしておらず、当局は該当するタンカーを特定していない。

items.title: Wall Street fecha em baixa, encerrando semana volátil
items.author: Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
items.creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
items.summary: Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam em baixa nesta sexta-feira, mesmo com as ações do setor de tecnologia se estabilizando um pouco, encerrando uma semana turbulenta para o setor de IA que impulsiona o mercado, com os investidores aguardando uma agenda repleta de divulgações de resultados corporativos e uma reunião do Federal Reserve sobre a política de taxas de juros.
items.body:
Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam em baixa nesta sexta-feira, mesmo com as ações do setor de tecnologia se estabilizando um pouco, encerrando uma semana turbulenta para o setor de IA que impulsiona o mercado, com os investidores aguardando uma agenda repleta de divulgações de resultados corporativos e uma reunião do Federal Reserve sobre a política de taxas de juros.
O Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) registrou uma leve baixa um dia depois que o índice predominantemente tecnológico sofreu sua maior queda em um único dia desde junho, à medida que aumentavam as preocupações com os custos de financiamento para sustentar os pesados gastos com investimentos em IA. O setor de tecnologia do S&P 500 registrou um ganho de 0,35% nesta sexta-feira.
A maioria dos setores do S&P 500, no entanto, registrou quedas, incluindo recuos bem acima de 1% nos setores de bens de consumo básico e bens de consumo discricionário, bem como no setor financeiro.
Na próxima semana, cerca de um terço das empresas do S&P 500 divulgará seus resultados trimestrais, incluindo a Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , a Microsoft (MSFT.O) e a Amazon (AMZN.O) — três gigantes da IA cujas previsões de gastos de capital serão acompanhadas de perto em Wall Street.
“Ainda há repercussões do questionamento em torno do setor de IA”, disse Kristina Hooper, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Man Group. “Certamente existe a possibilidade de vermos menos investimentos na expansão de data centers de IA no próximo ano do que o projetado. Portanto, acredito que isso esteja causando uma pausa.”
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 1,23%, para 52.215,16 pontos; o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,52%, para 7.623,68 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,21%, para 25.955,34 pontos.
Na semana, o S&P 500 recuou 0,5% e o Nasdaq caiu 0,7%. O Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, subiu 0,4%, registrando seu terceiro ganho semanal consecutivo.
As ações de telecomunicações caíram e pesaram sobre o setor de serviços de comunicação, após uma reportagem afirmar que a SpaceX buscava milhares de locais para antenas de telefonia celular para uma quarta operadora móvel.
As ações da AT&T (T.N) e da T-Mobile (TMUS.O) afundaram quase 8%, enquanto a Verizon (VZ.N) recuou 1,2%. As ações da SpaceX subiram 1,9%. As operadoras de torres de telefonia celular dos EUA registraram ganhos, com a Crown Castle (CCI.N) saltando 9% e a American Tower (AMT.N) subindo 4%.
O setor de energia (.SPNY) subiu 2,5%, atingindo uma máxima recorde. O petróleo Brent atingiu seu nível mais alto desde o final de abril, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no fornecimento de energia do Oriente Médio.
As ações da American Express (AXP.N) caíram 3,7%, pesando sobre o Dow. A empresa elevou sua previsão de lucro ao mesmo tempo em que anunciou planos para eliminar 5% de sua força de trabalho.
As ações da SLB (SLB.N) saltaram 7% depois que a prestadora de serviços para campos petrolíferos superou as estimativas de Wall Street para o lucro do terceiro trimestre.
Dados da Universidade de Michigan mostraram que a confiança do consumidor nos EUA recuou ligeiramente em outubro, aproximando-se de uma mínima histórica, à medida que o aumento dos preços devido ao conflito no Oriente Médio prejudicou a percepção das famílias sobre a economia.
O foco do mercado continua voltado para a temporada de resultados, com o robusto crescimento dos lucros corporativos sustentando as altas dos principais índices de ações neste ano. As empresas do S&P 500 devem registrar um aumento nos lucros de mais de 32% no terceiro trimestre, de acordo com dados da LSEG IBES.
Espera-se que o Fed mantenha as taxas de juros inalteradas quando divulgar sua declaração de política monetária na quarta-feira, mas os investidores estarão ansiosos por indícios sobre se o banco central dos EUA aumentará as taxas em sua reunião de dezembro. Wall Street também está cada vez mais focada nas eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro, que decidirão o controle do Congresso dos EUA.

items.title: Trump amplía exenciones arancelarias a productos de Canadá para favorecer la campaña republicana en Maine
items.author: Steven T. Dennis, Josh Wingrove, Greg Ryan
items.summary: Las exenciones incluyen productos de papel, plástico, maquinaria y algas marinas que abastecen a industrias de Maine. La senadora republicana busca reivindicar su gestión comercial ante el riesgo de p ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La administración Trump está ampliando las exenciones arancelarias a más productos canadienses, una medida que podría contribuir a impulsar la campaña de reelección de la senadora republicana Susan Collins en Maine. Collins anunció el viernes en un comunicado que las exenciones se aplicarían a determinados productos de papel, plástico, maquinaria y algas marinas, y señaló que contribuirían a la economía rural y costera del estado, incluidas las industrias del arándano, la patata, la manzana y las algas marinas. “Muchos de nuestros agricultores y productores dependen de equipos especializados, materiales de embalaje y otros productos procedentes de Canadá que o bien no están disponibles a través de proveedores estadounidenses, o bien no pueden sustituirse sin incurrir en un gasto significativo”, afirmó. Ver más: Administración Trump enfrenta demanda por aranceles del 50% a productos canadienses La Casa Blanca no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El Wall Street Journal informó anteriormente de que las reducciones podrían compensarse aumentando los aranceles sobre otros productos canadienses. La Sra. Collins, que se encuentra inmersa en una reñida campaña de reelección, ha destacado su capacidad para conseguir reducciones arancelarias que benefician a los consumidores y las empresas de Maine. Su oficina indicó que había presionado para obtener exenciones adicionales durante sus conversaciones con el representante comercial de Estados Unidos, Jamieson Greer, y el secretario de Comercio, Howard Lutnick. El candidato demócrata al Senado, Troy Jackson, respondió el viernes que Collins “quiere que se le reconozca el mérito de haber traído un vaso de agua para apagar el incendio”, argumentando que solo actuó porque corre el riesgo de perder su escaño. “Nos merecemos una senadora que se enfrente a Trump, no una que apruebe sin más su agenda y suplique alivio ante el caos que ella misma ayudó a crear”, publicó Jackson en X. El presidente Donald Trump ya había eximido el mes pasado a la sal para carreteras y otros productos, a petición de Collins, al mismo tiempo que anunciaba una serie de medidas de represalia tras el fracaso de las negociaciones entre EE.UU. y Canadá. Canadá también modificó sus propios aranceles de represalia para excluir los productos del mar. Según la declaración de Collins, entre los productos recién exentos se incluirán el papel y las cajas de cartón ondulado, algunos materiales de embalaje de plástico, equipos de refrigeración y congelación, maquinaria agrícola de limpieza, clasificación y selección, determinada maquinaria de embalaje, así como productos alimenticios a base de algas marinas. Ver más: Los países de América Latina cuyas exportaciones enfrentan los mayores aranceles de EE.UU., según la Cepal Estos cambios se producen en un momento en que las negociaciones comerciales entre EE.UU. y Canadá se encuentran estancadas. No ha habido nuevas conversaciones sustantivas desde que las negociaciones sobre un acuerdo arancelario fracasaran en agosto. La Sra. Collins se encuentra entre los senadores republicanos en el cargo más amenazados este noviembre, aunque los demócratas han fracasado en intentos anteriores por desbancarla. Esta medida se produce cuando las encuestas a nivel nacional y estatal muestran que los votantes otorgan malas calificaciones a los republicanos por su gestión del coste de la vida y la guerra de Trump en Irán. Collins ha desafiado con frecuencia las encuestas y los entornos políticos adversos para mantener su escaño, pero se enfrenta al aumento de los precios —incluidos los de la vivienda y el combustible— que han hecho que la vida resulte menos asequible para muchos habitantes de Maine. Jackson ha arremetido contra Collins por los aranceles, argumentando que podría aprovechar mejor su cargo como presidenta de la influyente comisión de asignaciones presupuestarias para obligar a Trump a retirarlos. Ver más: Negociaciones entre EE.UU. y México llegan a un punto muerto en aranceles al acero Collins ha intentado distanciarse del presidente, afirmando en un debate reciente que “no es precisamente su senadora favorita”. La senadora republicana se ha atribuido el mérito de haber frenado su agenda arancelaria, entre otras cosas al conseguir la exención para la sal de carretera. Esto llevó a su oponente, Jackson, a replicar en el escenario del debate que los votantes de Maine “no pueden comerse la sal de carretera”. Además de elevar los precios al consumo y perjudicar a sectores de Maine como la agricultura, la guerra comercial ha perjudicado a destinos turísticos como Bar Harbor y Ogunquit, ya que los canadienses, molestos con el presidente, se abstienen de pasar sus habituales vacaciones en este estado fronterizo. -Con la colaboración de Laura Curtis. items.title: Instacart in talks with DoorDash and Uber for sale, The Information reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Instacart is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, The Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Instacart (CART.O) is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, The Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Shares of Instacart closed about 9% higher and were down marginally in extended trading. The company currently has a market value of about $12 billion.
A potential takeover by Uber or DoorDash could bolster the buyer's online grocery delivery ambitions by combining Instacart's established marketplace and retailer ties with its own vast delivery network and customer base.
But either deal could draw antitrust scrutiny, as it would bulk up two of the biggest food-delivery platforms in the US and add to a wave of consolidation across the industry. In July, Uber struck a nearly $15 billion deal to buy Germany's Delivery Hero, to create the largest food-delivery group outside China.
Shares of Uber (UBER.N) closed down nearly 3% while DoorDash (DASH.O) fell more than 4%. Instacart declined to comment when contacted by Reuters, while Uber and DoorDash did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Discussions are ongoing and there is no guarantee they will lead to a deal, the report said, adding that a typical takeover premium of 30% to 40% would value Instacart at roughly $16 billion to $17 billion, based on recent public technology deals.
In 2021, DoorDash had held talks to acquire Instacart, legally known as Maplebear, in a potential deal that would have valued the grocery-delivery company at between $40 billion and $50 billion, [USN:L4N2PI4JF TEXT:"according"] to The Information. Instacart was privately valued at $39 billion at the time.
The talks fell apart partly because of concerns over whether a combination could secure antitrust approval under the Biden administration, the report said.

items.body:
Sam Altman-led OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed reinforcement learning training and internal use of its most advanced AI solutions after it tightened security controls and barred internet access for frontier-model training.
Concerns are mounting over the ability of increasingly capable AI agents to identify and exploit software flaws, including in guardrails.
OpenAI had halted training and evaluation of its most capable models after an internal research model briefly exploited a misconfiguration to gain limited internet access on September 2, it said in a blog post
The ChatGPT maker resumed reinforcement learning training and internal inference of its frontier models on October 1 after implementing additional safeguards
It has launched a campaign to probe its research infrastructure for vulnerabilities that could allow models to escape isolated computing environments, OpenAI said
AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research said on Thursday they [USN:L6N46815Y TEXT:"found several new vulnerabilities"] in OpenAI's internal system
The company [USN:L4N45N1OZ TEXT:"has been conducting"] a broad review of its AI models' activity after the accidental [USN:L6N4580VP TEXT:"Hugging Face hacking"]
OpenAI [USN:L4N45N1OZ TEXT:"informed more than 100 organizations"] about incidents of unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents

items.title: AI 'hallucinations' in court filings show signs of slowdown, but judges still sound alarms
items.author: Mike Scarcella, Sara Merken
items.creator: Mike Scarcella, Sara Merken
items.summary: New instances of "hallucinations" and other AI-generated errors in court filings fell in the second and third quarters of 2026, according to new research, indicating that lawyers and other users may be taking greater precautions or that newer generative AI models could be less prone to mistakes.
items.body:
New instances of "hallucinations" and other AI-generated errors in court filings fell in the second and third quarters of 2026, according to new research, indicating that lawyers and other users may be taking greater precautions or that newer generative AI models could be less prone to mistakes.
Court filings containing made-up, misquoted, misleading or incorrectly cited legal filing surged since 2022, when AI technology debuted on a mass scale.
But legal scholar Damien Charlotin, who created a highly-cited database of hallucination-related cases, said in a blog post on Friday that their number had declined since the spring.
Until then, the number of cases involving AI-related errors had been rapidly rising, according to Charlotin's database, which has tracked at least 1,500 such cases in US state and federal courts.
Charlotin, a senior researcher at the business school at HEC Paris, cautioned that a range of factors could be contributing to the decline, including the possibility that errors are just as frequent but are being reported less often when they are viewed as minor or unsurprising.
"Part of the reason lies in the progress on the model front: new LLMs hallucinate less," Charlotin wrote, citing a recent research experiment where various models were asked to create legal documents.
Charlotin told Reuters on Friday he expects instances of AI errors to continue to decrease but not disappear in the short or medium term.
"Tools get better, true, but not everyone is up to date on the latest tools," he said. He also said technological improvements could cause lawyers to lower their guard. "If AI does the job great in 99% of the cases, you'll eventually stop checking and rely on it – until it hallucinates again," he said.
In the meantime, US judges are [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"continuing to warn"] about the prevalence of AI errors, especially in court filings by non-lawyers.
“It is this court’s experience that for every good AI-assisted filing there are ten more obstructive ones,” US District Judge John Tuchi in Arizona said in an order on Thursday dismissing a civil rights lawsuit. “And the obstructive ones are often like the head of Hydra, for each one dismissed, several more follow.”
Tuchi said the lawsuit filed by the plaintiff who was not represented by an attorney lacked factual specificity and appeared to be produced using AI. The judge allowed the plaintiff to file an amended case. He didn't bar the use of AI in the case but complained that AI-assisted submissions had gotten out of control.
“The court simply decries the overwhelming volume of filings, and sheer verbiage therein, which to date have pummeled courts," Tuchi wrote.
Lawyers are generally not prohibited from using AI, but they are bound by ethics and other court rules to verify the accuracy of their court submissions. Individuals without lawyers also have obligations to ensure the accuracy of court papers they file.

US President Donald Trump said on Friday Washington may carry out another military operation against Iran at a time when the war is nearing its eight month mark and as rise in fuel prices weigh on the US midterm elections .
"We may do another little Epic Fury," Trump said in remarks at a rally in Florida as he spoke about the war. He did not elaborate.
"Operation Epic Fury" is the name used by the US military for its war against Iran.
Earlier on Friday, Trump said the US could end the war quickly but questioned whether Washington should seek a swift conclusion or allow the conflict to gradually wind down.
Trump, who has [USN:L4N4061X8 TEXT:"offered shifting goals and timelines"] for the war, said earlier this month that the US would not launch an attack on Iran before the midterm elections in which control of Congress is up for grab.
US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon have [USN:L1N3ZR14Q TEXT:"killed thousands"] and [USN:L6N3ZY0Q0 TEXT:"displaced millions"]

items.title: No hay evidencia de colocación de bandera palestina en la cima de la Torre Eiffel
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: No hay registro de que una bandera palestina haya ondeado en la cima de la Torre Eiffel en París, Francia, contrario a lo que muestra un clip compartido en redes sociales.
items.body:
No hay registro de que una bandera palestina haya ondeado en la cima de la Torre Eiffel en París, Francia, contrario a lo que muestra un clip compartido en redes sociales.
Estos son los detalles clave:
Una publicación en Facebook dice que activistas del grupo Extinction Rebellion colocaron la bandera sobre el monumento.
La publicación más antigua con el video fue compartida el 18 de octubre por el usuario de TikTok @jaranor.films, quien se describe como “creador de contenido Audiovisual & IA” y no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios.
La plataforma identificó el video como material con contenido multimedia generado por IA.
Déborah Thiney-Masselin, portavoz de la Dirección General de la Policía Nacional de Francia, dijo en un correo el 20 de octubre que el clip compartido en redes sociales es falso y fue generado íntegramente por IA.
Un análisis con la herramienta de verificación Meta Platforms determinó que la imagen probablemente fue editada o creada usando los modelos de IA de la empresa tecnológica. La herramienta detecta marcas de agua invisibles incrustadas en el medio generado.
En el video, la bandera sobre la estructura contiene una estrella en el costado izquierdo, lo que no corresponde con la bandera palestina, y tampoco es visible un puente debajo, como lo muestra una captura de Google Street View.
El 15 de mayo de 2026, miembros de Extinction Rebellion subieron a la Torre Eiffel para mostrar banderas palestinas en una planta inferior y no en la cima.
Francia registra una ola de [USN:L8N4670KY TEXT:"manifestaciones"] que ha dado lugar a [USN:L8N46401O TEXT:"enfrentamientos"] y daños materiales.
La sociedad que administra la Torre Eiffel no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios.
Veredicto: Sin evidencia. No hay registro de que un grupo de personas haya colocado una bandera palestina en la cima de la Torre Eiffel.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.body:
Un video grabado en 2023 en el que la senadora Martha Lucía Mícher, del partido oficialista Morena, renuncia al partido durante una discusión en el Senado se comparte erróneamente en publicaciones que dicen que ocurrió en octubre de 2026, después de que la funcionaria hiciera comentarios sobre beneficios para clientes de Aeroméxico.
Publicaciones en línea que incluyen el video dicen en parte: “La Senadora Malú Micher de MORENA hace berrinche y amenaza con irse del partido ya que no la defendieron en su postura contra las salas VIP de Aeroméxico”.
En el video, Mícher dice que iba a renunciar a Morena frente a integrantes de su bancada, entre ellas la entonces senadora Citlalli Hernández, hoy presidenta de la Comisión Nacional de Elecciones de Morena.
Sin embargo, la versión más antigua del video vista por Reuters fue publicada por Político MX el 26 de octubre del 2023.
Imágenes de la transmisión de la asamblea muestran el momento en que ocurrió el altercado, después de que la entonces presidenta de la Mesa Directiva, Ana Lilia Rivera, también de Morena, le negara la palabra a Mícher en la discusión de la Ley de Ingresos de 2024.
Imágenes de la transmisión de la asamblea de ese día muestran el momento en que ocurrió el altercado, después de que la entonces presidenta de la Mesa Directiva, Ana Lilia Rivera, también de Morena, le negara la palabra a Mícher en la discusión de la Ley de Ingresos de 2024.
La senadora Lilly Téllez compartió otro ángulo de la discusión.
Horas después, Mícher dijo en su cuenta de X que había dialogado con Rivera y “se aclararon ideas”.
La senadora no presentó una renuncia oficial en esa fecha y, al 23 de octubre de 2026, Mícher figura como integrante de Morena en el sitio web del Senado .
POLÍTICAS DE AEROMÉXICO El 16 de octubre, la senadora expresó en X su inconformidad por los cambios en el acceso a los salones de Aeroméxico y dijo que pediría una reunión con ejecutivos de la empresa para que explicaran sus nuevas políticas.
No hay información oficial a la fecha sobre negociaciones en el Senado con Aeroméxico.
Según el sitio web de Aeroméxico, a partir del 1 de septiembre actualizó las condiciones de acceso a sus Salones Premier para socios Aeroméxico Rewards y dijo que los vuelos nacionales en Clase Premier ya no incluirían acceso a Salón Premier.
El equipo de comunicación de Morena y Mícher no respondieron inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios.
VEREDICTO Falta contexto. El video fue grabado durante una sesión del Senado el 26 de octubre de 2023, no muestra un registro actual tras comentarios de Martha Lucía Mícher sobre las políticas para usuarios de Aeroméxico.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: Kenya reports second death from Ebola
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, the health ministry said late on Friday, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month.
items.body:
Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, the health ministry said late on Friday, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month.
The outbreak, which started in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now been reported in four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, giving it the widest geographic spread of any Ebola outbreak on the continent to date.
Kenya's first Ebola case was identified this month in a man who travelled from Congo to Nairobi and died at a Nairobi hospital on October 5.
Since then, Kenyan authorities have traced 135 contacts, all of whom were placed in quarantine, with nine cases confirmed.
The Ebola victim who died on Friday evening was a direct contact of the index patient, the ministry said.
"This loss brings the number of deaths to two among the nine confirmed cases. The remaining seven patients continue to receive care in the two isolation facilities," the ministry said, adding there was no evidence of community spread in the country.
Late on Monday, the US State Department [USN:FWN4651IO TEXT:"advised"] Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory level for the country because of health risks.
On Tuesday, Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case, with officials scrambling to work out how and where the patient, who had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, contracted the disease.
Ebola has infected nearly 10,000 people and killed more than 4,600 in Congo. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. Only people with symptoms can transmit the virus.
The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine.

items.title: Oncologists Cheer Melanoma Data
items.summary:
Leaked data from Moderna and Merck's highly anticipated melanoma vaccine trial has led to a rare disconnect between doctors, who celebrated the result, and Wall Street, which sold off the stocks.
Normally results of such pivotal drug studies are binary, with doctors, patients and investors all learning whether a novel medicine will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives and forming the same conclusion. Instead, as reports leaked out on social media about the findings of the melanoma shot — days before the carefully scripted presentation planned for thousands of oncologists gathered in Madrid for the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting — realities diverged.  Madison Muller, Bloomberg News Healthcare Reporter, reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 仏、24日の抗議活動に警官７万人動員　先週末の暴動再発警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Makini Brice　Crispian Balmer

[パリ　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Makini Brice　Crispian Balmer

[パリ　２３日　ロイター] - フランスで生活費の高騰などに抗議するデモが大規模な暴動に発展してから１週間が経過する中、ニュネス内相は２３日、暴力行為や略奪の再発を防ぐため、２４日に全国で予定されている抗議活動に対応するため７万人の警察官を動員すると発表した。政府が治安維持能力を失ったとの懸念を払拭するため、精鋭治安部隊や重武装の機動隊を通常の警察部隊とともに配備し、厳戒態勢で臨む。

ニュネス氏は記者団に対し「暴徒や略奪者、あらゆる暴力行為を行う者に対し一切妥協しない」と述べた。「極左」団体がインターネット上で公共施設を標的にし、一段の無秩序状態を引き起こすよう呼びかけていると言及し「これは平穏で友好的なデモではない。最大限の警戒態勢を敷き、断固として対応する。一切の違法行為を容認しない」と語った。

警察当局は２４日に首都パリで予定されるデモについて、労働組合による１件のみを許可。フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦや、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」が申請した集会は許可されなかった。パリ以外の多くの都市でも抗議活動が禁止されたが、第２の都市マルセイユでは禁止命令が撤回され、労組によるデモの実施が認められた。

当局は特に、中部オルレアンで週末に開かれる極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の年次党大会が新たな緊張の火種となる可能性を警戒。ニュネス氏によると、今週末に動員される警察官は前週末より１万人増員される。騎馬警官やヘリコプター、ドローン、対ドローン装備を全国に配備するほか、装甲車や放水車も待機。一部の要警戒地域で導入された夜間外出禁止令は継続されるという。

＜ルーブル美術館など休館、サッカー試合も延期＞

前週末の暴動再発への懸念から、パリの主要文化施設の一部は２４日、終日休館を決めた。対象にはルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座が含まれる。このほか、治安上の懸念から、サッカーフランス１部リーグのパリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）対オリンピック・リヨン戦は開催日が２５日から２６日に変更された。一方、米ナショナル・フットボール・リーグ（ＮＦＬ）のピッツバーグ・スティーラーズ対ニューオーリンズ・セインツ戦は、トランプ米大統領が中止を求めたにもかかわらず、２５日にパリで予定通り開催されると見られている。

前週末の暴動で約３０００の店舗や事業所が略奪被害を受けていたため、経済団体も小売店に対し休業を呼びかけている。フランス商工会議所のアラン・ディ・クレセンゾ会頭は、一部の商店主は店舗を守るため野球バットや散弾銃などを準備しているとし、自警のために暴力に訴えないよう呼びかけた。

社会不安の拡大を受け、仏経済の先行き懸念が増大。政府が財政支出の抑制に十分取り組んでいないとの懸念が改めて意識される中、格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日にフランス国債格付けを引き下げるとの観測が市場で広がっている。
