items.title: Midterms: Your questions, answered
items.author: Joseph Ax, Jason Lange, Nathan Layne, Rawan Yaghi
items.creator: Joseph Ax, Jason Lange, Nathan Layne, Rawan Yaghi
items.summary: Over the summer, we asked you to submit your most pressing questions about the US midterm elections. Here are the answers and insights from our reporters.
items.body:
Over the summer, we asked you to submit your most pressing questions about the US midterm elections . You asked about voter eligibility checks, threats to election officials or results, the effects of redistricting and which races are most likely to determine control of Congress.
Here are Reuters reporters’ answers to these questions, which were also published in the Politics US Newsletter . Similar questions have been combined and edited for clarity.
If you have more questions related to the midterms or other topics related to US politics, write to campaigntrail@thomsonreuters.com .
Q: Which national issues are having the greatest influence on competitive races? Answered by: Nathan Layne, Politics Reporter, and Jason Lange, Politics Data Reporter
Our [USN:L6N43U101 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos polling"] suggests that [USN:L6N46017L TEXT:"rising prices"], exacerbated by the war with Iran, are having an outsized impact on the midterm environment. About half of voters say the cost of living is the single most important issue in the congressional elections, compared with roughly 1 in 5 who cite democratic norms and about 1 in 10 who point to immigration.
That focus on inflation extends across the major expenses that dominate household budgets, from housing and healthcare to food and fuel. Gasoline prices, pushed higher by the conflict, and the elevated cost of grocery staples such as coffee and beef are particularly potent politically because voters encounter them regularly at the pump and checkout counter.
Starting this past summer, our polling has shown that, for the first time in a decade, voters view Democrats as better stewards of the economy than Republicans. Against that backdrop, Republican strategists and party officials say they are seeking to frame the midterms as a choice between two parties, casting Democrats as increasingly influenced by socialist ideas, rather than a referendum on current economic conditions.
Q: What are the most plausible paths for Democrats and Republicans to win control of the House and Senate in the 2026 midterm elections, and which races are most likely to determine the outcome? Answered by Jason Lange, Politics Data Reporter
Democrats face an uphill fight to win[USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:" the Senate"], where they need to pick up four seats. They would have to hold Michigan and New Hampshire – both tight races – while flipping four of six Republican-held seats in play: Alaska, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, Iowa and Texas – the last two of which haven't elected Democrats to the Senate in over a decade.
Republicans face more pressure in[USN:L6N45U0XS TEXT:" the House"], where their 218 members hold the smallest possible majority in the 435-seat chamber. About three dozen races nationwide are competitive. Democrats' best pickup chances include Republican-held seats in Nebraska's 2nd District, New Jersey's 7th and California's 48th, where district boundaries were redrawn to favor Democrats. Democrats must also defend Ohio's 9th and North Carolina's 1st, both redrawn to favor Republicans.
Q: What procedures do states use to verify voter eligibility and citizenship, and what does the available evidence show about the frequency and detection of ineligible voting or other election fraud? Answered by Joseph Ax, National Affairs Correspondent
Under federal law, every state must retain a statewide list of registered voters and perform regular maintenance on it to remove ineligible voters. In addition, US law requires first-time voters in federal elections who registered by mail to show some form of identification at the polls, such as a driver’s license, a paycheck or a utility bill.
Many states have imposed additional, more stringent procedures to verify eligibility, such as photo ID requirements, and those policies vary significantly among states. Votes cast by mail, which have come under frequent baseless attacks from Trump as unreliable, are typically checked by comparing the signature on the envelope with the one on file.
All available evidence indicates that ineligible voting, including noncitizen voting, is exceedingly rare. A Reuters investigation this year found just 129 cases in which noncitizens were federally charged with voting illegally; many appeared to stem from voter confusion or administrative errors, rather than intentional fraud.
The conservative Heritage Foundation think tank maintains a voter fraud database that includes just 1,619 cases from 1982 to 2025, or one for every 817,625 votes cast in a presidential election during that time.
Q: How are election officials preparing for threats to poll workers, misinformation, administrative disruptions or attempts to interfere with voting and vote counting? Answered by Peter Eisler , Ned Parker , Linda So and Mike Spector
Reuters interviewed more than 50 state and local election officials from both political parties, including a dozen secretaries of state, the top election officials in their states. Nearly all said they are adopting new strategies to prepare for political interference, misinformation, cyberattacks and even threats of violence ahead of the midterms. Their efforts span jurisdictions large and small, in areas controlled by Republicans and Democrats. In Michigan, for example, state officials are advising local clerks on the appropriate response if the federal government demands access to voting machines.
Preparations fall into three categories. Some election officials are hiring lawyers or seeking legal skills, as over a dozen interviewees said. Twice that many election officials said they are expanding public outreach and social media campaigns to counter misinformation around the reliability of mail-in voting or voting machines. Most of the interviewed officials said they are scrambling to fill gaps left by the Trump administration’s cuts to programs that help safeguard elections from cyberattacks and physical security threats. That includes ongoing work to fortify election offices with camera systems and bulletproof glass – a trend that began after Trump disputed his loss to Biden in the 2020 election, prompting violent threats by Trump supporters against election workers .
Read our reporting on more specific examples of what election officials are doing in preparation for such potential scenarios in Wisconsin, North Carolina, Georgia, Michigan, Colorado and Maine.
Q: How has redistricting affected the 2026 electoral map, and which maps or election practices are currently facing legal challenges? Answered by Joseph Ax, National Affairs Correspondent
Nine states have new US House maps in place after the redistricting war that unfolded over the last year. Republicans were the clear winners: the party gained an advantage in 15 districts across those states, while Democrats improved their chances in only 6 districts. However, Democrats remain favored to win the House, with Trump’s weak approval ratings[USN:L1N4660I0 TEXT:" dragging down his party’s candidates"].
There are about 40 seats in play in November out of 435 nationwide, meaning that a small fraction of voters will likely determine which party controls the House.
While some of the maps still face legal challenges, none of the litigation appears likely to alter any district lines ahead of November’s election.
Reuters reporters Bianca Flowers , David Hood-Nuño and Ally J. Levine mapped how redistricting has affected communities in Memphis, Tennessee.

items.title: Video de daños en un gimnasio durante sismo se grabó en Colombia, no en el Tíbet chino
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Un video que muestra el colapso de estructuras de un gimnasio y de un edificio en Pereira, Colombia, el 10 de agosto se comparte erróneamente en internet como si fuera del sismo de magnitud 7 que se registró en la región suroccidental del Tíbet, en China, el 22 de octubre.
items.body:
Un video que muestra el colapso de estructuras de un gimnasio y de un edificio en Pereira, Colombia, el 10 de agosto se comparte erróneamente en internet como si fuera del sismo de magnitud 7 que se registró en la región suroccidental del Tíbet, en China, el 22 de octubre.
Estos son los detalles clave:
Publicaciones en línea que incluyen el video dicen que es un registro del terremoto en octubre en el Tíbet chino que ha [USN:L6N46905A TEXT:"dejado"] 16 muertos y 76 heridos.
El gimnasio Meta Gym compartió una versión más larga y de mejor calidad de la grabación, que incluye una canción de fondo distinta, el 11 de agosto.
En respuesta a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters, Meta Gym dijo que el video es de su autoría y que fue grabado en el terremoto que sacudió Pereira en agosto.
El nombre del gimnasio aparece en la fachada. El edificio contiguo coincide con imágenes de Google Street View .
El 17 de septiembre, el recinto publicó en su cuenta de Instagram que trabajaba en retomar sus actividades después del sismo.
El 10 de agosto, un sismo de [USN:L1N3AC29B TEXT:"magnitud 7.4"] dejó al menos 331 muertos en Colombia, según una publicación en Facebook del 6 de septiembre de la Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres del país.
Veredicto: Erróneamente etiquetado: El video muestra un gimnasio afectado por el sismo del 10 de agosto en Pereira, Colombia, no al temblor del 22 de octubre en el Tíbet chino.

items.title: Heineken document reveals worries over weight-loss drugs and beer sales
items.author: Emma Rumney
items.creator: Emma Rumney
items.summary: Heineken has urged British pubs and bars to adapt to the booming use of weight-loss drugs.
items.body:
Heineken (HEIN.AS) has urged British pubs and bars to adapt to the booming use of weight-loss drugs or risk losing customers and revenue, according to a company presentation seen by Reuters, in a rare acknowledgement from a major alcohol maker that the medicines pose a threat to beer sales.
The warning comes as GLP-1 use has surged, with some 10 million people taking medications like Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) Ozempic and Wegovy in the US last year, according to JPMorgan research. Their growth is having ramifications across the consumer goods industry, hitting [USN:L6N44E0VN TEXT:"cravings for sweets and snacks"], driving up [USN:L6N45R11L TEXT:"demand for clothing alterations"] and prompting a scramble to sell products that [USN:L6N4500ZA TEXT:"counter side-effects"].
Heineken, the world's second-largest brewer after AB InBev told hospitality customers that GLP-1 drugs can reduce the desire to drink and put pressure on beer and cider sales from "fullness and fewer serves", while warning that traditional multi-pint drinking occasions could become harder to sustain.
The previously unreported presentation, sent to hospitality customers this month, advised venues to promote half-pints, low- and no-alcohol drinks and pair drinks with small plates, or risk declines in customer visits and spending as use of the medicines becomes increasingly mainstream in Britain.
The alcohol industry is already grappling with years of falling sales in some major markets as consumers cut back on drinking for health and economic reasons.
Heineken told Reuters the presentation was shared as part of its regular engagement with UK hospitality businesses to help them understand how the market is evolving.
"We see some changes in consumption behaviour among (GLP-1) users and will continue to monitor how these behaviours evolve in 2027," Heineken said.
GLP-1 users were not abandoning alcohol altogether but were increasingly opting for smaller serves, lower-alcohol drinks and more premium products, aligning with broader ongoing trends, it continued, adding its portfolio is well positioned to meet these demands.
EVIDENCE OF REDUCED CONSUMPTION GROWS Europe is the Dutch brewer's largest market by revenue, but growth has been sluggish. Heineken has singled out Britain, where it owns more than 2,000 pubs, as a relative bright spot.
Beer generated nearly £14 billion of sales in British pubs, bars and restaurants in the year to February 2026, with less than £300 million of that from no- and low-alcohol beers, according to a Heineken UK report.
Although drinks companies have largely played down the threat from GLP-1 medicines, emerging spending data points to an impact on purchases.
A group of US households with a GLP-1 user tracked by market research firm Circana between 2024 and 2026 reduced spending on alcohol for both at-home and out-of-home consumption compared with households without a user. After two years on the drugs, they spent about 7% less per month on alcohol versus non-using households, including around 13.5% less on beer.
Top spirits maker Diageo (DGE.L) has told investors any impact from GLP-1 drugs should be manageable even if use becomes more widespread. Carlsberg (CARLb.CO) told Reuters existing data did not yet support the view that the drugs were a clear driver of beer consumption trends. Anheuser-Busch InBev (ABI.BR) declined to comment.
Surveys in Europe and the UK by Circana, market researcher NIQ and specialist UK-based hospitality researcher KAM have also pointed to reduced drinking by GLP-1 users.
Ten of 11 GLP-1 users Reuters interviewed said they had reduced their drinking, sometimes significantly, saying it left them feeling uncomfortable or unwell, or they simply no longer had any desire to drink.
UK-based Daniel Cornwell, founder of hospitality executive recruitment business SPE Resourcing, said he used to drink regularly at work events and on weekends but now finds alcohol causes him discomfort and results in a multi-day hangover.
GLP-1's effects on the brain may also affect users' motivation to drink, said Joseph Schacht, a professor at the University of Colorado Anschutz, who led a randomised controlled trial on the impact of GLP-1s on people with alcohol use disorder. He said trials have consistently shown a reduction in cravings and consumption for people with AUD.
Schacht said the medicines could create a potential "Prozac moment" for AUD treatment, while also posing a challenge for alcohol producers if broader groups of drinkers cut back too.

items.title: Petróleo dispara US$3 com ataques houthis e vazamento; fecha no maior nível desde abril
items.author: Nicole Jao
items.creator: Nicole Jao
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de mais de US$3 nesta sexta-feira, atingindo o maior nível em quase seis meses, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no abastecimento de energia proveniente do Oriente Médio, região onde as autoridades dos Emirados Árabes Unidos também relataram um derramamento de petróleo.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de mais de US$3 nesta sexta-feira, atingindo o maior nível em quase seis meses, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no abastecimento de energia proveniente do Oriente Médio, região onde as autoridades dos Emirados Árabes Unidos também relataram um derramamento de petróleo.
Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam a US$116,72 o barril, alta de US$3,55 ou 3,14%, atingindo o maior nível desde 29 de abril. O petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fechou a US$103,27 o barril, alta de US$3,80 ou 3,8%.
O Brent encerrou a semana com alta de 6% e o WTI, com alta de 2,3%.
“Os temores de interrupções no abastecimento impulsionaram a alta depois que rebeldes houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, realizaram uma série de ataques em toda a Arábia Saudita, inclusive contra infraestrutura energética”, disse Adam Turnquist, estrategista-chefe de ativos cruzados da LPL Financial.
Na quinta-feira, a Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) ordenou a retirada de sua sede em Dhahran, no Golfo Pérsico, perto do Barein, informou a Reuters. Os combates se intensificaram entre a Arábia Saudita, maior exportadora mundial de petróleo, e os houthis, com base no Iêmen.
Foi detectado um derramamento de petróleo proveniente de um petroleiro na costa de Umm Al Quwain, nos Emirados Árabes Unidos, informou o Ministério das Mudanças Climáticas e do Meio Ambiente dos Emirados Árabes Unidos. O ministério não informou a causa do derramamento, e as autoridades ainda não identificaram o petroleiro envolvido.
ATAQUES A EMBARCAÇÕES Fontes do setor de navegação informaram, em 9 de outubro, que o superpetroleiro Gem No. 2 foi atingido por um projétil não identificado a 13 milhas náuticas (24 km) a oeste de Al Jazeera, nos Emirados Árabes Unidos.
“O mercado está preocupado com esses ataques iranianos contínuos a petroleiros, que temos visto aumentar na última semana”, disse Andrew Lipow, presidente da Lipow Oil Associates. “Embora tenha havido um aumento no transporte de petróleo pelo Estreito de Ormuz, isso pode mudar a qualquer momento.”
Os confrontos entre os houthis e uma coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita, que apoia o governo internacionalmente reconhecido do Iêmen, se intensificaram desde que os houthis, alinhados com o Irã, avançaram em direção ao Estreito de Bab el-Mandeb no mês passado, um ponto de estrangulamento marítimo na foz do Mar Vermelho.
Outubro foi o pior mês em termos de ataques à navegação comercial no Estreito de Ormuz e nas vias navegáveis próximas, de acordo com dados compilados por um think tank com sede em Washington que acompanha incidentes de segurança marítima em todo o mundo desde 2017.
O presidente Donald Trump afirmou nesta sexta-feira que os Estados Unidos poderiam encerrar rapidamente a guerra com o Irã, mas acrescentou que talvez Washington devesse permitir que o conflito fosse se acalmando gradualmente.

items.title: Stocks Fall as Oil Rally Keeps a Lid on Treasuries
items.summary: A resurgence in oil prices dragged down stocks and bonds, stoking concerns about inflation just days ahead of the next Fed decision. Brent crude topped $116 as a flare-up in Middle East violence threatened global supply. The S&P 500 saw back-to-back losses, even as selling pressure on tech firms abated. Yields rose after the market’s best day in more than a year. Joe Weisenthal, Bloomberg ‘Odd Lots’ Podcast Co-Host, joins to wrap up the week in markets ahead of the next Fed decision and more tech earnings. Jayati Bharadwaj, Head of FX Strategy at TD Securities, weighs in on a rush to safe haven trades. Plus, Bloomberg News AI Infrastructure Reporter Dina Bass joins to discuss her reporting on Blackstone's bet on chips driving a debt boom. Finally, Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry on internet security in light of new PHP vulnerabilities across the web. (Source: Bloomberg)

" Canada is working very hard to make a deal with us , and I hate to say this, but we have all the cards," Trump told reporters at the White Ho us e.
A spokesperson for Dominic LeBlanc, Canada 's minister responsible for trade with the US , declined to comment.

The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, who have blamed each other for the failed talks. The dispute has spurred Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to urge a further shift away from Canada 's biggest trading partner and cast doubt on the viability of the US -Mexico- Canada Agreement.

items.title: Argentina drops probe into President Milei and sister over meme coin scandal
items.author: Leila Miller
items.creator: Leila Miller
items.summary: A criminal investigation into the role of Argentine President Javier Milei and his sister Karina Milei in a meme coin scandal was dropped on Friday, according to court records.
items.body:
A criminal investigation into the role of Argentine President Javier Milei and his sister Karina Milei in a meme coin scandal was dropped on Friday, according to court records.
Federal judge Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi gave the order after prosecutor Eduardo Taiano asked for the dismissal, according to local outlet La Nacion.
A judge was assigned in February 2025 to investigate Milei's role in promoting a cryptocurrency that crashed. Milei had recommended the little-known crypto coin $LIBRA in a posting on X, kicking off a brief rally. He later deleted the posting and denied having any link to the cryptocurrency, which soon plunged.
The investigation had looked into possible fraud involved in the coin's launch.
At the time of the currency's crash, Milei said he had acted "in good faith" and accused his political rivals of trying to take advantage of the situation.

items.title: CVS is trying out pharmacists in chronic health management
items.author: Caroline Humer
items.creator: Caroline Humer
items.summary: CVS Health Chief Medical Officer Dr. Amy Compton-Phillips on Friday said healthcare affordability and access could potentially improve if pharmacists in its 9,000 retail stores play a bigger role in chronic disease management, helping consumers stay on top of their most important health metrics.
items.body:
CVS Health (CVS.N) Chief Medical Officer Dr. Amy Compton-Phillips on Friday said healthcare affordability and access could potentially improve if pharmacists in its 9,000 retail stores play a bigger role in chronic disease management, helping consumers stay on top of their most important health metrics.
Each year, millions of Americans die from heart attacks, strokes, kidney disease, diabetes and other chronic conditions that can be treated with medical attention and proper medicines, she said.
"We want to make it really easy and convenient for you to know your numbers," she said, adding that the company is experimenting with how pharmacists could become more involved by taking measurements for blood pressure, cholesterol, and blood sugar.
CVS is starting now with a pilot in five stores in Michigan to try out the concept, she said. In the US, the role of pharmacists is determined in part by varying state pharmacy regulations.
CVS Health is one of the largest US healthcare conglomerates, with the Aetna health insurance company, CVS Caremark pharmacy benefit manager and a nationwide network of retail pharmacies under its corporate umbrella.
Compton-Phillips, speaking during the Reuters Total Health conference in Nashville, said the company was also talking to the government's Medicare agency about the role pharmacists could play in expanding access to healthcare and providing lower-cost healthcare.
Affordability of healthcare is a key issue for the Trump administration, which is experimenting with different pilots that could lower costs for the more than 70 million people enrolled in the Medicare program for people aged 65 and older or with disabilities.
One of the pilots involves more access to highly popular GLP-1 medications used to treat obesity, which the government has made available for $50 a month for a limited time [USN:S0N3WX02P TEXT:"through TrumpRx.gov"].
More companies, however, are [USN:L1N44L0V0 TEXT:"cutting corporate coverage"] of the medicines in 2027, recent surveys show, concerned about the increased cost to their health plans for the Eli Lilly (LLY.N) and Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) medicines such as Mounjaro, Zepbound, Ozempic and Wegovy.
Those medicines cost a few hundred dollars on the drugmakers' direct-pay websites, but can be more expensive to employers when they are covered in their insurance plans.
Compton-Phillips said she would like to see better access to the GLP-1 drugs at a lower cost, describing their potential health benefits as "incredible."
"They really do have real benefits in decreasing heart disease and kidney disease," she said.
"I can't wait until 2032," she said. "That's when Ozempic goes generic in the US and I think we are going to be writing prescriptions for it like water."

items.title: Former MLB stars help kids swing for the fences in cricket-mad Mumbai
items.author: Revathi Hariharan
items.creator: Revathi Hariharan
items.summary: When former New York Yankees player Nick Swisher watched a schoolgirl with braided hair smash a series of home runs at a Mumbai playground, he was struck by how readily the cricket-mad youngsters could adapt their skills to baseball.
items.body:
When former New York Yankees player Nick Swisher watched a schoolgirl with braided hair smash a series of home runs at a Mumbai playground, he was struck by how readily the cricket-mad youngsters could adapt their skills to baseball.
The girl was among students at Hansraj Morarji School who swapped their cricket gear for baseball gloves as a parade of MLB greats arrived to put them through a series of drills.
"I am taking these kids back with me, they can really swing the bat," the former Yankees first baseman and outfielder said.
While Swisher ran home-run drills, former Los Angeles Dodgers first baseman Adrian Gonzalez and American softball star Rachel Garcia oversaw batting practice.
Meanwhile, former Chicago Cubs pitcher Jake Arrieta, ex-Boston Red Sox outfielder and World Series champion Jonny Gomes and softball star Jordan Woolery handled pitching and fielding sessions in Mumbai's scorching heat.
Gonzalez, who hit 317 home runs in MLB across a 15-year career, said he was stunned by what he witnessed.
"From how little baseball has been played in India, their skills are advanced," he said.
"I kind of expected it because cricket has so many similarities to baseball: bat-to-ball skills, the ability to catch, especially catching with your hands.
"I really feel like if India devoted time to baseball, you would have some Major League Baseball players in no time."
The clinic showcased grassroots efforts to introduce baseball in a nation where cricket reigns supreme.
GIRLS IMPRESS The former players also unanimously agreed that the girls consistently outperformed the boys, opening up the conversation about the future of women in baseball in India even as Indian women's cricket continues to shine.
"I think the future for women in sports is growing. Hopefully in the next five to 10 years, we're going to be on top," Garcia said.
"I'm excited to see what the future does look like and to keep inspiring young women to keep picking up a bat, ball or just going out there to try and play some sort of sport."
Swisher, who has been watching cricket himself, said the sports complement each other.
"The cricket swing does transfer to the baseball swing," he said.
LOVE FOR THE GAME Ryo Takahashi, director of international business for MLB, remained optimistic about baseball's prospects in India despite the sport's limited presence, insisting that MLB was not competing with cricket.
"I don't think it's fair to put a timeline on anybody for expectations, but I think if you saw what you saw today, the enthusiasm, the athleticism and most of all, just the love for the game, it could be very close," Takahashi said.
"I think if kids play both, they'll be developing both skills in many ways."
The former MLB players are scheduled to join Indian cricketers Suryakumar Yadav, Deepak Chahar, Shardul Thakur and Radha Yadav for 3-on-3 baseball at the MLBx event on Saturday.

items.title: After previous day's slump, trading is quieter among AI shares
items.author: Caroline Valetkevitch
items.creator: Caroline Valetkevitch
items.summary: Big AI stocks were mixed on Friday, a day after the biggest decline in the Nasdaq Composite Index in four months, giving investors a welcome respite as they look forward to more information on Anthropic's forthcoming IPO and a further wave of earnings over the next week.
items.body:
Big AI stocks were mixed on Friday, a day after the biggest decline in the Nasdaq Composite Index in four months, giving investors a welcome respite as they look forward to more information on Anthropic's forthcoming IPO and a further wave of earnings over the next week.
Meta Platforms (META.O) , the center of Thursday's storm, was fractionally lower following [USN:L6N4690SJ TEXT:"Thursday's 7% decline"]. The operator of social media networks and major AI investor said in its earnings report this week that it would create a new class of shares in part to raise money for further capital spending, which was taken as evidence that the next leg of the AI buildout will be costly for shareholders.
Other major AI players were mixed on Friday, with SpaceX (SPCX.O) , Oracle (ORCL.N) and Dell Technologies (DELL.N) up 1% to 2% and Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) down less than 1%. Big semiconductor stocks were mostly higher after their largest decline since the summer on Thursday.
Credit default swaps tracking the perceived risk of default at the biggest AI players were mostly modestly lower, with Meta's five-year CDS spread trading 0.3% narrower at 123, according to LSEG data. The swaps enable investors to bet on a default using contracts typically with terms of five or 10 years, though contracts frequently change hands for the purposes of hedging positions and betting on near-term market moves.
Thursday's deluge and the day-after calm is the latest sign of indirection in a market that has hovered near record highs without breaking out, said Rick Meckler, partner at Cherry Lane Investments, a family investment office in New Vernon, New Jersey.
"To some extent, we're seeing the market tread water over a longer period of time because every sell-off has been met by buyers and every point upward has been met by sellers," Meckler said.
The Nasdaq (.IXIC) was barely changed on Friday afternoon.
Credit-default swap premiums, reflecting the annual cost borne by the swap purchaser in thousands of dollars, have risen over the past year with concern about the risks being taken on by large AI spenders. The [USN:l4n4681e6 TEXT:"premiums rose"] on Thursday after Meta's decision to sell more stock, as much of the buildout to date has been financed through debt issuance.
The concerns around AI spending and investment returns have added to the market's volatility since Treasury yields rose sharply in August, which changed the economics of investing and bond issuance, given the increasing attractiveness of a higher risk-free rate.
It's been "a very volatile week," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth in Boston. "There's no doubt at some point in time that the higher inflation moves, especially if driven by unsustainably higher energy prices ... would have to show up in corporate earnings. It hasn't yet, but that's the concern. And market participants are trying to position for that."
Shares of neoclouds, smaller companies tied to AI data centers and other infrastructure projects like CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , have dropped due to anxiety over their future. Their performance of late has also raised talk on Wall Street that capital is growing scarce - which stands to raise costs further and potentially raise funding issues down the road.
Even so, many investors remain positive on the sector, where giant AI lab Anthropic is expected to publish its IPO prospectus in coming days and Alphabet, Amazon (AMZN.O) and Microsoft (MSFT.O) are expected to report earnings next week.
"In general, AI news in terms of revenues continues to be very strong, it's just at what cost and how long that growth is sustainable," Meckler said. "We really haven't gotten to the point of the market sort of focusing on winners and losers. It's been one big sector trade every day."

It's been "a very volatile week," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth in Boston. "There's no doubt at some point in time that the higher inflation moves, especially if driven by unsustainably higher energy prices ... would have to show up in corporate earnings. It hasn't yet, but that's the concern. And market participants are trying to position for that."
Shares of neoclouds, smaller companies tied to AI data centers and other infrastructure projects like CoreWeave, have dropped due to anxiety over their future. Their performance of late has also raised talk on Wall Street that capital is growing scarce - which stands to raise costs further and potentially raise funding issues down the road.
Even so, many investors remain positive on the sector, where giant AI lab Anthropic is expected to publish its IPO prospectus in coming days and Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft are expected to report earnings next week.
"In general, AI news in terms of revenues continues to be very strong, it's just at what cost and how long that growth is sustainable," Meckler said. "We really haven't gotten to the point of the market sort of focusing on winners and losers. It's been one big sector trade every day."

Credit default swaps tracking the perceived risk of default at the biggest AI players were mostly modestly lower, with Meta's five-year CDS spread trading 0.3 per cent narrower at 123, according to LSEG data. The swaps enable investors to bet on a default using contracts typically with terms of five or 10 years, though contracts frequently change hands for the purposes of hedging positions and betting on near-term market moves.

items.title: Leclerc marca el mejor tiempo para Ferrari en la primera sesión de pruebas del GP de EEUU
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, marcó el mejor tiempo en la primera sesión de pruebas del Gran Premio de Estados Unidos, celebrada el viernes en el Circuito de las Américas de Austin, mientras que el líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, apenas quedó quinto.
items.body:
Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, marcó el mejor tiempo en la primera sesión de pruebas del Gran Premio de Estados Unidos, celebrada el viernes en el Circuito de las Américas de Austin, mientras que el líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, apenas quedó quinto.
El piloto nacido en Mónaco marcó la referencia con su monoplaza mejorado, con un tiempo de un minuto y 36,052 segundos, 0,084 más rápido que Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, que ha ganado las dos últimas carreras en Singapur y Malasia y que también se impuso en Austin el año pasado.
Leclerc —cuyo monoplaza presenta modificaciones en el suelo, los pontones y el difusor— ganó en el circuito situado a las afueras de Austin en 2024.
El vigente campeón de McLaren, Lando Norris, fue el tercero más rápido, a 0,245 del mejor tiempo, mientras que los Mercedes de George Russell y Antonelli fueron 0,326 y 0,481 más lentos que Leclerc, respectivamente.
Antonelli, de 20 años, puede convertirse en el campeón de Fórmula 1 más joven de la historia si gana la carrera del domingo y los resultados le son favorables. De lo contrario, el italiano tendrá que esperar al menos hasta México, el fin de semana siguiente.
Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, fue sexto en la tabla de tiempos, por delante de Oscar Piastri, de McLaren; Gabriel Bortoleto, de Audi; y la pareja de Racing Bulls formada por Arvid Lindblad y Liam Lawson.
Tanto Lindblad como Bortoleto sufrirán penalizaciones en la parrilla de salida de la carrera del domingo tras cambiar componentes de la unidad de potencia.
El circuito ha sido objeto de críticas por parte de algunos pilotos debido a lo accidentado que se ha vuelto.
"Probablemente sea el circuito más bacheado que hemos tenido en lo que va de año. Es complicado, pero estoy seguro de que sabremos adaptarnos", declaró Pierre Gasly, de Alpine, a la cadena Sky Sports.
Su compañero de equipo argentino, Franco Colapinto, sufrirá un retroceso de 10 puestos en la parrilla tras haber instalado una nueva unidad electrónica de control.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは仏情勢が重し　来週の中銀会合に注目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。

ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。

ユーロは対円でより大きく下落し、一時１７５．０８円と、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を更新。週初からは約１．１％下落した。

フランスでは１７日の抗議デモが過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展してから１週間が経過し、ヌニェス内相は暴力行為や略奪の再発防止に向け、２４日に全国で予定される抗議活動に７万人の警察官を動員すると発表。パリのルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座などの主要文化施設の一部が臨時休館となるほか、治安上の懸念からパリで予定されているサッカーフランス１部リーグの試合が２５日から２６日に延期されるなどの影響が出ている。

バノックバーン・グローバル・フォレックスの主席市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「マクロン政権は社会不安の鎮静化に向けて軍の投入も辞さない姿勢を示しているが、週末にかけて抗議活動が一段と活発化する可能性が高い」と指摘。「欧州債券市場への圧力はこの日は幾分和らいだが、２３日に予定されているムーディーズによるフランス国債格付けの見直しが注目されている」と述べた。

終盤の取引で、主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％高の１０１．８２。

ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、前日の株式相場急落を受け、１２月の会合での利上げ観測がやや後退したことがＬＳＥＧのデータで示された。ただ、ＦＦ金利先物市場では１２月利上げの確率はなお８１％と見込まれている。

ＥＣＢについては、１２月の理事会で利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁が９月下旬にインフレに対し穏健な政策対応が適切との認識を示していることから、今後の金利見通しについて新たな示唆があるか注目されている。

日銀については、１２月の利上げの確率が６１％と織り込まれている。

items.title: Infantino allana el camino para lograr su cuarto mandato en la FIFA
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: Las perspectivas de reelección del presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, se reforzaron después de que el máximo responsable del fútbol asiático respaldara su candidatura para un cuarto mandato, lo que dejó a Europa cada vez más aislada y puso de manifiesto la falta de un rival creíble.
items.body:
Las perspectivas de reelección del presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, se reforzaron después de que el máximo responsable del fútbol asiático respaldara su candidatura para un cuarto mandato, lo que dejó a Europa cada vez más aislada y puso de manifiesto la falta de un rival creíble.
El apoyo del presidente de la Confederación Asiática de Fútbol, el jeque Salman bin Ibrahim Al Jalifa, expresado el viernes en el congreso extraordinario de la AFC celebrado en Tokio, supuso una notable reconciliación con Infantino.
El jeque Salman se había sumado al presidente de la UEFA, Aleksander Ceferin, y al presidente de la CONCACAF, Víctor Montagliani, en las críticas a la propuesta "FIFA Forward Enterprise" (FFE), que buscaba inversión privada para una nueva entidad que controlara los derechos comerciales vinculados a las principales competiciones de la FIFA, incluida la Copa Mundial.
Su oposición pública, seguida de llamamientos a la dimisión de Infantino, suscitó dudas sobre si la hasta entonces sólida base de apoyo del presidente de la FIFA estaba empezando a resquebrajarse.
Sin embargo, el jeque Salman dijo ante el congreso de la AFC que Asia se mantenía unida en apoyo a Infantino, dos meses después de que la confederación le acusara de una "violación fundamental de la confianza" en relación con la iniciativa FFE. El giro redujo las posibilidades de cualquier rival de cara a las elecciones de marzo.
Asia cuenta con 47 federaciones, aunque solo 46 son miembros de la FIFA con derecho a voto en las elecciones presidenciales. Cada federación nacional dispone de un voto en las elecciones de la FIFA, independientemente del tamaño del país o de su trayectoria futbolística.
Infantino ya se había asegurado el apoyo de la confederación africana, compuesta por 54 miembros, con la que ha mantenido sólidas relaciones durante su presidencia.
La CONMEBOL de Sudamérica solo cuenta con 10 votos, pero no se sumó a las peticiones de dimisión, y se espera que la mayoría de las federaciones de Oceanía también se mantengan de su lado.
La CONCACAF se había sumado inicialmente a la UEFA y a la AFC en las críticas a Infantino, pero sus federaciones miembro están ahora divididas, y miembros influyentes, como México, respaldan al actual presidente.
El respaldo de las confederaciones no es formalmente vinculante para las asociaciones individuales, pero el apoyo con el que cuenta Infantino en Asia, África y otras regiones le otorga una posición dominante entre los 211 miembros con derecho a voto de la FIFA antes de que se cierre el plazo de presentación de candidaturas el 18 de noviembre.

items.title: Lawyers gird for congressional probes if Democrats take control
items.author: David Thomas, Sara Merken
items.creator: David Thomas, Sara Merken
items.summary: (Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com)
items.body:
(Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com )
A Democratic takeover of at least one chamber of Congress following next month's midterm elections could be a boon to law firms angling for roles in a potential surge of congressional investigations.
Several lawyers and lobbyists in Washington said they're communicating with current and potential clients in anticipation of a spate of new probes on Capitol Hill if Democrats tip the balance. Reuters [USN:L1N4600WS TEXT:"has reported"] that Democrats are widely expected to win control of the House, though the Senate is too close to call.
Anyone ignoring inquiries from Democratic lawmakers risks the chance they could have subpoena power in the next Congress, said Brian Pomper, who co-leads Akin Gump's lobbying and public policy practice.
"They should really be preparing now," Pomper said.
After two years in the minority during Republican President Donald Trump's first term, newly-empowered Democrats could scrutinize [USN:L6N45E0PR TEXT:"a range of targets"], from administration figures to corporate donors and participants in business deals brokered by the Trump family. Unlike the White House, private companies cannot claim that their activities are protected by executive privilege.
Democrats are "telegraphing that they’re going to go towards companies for information" because the administration will not cooperate, said Susanne Sachsman Grooms, the leader of Cooley's congressional investigations practice.
Grooms said she is planning to meet with a small group of clients at private dinners in New York and San Francisco after the election to discuss the results and their implications.
US law firm Brownstein Hyatt launched a website to track investigative activity, said Will Moschella, who co-chairs the firm's government relations department, and posted hundreds of letters Democratic lawmakers in the US House and Senate have sent since last year that could augur future probes.
Lawyers at several firms said they expanded their congressional investigations practices over the past year, while others are still hiring.
In March, Akin Gump [USN:L6N40C15X TEXT:"hired Marcus Childress"], a former senior adviser to US Representative Jamie Raskin, the ranking member of the House Judiciary Committee and a Democrat. Last month, Cooley brought Jessica Donlon, who has served as general counsel to Republican US Representatives Brett Guthrie and James Comer.
Aaron Cutler, who leads Hogan Lovells Cadwalader's government relations practice, said he has been given a mandate to hire more people.
"We've been busy all year," Cutler said. "We're expecting to be busier next year."
LOBBYING REVENUES ON THE RISE – AGAIN Several firms reported record-setting US lobbying revenues once again in the third quarter, as lobbyists also look ahead to the post-election landscape.
Florida-founded lobbying firm Ballard Partners said it brought in $35.01 million in its best-ever quarter, 39.6% more than the same time period last year. The firm, which previously employed former US Attorney General Pam Bondi, has seen massive revenue growth since President Donald Trump took office last year.
Law firms Brownstein Hyatt, Akin Gump and Squire Patton Boggs reported federal lobbying revenues of $22.5 million, $18.85 million and $7.9 million, respectively, while lobbying firms BGR Group and Cornerstone Government Affairs reported $22.5 million and $15.6 million. Representatives from those five firms said these are new quarterly records.
Akin Gump said lobbying on trade and tariff issues was a major driver, while Brownstein Hyatt cited a range of areas including healthcare and tax.
Lobbyists are required to report quarterly revenue under the federal Lobbying Disclosure Act.
Not every firm saw an increase. Hogan Lovells Cadwalader said its federal lobbying revenue in the third quarter dropped to $2.97 million from $3.7 million in the prior quarter. K&L Gates reported a quarterly decline from $5.5 million to $4.8 million.
Aaron Cutler, the leader of Hogan Lovells Cadwalader's government relations practice, said in a statement the firm has "continued to see an increase in non-LDA work," including congressional investigations and its work for foreign clients like Venezuela.
Karishma Shah Page, who co-leads K&L Gates' public policy and law practice, said in an email that there was heavy preparation underway ahead of the election, and that she expects both the end of the year and the next congressional session to be busy. She noted that the third quarter tends to be slower prior to a midterm election, and that Congress spent limited time in session in July and September.
Federal lobbying spending has continually increased since 2016, surpassing $5 billion last year, according to nonprofit research group OpenSecrets. As of July 23, companies, trade groups and other entities have spent $2.74 billion this year, per OpenSecrets.
COOLEY MATCHES MILBANK SALARY SCALE Cooley will raise salaries for its US associates in January, aligning with the associate compensation scale that rival firm Milbank rolled out earlier this year.
Associates at Palo Alto-founded Cooley will have base salaries ranging from $235,000 to $455,000, depending on seniority, according to an internal Cooley memo published by the website Above the Law. The firm will also hand out “special” bonuses for the year to eligible associates, the memo said, without specifying the amounts.
Large US firms have largely stayed quiet since Milbank announced [USN:L6N42A13E TEXT:"salary increases"] in June, though McDermott, Will & Schulte was among a handful of firms that matched the new scale. Milbank, which in recent years has been a first mover among large firms on associate compensation, also rolled out so-called [USN:L6N43T126 TEXT:"special bonuses"] of up to $25,000 in July.

items.title: ¿Vale la pena el iPhone Duo? Esto dicen los expertos sobre el primer teléfono plegable de Apple
items.author: Isaac Garrido
items.summary: El nuevo teléfono enfrenta retos técnicos como su pantalla exterior, la ausencia de FaceID y una cámara sin zoom óptico.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El nuevo iPhone Duo, el primer teléfono plegable de Apple ( AAPL ), finalmente salió a la venta este viernes y provocó tal expectativa que algunos aficionados acamparon afuera de una Apple Store en México para ser de los primeros en conseguirlo. No importó que su versión más cara tuviera un precio de MXN$77.999, unos US$4.178. ¿Pero realmente vale la pena el nuevo dispositivo? Los especialistas y periodistas especializados comenzaron a responder y destacaron que si bien el teléfono tiene algunos aciertos, enfrenta también varias deficiencias técnicas y de diseño. Nilay Patel, de The Verge , señaló que es “caro”, pero “divertido”. “El iPhone Duo es uno de los productos de primera generación más problemáticos de Apple en mucho tiempo”, reseñó el periodista, quien destacó que el teléfono entusiasmará a los aficionados, “pero probablemente frustrará a todos los demás”. Aunque el dispositivo llega a un segmento que otros competidores como Samsung ya dominan desde hace años, el periodista de Wired Julian Chokkattu le dio una calificación de 7/10. Resaltó que el iPhone Duo tiene un hardware refinado y que su acabado nanotexturizado logra dar la vuelta uno de los mayores problemas de los plegables: disimular el pliegue de la bisagra. Chokkatu subrayó que el dispositivo facilita la multitarea y “ofrece una autonomía confiable”. Sin embargo, es pesado y muchas de las aplicaciones no están optimizadas al formato del teléfono, según él. Las dos pantallas con las que cuenta el teléfono se convierten en las absolutas protagonistas. Especialistas coincidieron en que esto dota de una versatilidad al teléfono, que pasa de un celular a una minitableta. “Si compras un Duo, no necesitas un iPad”, dijo Caitlin McGarry, del New York Times , quien probó el teléfono por una semana. Xataka aseguró que el marco de titanio y cristal del teléfono hacen que pueda “ser el plegable más resistente en el mercado”, pues cuenta con clasificación IP68 completa contra agua y polvo. Además, aplaudió su compatibilidad con accesorios y soportes MagSafe. Una de los grandes sacrificios del diseño del iPhone Duo es el Face ID, el sistema de reconocimiento facial de Apple que permite desbloquear un iPhone o iPad con solo mirar la pantalla. En su lugar, el teléfono retoma el Touch ID de generaciones atrás. “Requiere un periodo de adaptación después de años de depender de Face ID, sobre todo cuando sostienes el Duo con la mano izquierda y de pronto tienes que autenticar una aplicación o una compra con la derecha”, sostuvo el periodista de Wired. En una prueba, el creador de contenido especializado en tecnología Soy Mau Lozano cargó un iPhone Duo completamente vació en una hora con 27 minutos, según un video en su cuenta de instagram. Xataka incluso sentenció que “los compromisos en las cámaras y la batería sugieren que la mayoría de los usuarios comunes deberían esperar a futuras versiones más refinadas”.

items.title: Zelenski dice negociadores ucranianos, rusos y estadounidenses se reunirán en Abu Dabi
items.author: Andrea Shalal, Olena Harmash
items.creator: Andrea Shalal, Olena Harmash
items.summary: El presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, declaró el viernes que los negociadores de paz de Ucrania, Rusia y Estados Unidos habían acordado reunirse a nivel técnico durante la primera quincena de noviembre en Abu Dabi, y añadió que esperaba que a ello le siguiera una reunión entre los líderes de estos países.
items.body:
El presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, declaró el viernes que los negociadores de paz de Ucrania, Rusia y Estados Unidos habían acordado reunirse a nivel técnico durante la primera quincena de noviembre en Abu Dabi, y añadió que esperaba que a ello le siguiera una reunión entre los líderes de estos países.
Zelenski afirmó que había hablado el viernes con los enviados estadounidenses Jared Kushner y Steve Witkoff tras la reunión que estos mantuvieron con el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, a principios de esta semana.
Señaló que cualquier acuerdo de paz necesitaría sólidas garantías de seguridad para Ucrania y financiación durante diez años para mantener el ejército ucraniano.
"El plan es reunirnos en la primera quincena de noviembre y, por supuesto, lo antes posible", declaró Zelenski al centro de estudios Hudson Institute a través de una videoconferencia. Señaló que mucho dependería de Rusia, y destacó que una reunión similar prevista para este mes no se había materializado.
Zelenski subrayó la importancia de proseguir con los esfuerzos diplomáticos para alcanzar un alto el fuego y poner fin a la guerra, que ya cumple su quinto año, y añadió que Europa también debería participar en las negociaciones.
El presidente ucraniano señaló que era fundamental que las conversaciones técnicas fueran seguidas de una reunión entre los líderes de estos países.
Manifestó su esperanza de celebrar otra reunión con los negociadores estadounidenses y añadió que Ucrania estaba dispuesta a iniciar negociaciones sobre un alto el fuego total, o incluso un acuerdo que abarcara únicamente el sector energético o las operaciones marítimas, si Moscú no estuviera dispuesta a debatir un acuerdo más amplio.
La Casa Blanca no hizo ningún comentario inmediato sobre los planes de celebrar una reunión trilateral a nivel técnico.

items.title: Novartis presenta datos sobre fármaco para esclerosis múltiple peores de lo esperado
items.author: Bhanvi Satija, Marleen Kaesebier
items.creator: Bhanvi Satija, Marleen Kaesebier
items.summary: El fármaco oral remibrutinib para la esclerosis múltiple (EM) de la farmacéutica suiza Novartis redujo significativamente las recaídas en los pacientes, según los datos presentados el viernes en un congreso médico celebrado en Toronto, pero menos de lo que esperaban los analistas.
items.body:
El fármaco oral remibrutinib para la esclerosis múltiple (EM) de la farmacéutica suiza Novartis (NOVN.S) redujo significativamente las recaídas en los pacientes, según los datos presentados el viernes en un congreso médico celebrado en Toronto, pero menos de lo que esperaban los analistas.
El fármaco redujo las tasas de recaída anualizadas en un 35,2% y un 31,2%, en comparación con la teriflunomida, un tratamiento más antiguo para la EM comercializado por Sanofi bajo la marca Aubagio. Los analistas esperaban una reducción de entre el 45% y el 60%.
Los resultados detallados del ensayo, que anteriormente solo se habían dado a conocer de forma resumida, se presentaron [USN:L6N4670V1 TEXT:"días después de que Roche"] (ROPC.S) publicara sus propios datos sobre el fármaco rival para la EM, el fenebrutinib. En los datos agrupados de la fase III, Roche informó de una reducción del 55% en la tasa de recaídas anualizada frente a la teriflunomida.
"En definitiva, podrían ser bastante similares en lo que hacen en cuanto a la reducción de las recaídas y la discapacidad", dijo Heinz Wiendl, copresidente de los estudios de Novartis, en una entrevista.
Antes de la publicación de los resultados, los analistas señalaron que se necesitarían mejoras en las recidivas similares a las observadas en el ensayo de Roche para demostrar que esta clase de tratamientos es mejor que las terapias anti-CD20 que se utilizan actualmente. Entre estas se incluyen Ocrevus, Kesimpta de Novartis y Briumvi de TG Therapeutics (TGTX.O) , que se dirigen a las células inmunitarias que provocan la EM y las destruyen.
Novartis confía en el éxito del fármaco en diferentes áreas terapéuticas, especialmente tras una serie de reveses recientes en los ensayos de su fármaco para el corazón, pelacarsen, y de su tratamiento para la debilidad muscular, del-desiran.
Los analistas estiman actualmente que el remibrutinib podría alcanzar unas ventas máximas de más de 4.000 millones de dólares, si se aprueba para pacientes con formas recidivantes de EM.
Los dos fármacos competidores para la EM pertenecen a una clase de tratamientos que anteriormente se relacionaban con toxicidad hepática, lo que hace que la seguridad sea un aspecto que se sigue muy de cerca.
Aunque el fenebrutinib de Roche podría tener una ventaja en términos de eficacia, mostró elevaciones significativamente mayores de las enzimas hepáticas en comparación con el fármaco de referencia. Novartis dijo que no se observaron señales de seguridad hepática en su fármaco.

items.title: Plantio de soja em Mato Grosso segue adiantado, com 75,81% das áreas semeadas, diz Imea
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O plantio de soja em Mato Grosso, principal produtor brasileiro, atingiu 75,81% da área projetada para o Estado até esta sexta-feira, um salto de 23,95 pontos percentuais em relação à semana anterior, de acordo com dados publicados pelo Instituto Mato-grossense de Economia Agropecuária (Imea).
items.body:
O plantio de soja em Mato Grosso, principal produtor brasileiro, atingiu 75,81% da área projetada para o Estado até esta sexta-feira, um salto de 23,95 pontos percentuais em relação à semana anterior, de acordo com dados publicados pelo Instituto Mato-grossense de Economia Agropecuária (Imea).
O índice indica um ritmo mais acelerado em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado (60,05%) e na comparação com a média de cinco anos para a época (64,31%), segundo dados do instituto ligado aos produtores.
O plantio se acelerou em outubro, com uma melhora nas chuvas, após um ritmo considerado abaixo do ideal em setembro.
Se o ritmo atual for mantido, o Mato Grosso deverá superar 80% da área semeada na última semana de outubro, o que amplia a perspectiva de que a maior parte da área de milho de segunda safra seja implantada dentro da janela ideal, segundo avaliação do Imea divulgada em nota da Federação da Agricultura e Pecuária de Mato Grosso.
Quase todo o milho semeado em Mato Grosso vem da segunda safra, após a colheita da soja. Se o cereal é implantado dentro da melhor janela climática, os riscos diminuem.

items.title: Canadian dollar hits five-week high as data supports rate hike bets
items.author: Fergal Smith
items.creator: Fergal Smith
items.summary: The Canadian dollar strengthened to a five-week high against its US counterpart on Friday as oil prices rose and domestic retail sales data supported expectations the Bank of Canada would raise interest rates next week.
items.body:
The Canadian dollar strengthened to a five-week high against its US counterpart on Friday as oil prices rose and domestic retail sales data supported expectations the Bank of Canada would raise interest rates next week.
The loonie was trading 0.1% higher at 1.40 per US dollar, or 71.43 US cents, after touching its strongest intraday level since September 16 at 1.3969.
It left the currency on track for a seventh straight day of gains, which would be the longest daily winning streak since March 2022.
For the week, the currency was up 1% — heading for its biggest weekly advance since April.
[USN:L6N4690T5 TEXT:"Canadian retail sales"] rose 1.2% in August from July, led by higher sales at motor vehicle and parts dealers, while a preliminary estimate showed sales increasing by 0.7% in September.
"Given the resilience in these spending numbers, we still believe the Bank of Canada is headed for a rate increase next week," Oskar Stone, an analyst at Desjardins, said in a note, adding that the data points to third-quarter GDP growth of 2%.
The Bank of Canada will raise its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on October 28 and follow with one more hike by the end of March to pre-empt any further rise in inflation expectations, according to a majority of economists [USN:L6N4690GZ TEXT:"polled by Reuters"].
Investors see a roughly 80% chance the BoC hikes next week. Bets on a hike have increased in recent days after hawkish comments from [USN:L6N463037 TEXT:"Governor Tiff Macklem"] and as [USN:L6N4651AT TEXT:"Alberta"] voted by a large majority to remain part of Canada.
The price of oil, one of Canada's major exports, rose after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concern over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East. US crude oil futures settled 3.8% higher at $103.27 a barrel.
Canadian bond yields rose across the curve, tracking moves in US Treasuries. The 10-year was up 5.1 basis points at 3.838%.

Oct 23 : US-based Indycar will race in Europe for the first time in 20 years with a July 2027 round at Barcelona's Circuit de Catalunya in a multi-year deal announced on Friday.
The race will be a return home for Spain's five-time Indycar champion Alex Palou, who was born near Barcelona.

items.title: Qué porcentaje de votos necesitan Bolsonaro y Lula para ganar la segunda vuelta este 2026
items.author: Redacción Bloomberg Línea
items.summary: El gigante sudamericano definirá este domingo quién manejará los destinos del país durante los próximos cuatro años. El ganador asumirá su cargo el 5 de enero de 2027 y gobernará hasta 2031.
items.body: Este domingo 25 de octubre, los ciudadanos brasileños definirán quién será el próximo presidente del país en los próximos cuatro años. Se trata de una elección sumamente polarizada entre el actual presidente, de izquierda, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (80 años), y el derechista Flávio Bolsonaro (de 45 años), quien es hijo del exmandatario Jair Bolsonaro. VER MÁS: “Brasil está siendo colonizado digitalmente”, dice exejecutivo de Microsoft, Google y Meta En la primera vuelta, Bolsonaro dio la sorpresa y se quedó con el 47,03% de los votos válidos (en total, sufragaron por él 56.104.503 personas). En tanto, Lula quedó en el segundo lugar con 53.879.538 votos, es decir, un 45,16% de los sufragios válidos. Horas después de la elección, los analistas coincidían en que Flávio prácticamente tenía asegurado el triunfo. Sin embargo, en las últimas horas, las encuestas publicadas muestran una paridad casi total, con el candidato derechista aventajando a su rival por decimales que se encuentran dentro del margen de error. Llegará a la Presidencia de Brasil quien obtenga el 50% + 1 de los votos válidos. Lula apunta a conquistar a buena parte de ese 21,08% del padrón que no fue a votar en la primera vuelta. En tanto, Bolsonaro intentará mantener la distancia y sumar a los candidatos que quedaron afuera del balotaje, la mayoría de ellos de centroderecha y derecha. VER MÁS: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro empatan con el 50% de los votos en encuesta a días de la segunda vuelta en Brasil “Estas elecciones serán un punto de inflexión para Brasil”, aseguró Lula en las últimas horas. Y continuó: “Es hora de transformar esta esperanza y movilización de las calles en mayor participación y compromisos”. En tanto, Bolsonaro se refirió a los rumores que indicaban que recortaría el programa Bolsa, que asiste a familias de menores recursos. Y aseguró: “¡El Bolsa Familia no va a terminar! La izquierda está difundiendo más mentiras. Nosotros tenemos la verdad de nuestro lado". Quien resulte ganador el domingo asumirá la Presidencia de Brasil el martes 5 de enero de 2027 y manejará el destino de la principal potencia económica de la región durante los siguientes cuatro años.

items.title: Leclerc laps fastest for Ferrari in first US GP practice
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Ferrari's Charles Leclerc lapped fastest in first practice for the US Grand Prix at Austin's Circuit of the Americas on Friday with Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli only fifth.
items.body:
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc lapped fastest in first practice for the US Grand Prix at Austin's Circuit of the Americas on Friday with Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli only fifth.
The Monaco-born driver set the standard in his upgraded car with a time of one minute 36.052 seconds, 0.084 faster than Red Bull's Max Verstappen, who has won the previous two races in Singapore and Malaysia and was also triumphant in Austin last year.
Leclerc -- whose car has changes to the floor, sidepod and diffuser -- won at the circuit outside Austin in 2024.
McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris was third fastest, 0.245 off the pace, with the Mercedes of George Russell and Antonelli 0.326 and 0.481 slower than Leclerc respectively.
Antonelli, 20, can become the youngest ever Formula One champion if he wins Sunday's race and results go his way. Otherwise the Italian will have to wait until at least Mexico the weekend after.
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton was sixth on the timesheets ahead of McLaren's Oscar Piastri, Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Racing Bulls pair Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson.
Lindblad and Bortoleto are both set to take grid penalties for Sunday's race after power unit component changes.
The track has drawn [USN:L6N469119 TEXT:"criticism from some drivers"] for how bumpy it has become.
"Probably the bumpiest track we've had so far this year. It's tricky but I'm sure we'll work around it," Alpine's Pierre Gasly told Sky Sports television.
His Argentine teammate Franco Colapinto will have a 10-place grid drop after a new control electronics unit was fitted.

items.title: US Justice Dept sues to block possible Alaska election of Democrat to Senate
items.author: Jan Wolfe
items.creator: Jan Wolfe
items.summary: Control of the US Senate could come down to Alaska, where incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan is running a closely contested race against Democrat Mary Peltola.
items.body:
The US Justice Department on Thursday sued to preemptively block Alaska from certifying the results of its US Senate race if the Republican incumbent candidate loses by a narrow margin, saying voters could be confused because two Republicans on the ballot have almost identical names.
The lawsuit signals the willingness of President Donald Trump's administration to contest the results of the November 3 midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.
Trump's administration has taken an increasingly aggressive approach to election oversight, pressing states for voter-registration data and arguing that stricter measures are needed to ensure public confidence in the vote. Critics, including both Democratic and some Republican election officials, view the moves as federal overreach.
Control of the US Senate could come down to Alaska, where incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan is running a closely contested race against Democrat Mary Peltola.
The Justice Department's lawsuit , filed in federal court in Anchorage, takes issue with the presence of a third contender in the race, another Republican named Dan J. Sullivan Jr, alleging he is running "with the intention of misleading supporters of Senator Sullivan into voting for him."
The lawsuit asks a federal judge to block the certification of an outcome "that may be impacted by voter confusion," so that there can be "an investigation to determine whether votes cast for Daniel J. Sullivan were meant to be cast for Senator Sullivan."
Trump told reporters on Friday that he supported the lawsuit, saying "I'm the one that said do it."
A Justice Department spokesperson said in a statement that the agency is taking "necessary steps to ensure that this frivolous candidacy does not undermine the integrity of Alaska’s election or the will of its voters.”
Election officials around the country have told Reuters they are preparing for potential federal interference in November’s elections, including legal challenges and disputes over voting that could disrupt certification of the results.
Trump has a long history of challenging election outcomes and encouraging supporters to contest results he views as unfavorable.
Election law experts said the Justice Department's lawsuit has no merit and seeks relief not allowed under federal law.
"In short, like many Department letters over the last few years, it is designed to win the press release rather than the litigation," wrote Notre Dame law professor Derek Muller in a blog post , adding that "the legal argument is one of the worst ones I’ve ever seen."
Trump's administration "has absolutely no authority to tell Alaska when or how to certify the results of its Senate election," said David Becker of the Center for Election Innovation and Research, a nonpartisan group that advises election officials, adding that "this issue has already been fully litigated by Alaska's courts."
The unelected Sullivan, a former US Forest Service worker and elementary school teacher, filed to run as a candidate on May 29 seeking to unseat Senator Dan S. Sullivan and "put Alaska first," according to his campaign website, which advertised "Dan Sullivan Challenges Dan Sullivan for US Senate Seat."
Dan J. Sullivan has denied in interviews with US news outlets that his aim is to cause confusion or divert votes from Dan S. Sullivan.
The Alaska Supreme Court in June permitted the unelected Sullivan to appear on the ballot. He will appear without a party designation next to his name, while the senator will be listed as the Republican incumbent.
Trump's [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"approval rating"] has fallen to a record low, hit by rising diesel and gasoline prices and a conflict in the Middle East that has proven deeply unpopular with voters.
Public opinion polls suggest Republicans may lose control of one or both houses of Congress, which would likely limit Trump's ability to enact his policies in the final two years of his presidency.

items.title: Sem Parar Corpay impulsa su negocio con una “Fábrica de IA” propia
items.summary: Nueva propuesta de Bajada: Sem Parar Corpay desarrolló, junto con Dell Technologies y NVIDIA, una infraestructura propia de inteligencia artificial que le permite ejecutar distintas aplicaciones sobre ...
items.body: Incorporar inteligencia artificial a las operaciones es cada vez más relevante para las empresas que procesan grandes volúmenes de datos. El desafío está en hacerlo de manera eficiente, con control de costos y capacidad de expansión. Ante esta situación, Sem Parar Corpay, un ecosistema de soluciones de movilidad, medios de pago y beneficios corporativos, decidió dar un paso adelante en la forma en que opera la inteligencia artificial y sus modelos de lenguaje. En lugar de tratar cada aplicación como un servicio aislado, contratado y cobrado por uso, la empresa decidió crear una nueva alternativa con su propia “fábrica de IA”: una infraestructura dedicada sobre la que ya ha desarrollado una cartera diversificada de soluciones basadas en grandes modelos de lenguaje (LLM) de código abierto. Hoy en día, la fábrica ya mantiene en producción aplicaciones como “Meu RH”, un agente que atiende a los empleados de la empresa y está integrado a Microsoft Teams; “Super Carol”, una asistente virtual para los clientes de Sem Parar en WhatsApp; el “Copiloto de Atención”, que ayuda a los operadores del centro de atención al cliente a ser más eficaces; y el “Robot de Recuperación de Ventas”, que recupera pedidos en línea interrumpidos por errores de registro. Cada nueva aplicación que ingresa a la fábrica utiliza la misma capacidad instalada, lo que aumenta el retorno de la inversión. La “Fábrica de IA” nació para responder a una necesidad concreta: procesar y analizar grandes volúmenes de llamadas del centro de atención al cliente. Para ello, Sem Parar Corpay desarrolló una solución basada en IA que convierte miles de mensajes de texto y las grabaciones de voz en datos facilitando el análisis de las conversaciones, permitiendo identificar patrones relacionados con la conversión de ventas, las cancelaciones y el desempeño del servicio. Con base en el dimensionamiento del proyecto inicial, el procesamiento alcanza tiempos de respuesta inferiores a medio segundo, y la demanda relacionada con el procesamiento de mensajes consume solo alrededor de dos horas de la capacidad diaria disponible. Para ello, la empresa creó una infraestructura propia de IA, desarrollada en colaboración con Dell Technologies, con tecnología de NVIDIA en la asignación de la infraestructura de TI. De una aplicación específica a una «fábrica de IA» Todo comenzó con un reto concreto: ¿cómo procesar y analizar grandes volúmenes de llamadas del centro de atención al cliente con agilidad, seguridad y costos predecibles? La respuesta incluyó servidores Dell PowerEdge equipados con cuatro GPU NVIDIA H200 , almacenamiento Dell PowerScale y la plataforma de software NVIDIA AI Enterprise , que actúa como una capa de software empresarial para hacer posible y acelerar el procesamiento de voz de la solución. El proyecto también contó con la participación de Ascenty en la asignación de la infraestructura de TI. Entre las ventajas de esta innovación para el proyecto se encuentran el procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de audio con un tiempo de respuesta más corto; la disponibilidad de una plataforma validada, segura y orientada a la ejecución de modelos de IA; la simplificación de la implementación, la administración y la escalabilidad del entorno; el procesamiento local y un mayor control sobre la información confidencial, además de transformar los archivos de audio en textos estructurados, lo que permite análisis posteriores, como la búsqueda, la clasificación, la identificación de temas y la generación de insights. “NVIDIA AI Enterprise es una solución completa para acelerar y optimizar el desarrollo y la implementación de la IA en las empresas al reunir microservicios, marcos de trabajo, modelos abiertos, bibliotecas y herramientas de ciencia de datos que maximizan el rendimiento de las GPU de NVIDIA para aplicaciones de IA agéntica. Por eso, en este proyecto, la plataforma no es solo un modelo para el análisis, el procesamiento y la transcripción de voz. La tecnología es la base necesaria para operar el proyecto con alto rendimiento, escalabilidad y confiabilidad», señala Marcio Aguiar, director de la división Enterprise de NVIDIA para América Latina. En general, todos estos componentes conforman la infraestructura necesaria para transformar los datos generados por la operación en información que pueda ser procesada por modelos de IA. El resultado fue una estructura que no se limitó al caso de uso que motivó su creación, sino que ha ido incorporando nuevas aplicaciones a medida que la empresa las desarrolla o las migra desde soluciones maduras que anteriormente generaban costos por el consumo de tokens. “La decisión de construir una infraestructura propia de inteligencia artificial surgió de la búsqueda de un mayor control sobre nuestros datos, costos y capacidad de evolución”, afirma Paulo Henrique Scrideli, vicepresidente de TI de Sem Parar Corpay. “Más que atender un caso de uso específico, que justificó la inversión inicial en el proyecto, queríamos construir una base que nos brindara mayor seguridad, privacidad y previsibilidad, además de la flexibilidad necesaria para incorporar algunas de las nuevas aplicaciones de IA a medida que surgieran nuevas oportunidades para el negocio”. Según el dimensionamiento del proyecto, el procesamiento alcanza tiempos de respuesta inferiores a medio segundo, y la demanda relacionada con el procesamiento de mensajes consume solo alrededor de dos horas de la capacidad diaria disponible. De este modo, más del 90 % del tiempo de procesamiento puede aprovecharse para otras iniciativas de IA, ampliando el uso de la infraestructura y optimizando la inversión realizada. “El principal desafío fue crear una infraestructura capaz de manejar datos críticos y confidenciales, ampliando el control y la gobernanza de la información y cumpliendo con los requisitos de la LGPD y la conformidad regulatoria. En este contexto, procesar los datos en un entorno propio fue estratégico para la empresa. Con nuestra Dell AI Factory , que cuenta con una solución de NVIDIA, hemos creado una base segura y escalable, preparada para satisfacer la demanda actual y dar cabida a nuevos proyectos de IA», destaca Diego Puerta, presidente de Dell Technologies en Brasil. Más IA, con costos predecibles Con la nueva estrategia llegó una nueva forma de administrar los costos, basada en capacidad dedicada, más predecible y compartida entre diferentes aplicaciones a medida que avanza el uso de la IA en la empresa. Con una “fábrica de IA” interna, la empresa cuenta ahora con capacidad de procesamiento para diferentes aplicaciones, lo que le permite mantener un mayor control sobre los datos y los modelos de IA. La estrategia cobra relevancia ante las crecientes exigencias de seguridad, privacidad y protección de los datos de los clientes, incluida la LGPD, y crea un entorno más controlado para escalar nuevas iniciativas de IA. La eficiencia de la infraestructura también es un componente importante de la estrategia. Al combinar una arquitectura dedicada con tecnologías optimizadas para cargas de trabajo de IA, Sem Parar Corpay busca aumentar el rendimiento y aprovechar mejor los recursos computacionales disponibles, lo que contribuye a un costo de procesamiento más eficiente. Esta optimización cobra mayor relevancia a medida que crece el uso de la IA dentro de la empresa. Una infraestructura dedicada y más eficiente permite a Sem Parar Corpay ampliar el control sobre sus recursos computacionales y sus costos, con mayor previsibilidad sobre la inversión necesaria para procesar volúmenes crecientes de datos, además de maximizar el aprovechamiento de la capacidad instalada. “Cuando hablamos de escalar la inteligencia artificial, no basta con considerar solo la capacidad computacional disponible, sino también la eficiencia con la que se utiliza. La optimización de modelos y cargas de trabajo permite realizar más procesamiento con la misma infraestructura, mejorando el aprovechamiento de los recursos y, en consecuencia, la relación entre costo y rendimiento. En el caso de Sem Parar Corpay, este enfoque ayuda a crear una base que puede atender el primer caso de uso y, progresivamente, dar cabida a nuevas aplicaciones de IA sin que los costos tengan que crecer en la misma proporción”, evalúa el director de la división Enterprise de NVIDIA para América Latina. Las ganancias en eficiencia y la mejora en la relación costo-beneficio del procesamiento de tokens durante la inferencia ayudan a demostrar el potencial de la infraestructura, pero el aspecto más relevante radica en la posibilidad de aprovechar esa misma base tecnológica para ampliar la adopción de la IA y generar valor en nuevos casos de uso. Cinco aplicaciones, una misma base Este potencial ya ha comenzado a materializarse. La fábrica de IA cuenta con cinco aplicaciones en funcionamiento: la solución inicial de análisis de llamadas del centro de atención al cliente y otras cuatro que Sem Parar Corpay incorporó en octubre. En conjunto, estas herramientas abarcan distintos procesos del negocio, desde la atención al cliente hasta la gestión de recursos humanos y la recuperación de ventas. En común, las cinco aplicaciones comparten ahora los beneficios que motivaron la creación de la fábrica: datos procesados en un entorno propio, mayor autonomía para desarrollar las soluciones y costos más predecibles a medida que crece el uso de la IA. Próximos pasos Además de estas cinco aplicaciones, la infraestructura instalada allana el camino para que Sem Parar Corpay desarrolle nuevos proyectos de IA. Esto ha incluido iniciativas de IA generativa y agentiva, copilotos para apoyar a los profesionales y automatización de procesos, entre otros. Es el caso, por ejemplo, del uso de la visión computacional para identificar y verificar los ejes de los camiones en las casetas de peaje. Hoy en día, este tipo de verificación puede implicar un análisis manual de las imágenes. Con la IA, la empresa automatizará parte de este proceso y destinará a los profesionales a actividades de mayor valor agregado. La aplicación, que aún se encuentra en fase de estudio, ilustra la lógica detrás de la infraestructura construida por Sem Parar Corpay: una misma base tecnológica puede sustentar diferentes aplicaciones, siempre y cuando se desarrollen y validen nuevos casos de uso. Para la empresa, contar con la tecnología en casa significa ampliar el control sobre los datos y sobre la operación, ganar autonomía para desarrollar sus aplicaciones y generar mayor previsibilidad en los costos. “Este proyecto crea nuevas opciones para optimizar los diferentes perfiles de demanda y establece una base para la siguiente etapa de nuestro camino hacia la inteligencia artificial. A partir de esta infraestructura, ya hemos incorporado a la fábrica soluciones para uso interno y de soporte a los clientes y, sobre todo, hemos abierto el camino para explorar nuevas aplicaciones a medida que identificamos oportunidades de generar eficiencia y valor para el negocio. El reto es ampliar gradualmente el uso de esta capacidad, llevando la IA a diferentes procesos y transformando la tecnología en una plataforma cada vez más transversal dentro de la empresa”, concluye Scrideli.

Advantage Infantino as AFC backing puts FIFA president on track for fourth term
