ＣＳＩ３００指数は６月２２日の終値ベースの高値を約１９％下回っており、テクニカル的な弱気相場入りの目安とされる２０％下落に近づいている。週間では１．６％下落。１１週連続の下落で２００５年の指数算出開始以来、最長となった。

後場の反転の背景には、政府系投資家で構成する「国家隊」に人気のＥＴＦ数銘柄の売買急増がある。これを受け、当局が相場を下支えしているとの観測が広がった。 

トレーダーやアナリストは、最近の中国本土株（Ａ株）の軟調さは、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策に対する失望が影響していると指摘する。

モルガン・スタンレーのアナリストは中国株に引き続き慎重な姿勢を示し、「内需の弱さと流動性面の逆風が続いている。一方、バリュエーション（株価評価）はまだ明確な底に達していない」と述べた。

ＲＢＣウェルス・マネジメントはリポートで、財政刺激策の不足と期待外れの企業業績が株価下落の原因と指摘。新たな政策や技術面の材料がなければ、不安定な相場は来年初めまで続く可能性があり、国家隊の下支えだけでは、相場回復を維持できないとの見方を示した。

香港市場のハンセン指数が０．７％高で引けた。

ソウル株式市場は上昇して引けた。米子会社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）計画を撤回した半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスが急伸した。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は０．３０％高で終了。一時４．１２％下落していた。

前日の米半導体株安に追随して半導体株が売られ、指数は下落して始まった。２２日のフィラデルフィア半導体指数は人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る懸念から６．７％急落した。

ＳＫハイニックスは４．４２％上昇。市場の変動を理由に、半導体子会社ソリダイムの米上場計画を凍結した。

同業のサムスン電子は一時５％超下落したものの、０．４７％高で引けた。

大信証券のアナリスト、イ・ギョンミン氏は「米株式市場のＡＩ投資に対する懸念は、前日の韓国市場に織り込まれていた。新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）計画の撤回を受け、ＳＫハイニックスを中心に投資家心理が改善した」と述べた。

ロイター調査によると、韓国経済の第３・四半期の成長率は４─６月期からやや加速したとみられる。好調な半導体輸出とＡＩ関連投資が回復にばらつきのある内需を補った。

取引された９１５銘柄のうち、値上がりは１７１銘柄、値下がりは７２１銘柄だった。

海外投資家は９９４１億ウォン（７億５０６４万ドル）相当を売り越した。

シドニー株式市場は、ほぼ横ばいで引けた。鉱業株や産金株の下落が銀行株やヘルスケア株の上昇を相殺した。週間では小幅安となり、３週連続の上昇が途切れた。

今週は鉱業大手ＢＨＰとフォーテスキューの事業報告が投資家の期待に届かなかったほか、原油高に伴う金価格の変動で産金株が急落した。投資家は安全な投資先と見なされる銀行株やヘルスケア株に資金を振り向けた。

ＥＴＦシェアーズのデービッド・タックウェル最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「投資家は慎重になっているが、パニックには陥っていない。豪株式市場はアジア市場に比べて底堅い」と指摘。イエメンの武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへの新たな攻撃を受け、原油が市場の大きな懸念材料になっているとし、米国とイランの衝突再燃への警戒でインフレ懸念が強まっていると述べた。

鉱業株指数は４．２％急落し、この日の相場の下げを主導した。週間では７カ月余りぶりの大幅安となった。

ＢＨＰとリオティントはそれぞれ２．５％超下落した。

産金株指数は５．６％下落。週間では７カ月余りぶりの大幅安となった。

エネルギー株指数は０．４％下落し、週間では１カ月ぶりの大幅安となった。同業大手サントスは１．５％下落した。

金融株指数は２．２％上昇し、週間では６カ月余りぶりの大幅高となった。四大銀行株はいずれも上昇した。

タックウェル氏は「銀行株は市場が不安定になった際の安全な資金の置き場と見なされている。主に豪国内の住宅ローンから収益を得ているため、ＡＩ投資や原油・商品価格の影響を受けにくい」と述べた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: 中国株式市場は反発。前場は軟調だったが、政府系投資家が好んで売買する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の取引が急増し、後場に切り返し...
items.body:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（23日）
10/23 16:16 配信

中国株式市場は反発。前場は軟調だったが、政府系投資家が好んで売買する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の取引が急増し、後場に切り返した。

優良株で構成するＣＳＩ３００指数は一時１．９％下落したが、１．７％高で終了。上海総合指数が０．９％高。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は６月２２日の終値ベースの高値を約１９％下回っており、テクニカル的な弱気相場入りの目安とされる２０％下落に近づいている。週間では１．６％下落。１１週連続の下落で２００５年の指数算出開始以来、最長となった。

後場の反転の背景には、政府系投資家で構成する「国家隊」に人気のＥＴＦ数銘柄の売買急増がある。これを受け、当局が相場を下支えしているとの観測が広がった。 

トレーダーやアナリストは、最近の中国本土株（Ａ株）の軟調さは、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策に対する失望が影響していると指摘する。

モルガン・スタンレーのアナリストは中国株に引き続き慎重な姿勢を示し、「内需の弱さと流動性面の逆風が続いている。一方、バリュエーション（株価評価）はまだ明確な底に達していない」と述べた。

ＲＢＣウェルス・マネジメントはリポートで、財政刺激策の不足と期待外れの企業業績が株価下落の原因と指摘。新たな政策や技術面の材料がなければ、不安定な相場は来年初めまで続く可能性があり、国家隊の下支えだけでは、相場回復を維持できないとの見方を示した。

香港市場のハンセン指数が０．７％高で引けた。

ソウル株式市場は上昇して引けた。米子会社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）計画を撤回した半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスが急伸した。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は０．３０％高で終了。一時４．１２％下落していた。

前日の米半導体株安に追随して半導体株が売られ、指数は下落して始まった。２２日のフィラデルフィア半導体指数は人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る懸念から６．７％急落した。

ＳＫハイニックスは４．４２％上昇。市場の変動を理由に、半導体子会社ソリダイムの米上場計画を凍結した。

同業のサムスン電子は一時５％超下落したものの、０．４７％高で引けた。

大信証券のアナリスト、イ・ギョンミン氏は「米株式市場のＡＩ投資に対する懸念は、前日の韓国市場に織り込まれていた。新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）計画の撤回を受け、ＳＫハイニックスを中心に投資家心理が改善した」と述べた。

ロイター調査によると、韓国経済の第３・四半期の成長率は４─６月期からやや加速したとみられる。好調な半導体輸出とＡＩ関連投資が回復にばらつきのある内需を補った。

取引された９１５銘柄のうち、値上がりは１７１銘柄、値下がりは７２１銘柄だった。

海外投資家は９９４１億ウォン（７億５０６４万ドル）相当を売り越した。

シドニー株式市場は、ほぼ横ばいで引けた。鉱業株や産金株の下落が銀行株やヘルスケア株の上昇を相殺した。週間では小幅安となり、３週連続の上昇が途切れた。

今週は鉱業大手ＢＨＰとフォーテスキューの事業報告が投資家の期待に届かなかったほか、原油高に伴う金価格の変動で産金株が急落した。投資家は安全な投資先と見なされる銀行株やヘルスケア株に資金を振り向けた。

ＥＴＦシェアーズのデービッド・タックウェル最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「投資家は慎重になっているが、パニックには陥っていない。豪株式市場はアジア市場に比べて底堅い」と指摘。イエメンの武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへの新たな攻撃を受け、原油が市場の大きな懸念材料になっているとし、米国とイランの衝突再燃への警戒でインフレ懸念が強まっていると述べた。

鉱業株指数は４．２％急落し、この日の相場の下げを主導した。週間では７カ月余りぶりの大幅安となった。

ＢＨＰとリオティントはそれぞれ２．５％超下落した。

産金株指数は５．６％下落。週間では７カ月余りぶりの大幅安となった。

エネルギー株指数は０．４％下落し、週間では１カ月ぶりの大幅安となった。同業大手サントスは１．５％下落した。

金融株指数は２．２％上昇し、週間では６カ月余りぶりの大幅高となった。四大銀行株はいずれも上昇した。

タックウェル氏は「銀行株は市場が不安定になった際の安全な資金の置き場と見なされている。主に豪国内の住宅ローンから収益を得ているため、ＡＩ投資や原油・商品価格の影響を受けにくい」と述べた。

ヘルスケア株指数は０．７％、一般消費財株指数は２．６％、それぞれ上昇した。

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - ＳＧホールディングス傘下の佐川急便は２３日、９月末に確認した荷物追跡サービスの不正アクセスで最大５３２３万件の個人情報が流出した可能性があると発表した。対象となる情報は荷主や届け先の氏名、住所、電話番号のほか、ウェブサービスに登録した顧客の氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレス、会員ＩＤ。クレジットカード情報とパスワードは含まれていないとしている。 

佐川は不正アクセス確認後に荷物追跡サービスを停止していたが、２３日に再開した。

items.title: 9月スーパー販売額0.8％増、秋物など衣料品好調＝チェーンストア協会
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２３日　ロイター］ - 日本チェーンストア協会が２３日に発表した９月の全国スーパーマーケット販売額は、店舗調整後（既存店ベース）で前年同月比０．８％増の９９３７億６６９４万円となった。店舗調整前では、１．２％減だった。

９月は東日本を中心に天候不順によるマイナス要因が見られたが、食料品は畜産品の動きが良かったこともあり全体の販売額をカバー。衣料品も天候不順の影響で秋物商品が動き、住関品もまずまずの動きだったことから、総販売額はプラスとなった。

カテゴリ別では、食料品は０．２％増、衣料品は１．９％増、住居関連品は１．９％増、サービスは７．８％増だった。

Aditya Soni

[シドニー ２３日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２３日、同社初の折り畳み式スマートフォンｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」を発売した。市場関係者は、ｉＰｈｏｎｅがスマートフォン市場を変えたように、Ｄｕｏが折り畳み式端末市場を一変させられるかに注目している。

２３日に最初に販売を始めたシドニーのアップルストアでは、午前８時の開店前から行列ができた。エンジニアのサイモン・クリシュナン氏（４８）は、メモリー容量５１２ＧＢのＤｕｏを３８９９豪ドル（２７３４米ドル）で購入した。「とても高くて私にはちょっとしたぜいたく品だ。でも人生は短いのだから」と話した。

すでに小米科技（シャオミ）の折り畳み式端末を持っているにもかかわらず、上海中心部のアップルストアに午前６時から並んだというのは医療従事者のリウ・ウェイ氏（２６）だ。「アップル製品を長年使っていて、（ブランドへの）信頼もより厚い。試してみようと思い、発売日に買った」と語った。

香港ではメイと名乗った３８歳の男性がオンラインの先行販売で２５６ＧＢモデルを手に入れた。小売価格は１万７４９９香港ドル（２２３１．７３米ドル）で、転売して４０００香港ドル程度の利益を得るつもりだという。

＜評価は分かれる＞

初期のレビューでは、Ｄｕｏのデザインに加え、頑丈でほとんど目立たないヒンジが評価された。折り目が目立つ画面は長年、折り畳み式端末の欠点で、購入をためらわせる要因にもなりかねなかっただけに、大きな成果だ。

一方、望遠レンズがないなどカメラ機能で妥協した点や、外部の開発者によるアプリが新しい画面サイズにまだ対応し切れていない点は、一部の購入者を失望させる可能性があると指摘されている。また折り畳んだ状態では、通常のｉＰｈｏｎｅで毎日こなす数多くのちょっとした作業には使いにくいとの声もある。著名なレビュアーの中には、多くのアップルユーザーにはＤｕｏを勧めないとする人も見られる。

アップル製品を長年論評し、ブログ「Ｄａｒｉｎｇ Ｆｉｒｅｂａｌｌ」を執筆するジョン・グルーバー氏はレビューに「Ｄｕｏを１週間試すのはとても楽しかった。ただ使わせてもらったのは非常に完成度の高い試作品という感じで、買って持ち歩きたいと思える完成品ではなかった」と記した。

ＭＫＢＨＤの名で知られるテクノロジー評論家のマルケス・ブラウンリー氏は、ユーチューブのレビューで「メッセージのやり取りや交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）、たまにネットを見る程度の一般的な利用者なら、おそらく買わない方がいい。２０００ドルが大した出費ではなく、この発想が気に入ったなら、操作を覚え、顔認証がないことに慣れれば、とても楽しい端末だ」と述べた。

市場調査会社ＩＤＣのバイスプレジデント、フランシスコ・ジェロニモ氏は「折り畳み式端末は数年前から一つの製品分野として定着しているが、従来型のスマートフォンに比べると普及はなお限定的だ。アップルの参入によって、はるかに幅広い層に広がる可能性がある」と述べた。

Ｄｕｏを１週間使ったというジェロニモ氏は「アップルはこの形状の端末の魅力を説得力のある形で示した」と語った。「次の試練は、この熱気を供給と普及につなげ、スマートフォン市場に長く続く新たな時代を開けるかどうかだ」と述べた。

items.title: 午後3時のドルは156円後半で小動き、実需の買い一巡後は様子見強まる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] -

  ...
items.body:
午後3時のドルは156円後半で小動き、実需の買い一巡後は様子見強まる
10/23 15:41 配信

米ドル紙幣。２０１６年１１月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] -

  ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 156.88／156.90 1.1210／1.1212 175.89／175.90

午前９時現在 156.54／156.55 1.1220／1.1222 175.63／175.69

ＮＹ午後５時 156.76／156.77 1.1214／1.1217 175.81／175.84

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べて小幅にドル高／円安の１５６円後半で推移している。朝方は円買いが優勢で一時１５６．０８円まで下落したが、昼前にかけて１５７円前半まで切り返した。実質的な五・十日に当たり、輸入企業によるドル買いが入ったとみられている。実需の取引が一巡した午後は１５７円近辺で小動きが続いた。

朝方は日経平均が１０００円超安に下げ幅を拡大する中、リスク回避の円買いが優勢となった。全国消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）で総合、コア、コア・コアのいずれも２％を上回り、日銀による利上げへの思惑も円買いを後押しした。

ただ、ドル／円は１５６円近辺で下げ止まり、一段安とはならなかった。５週間ぶりの安値圏に下落したこともあり、実需の買いが入りやすい地合いだった。

市場からは「株価が落ち着きを取り戻し、もう一段下を攻める材料に欠いた。一目均衡表の雲下限も下値のサポートとして意識されたのではないか」（みなと銀行の苅谷将吾ストラテジスト）との見方が出ていた。

午後は動意に乏しい展開となった。来週の日米中銀による金融政策イベントを控え、様子見ムードが強まりやすかった。

items.title: 国内金融システム、海外市場・ファンドの影響受けやすくなっている可能性＝日銀リポート
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 日銀は２３日に公表した金融システムリポートで、国...
items.body:
国内金融システム、海外市場・ファンドの影響受けやすくなっている可能性＝日銀リポート
10/23 15:35 配信

日銀本店。２０２４年３月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 日銀は２３日に公表した金融システムリポートで、国内の金融システムは「全体として安定性を維持」していると評価した。同時に海外ノンバンクの影響拡大を指摘し「グローバルな金融市場の変動や海外ファンドの動向の影響を受けやすくなっている可能性」があると指摘した。

＜ＡＩ期待縮小なら、債券市場に影響も＞

現状は「グローバルなＡＩ（人工知能）関連需要の拡大が続くもとで、日本株も上昇している」と指摘。海外ヘッジファンドに「株式投資と債券取引の双方を行うものが多い」ため、米ＡＩ銘柄への「期待が縮小する場合には、債券市場にも影響が伝播する可能性がある」と警鐘を鳴らした。

ＡＩ関連設備投資を進める米ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）が「自己資金で賄えない部分でノンバンク部門が資金の出し手として存在感を増している」とも指摘している。

＜都心３区の中古マンション価格に一服感＞

足元の国内金融活動については「大きな不均衡は認められないが、不動産価格や株価といった資産価格の動向には引き続き留意が必要」とした。首都圏マンション市場の関連では「空室率の低下と賃料の上昇が続いている」とする一方で、「都心３区に限ると中古マンションの価格上昇に一服感もみられる」と記述した。

原油価格が急騰する場合、中小企業のデフォルト確率の上昇は「総じて限定的」としている。

原油価格のバレル１４０ドルへの急騰や金利上昇、米国を中心としたＡＩ関連投資に対する期待が縮小などのリスクを想定した場合のシミュレーションを試算。メガバンクの台湾などアジア向け貸し出しなどを下押しされ、自己資本比率は低下するものの、「金融システムの安定性は全体として維持される」と評価している。

日銀は年２回、金融システム全体の状況についての分析・評価を行うリポートを公表している。

items.title: 円債の積み増し継続、外債は減少へ＝太陽生命・26年度下期運用計画
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mariko Sakaguchi

［東京　２３日　ロイター］ - Ｔ＆Ｄホールディングス傘下の太陽生命保険は、２０２６...
items.body:
円債の積み増し継続、外債は減少へ＝太陽生命・26年度下期運用計画
10/23 15:19 配信

写真は円紙幣のイメージ。2022年11月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Mariko Sakaguchi

［東京　２３日　ロイター］ - Ｔ＆Ｄホールディングス傘下の太陽生命保険は、２０２６年度下期一般勘定資産運用計画で、国内債券の残高を引き続き増加させる方針を示した。デュレーションを抑制し、スプレッド（上乗せ金利）がある事業債や長期・超長期債を中心に円債を積み増す。外国債券、内外株式の残高はいずれも減少を見込んでいる。

取締役常務執行役員の清友美貴氏が１９日、ロイターとのインタビューで述べた。

国内債券の残高は下期も引き続き増加の見通し。１０年以下の事業債や１０―２０年ゾーンの国債を中心に、平準的なペースで積み増していく。低利回り債券からの入れ替えについては前倒しする形で進めており、下期も状況を見極めながら対応していく。上期については想定通り、円債を積み増した。

日銀の金融政策については、年度内に２回の追加利上げの実施を予想。ターミナルレート（利上げ最終到達点）は２％を想定する。

清友氏は「市場が２％を超える政策金利の引き上げをすでに織り込んでいることを踏まえると、長期や超長期債の金利上昇余地は限られてくる」と指摘。２６年度の日本国債１０年物利回りレンジは２．６０―３．４０％で、年度末は３．００％を想定。２０年物利回りレンジは３．５０―４．３０％で、年度末は３．８０％を想定する。

高市早苗政権による財政政策については、「（政権から）市場に配慮する発言が目立つこともあり、実際の数字を見極めながらとなるが、財政懸念も徐々に落ち着いてくるのではないか」（清友氏）とみている。

外国債券の残高は減少する見通し。４月時点の計画では横ばいを想定していたものの、償還に伴う再投資分を円債に振り向けたため、上期は減少した。下期も、為替ヘッジコストの高止まりを踏まえ、選別取り組みを行う。

米１０年債利回りのレンジは４．５０％─５．５０％、年度末は５．００％を予想。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が年度内に２回の利上げを実施すると予想。ドル／円の想定レンジは１４０─１６５円で、年度末は１５０円を想定。相場を見極めながら機動的に対応する。

株式は、国内、海外ともにリスク削減のため、残高を縮小させる見通し。上期は、国内株式の残高は減少した一方、外国株式の残高は横ばいにとどまった。貸付金は上期は減少したものの、下期は金利上昇に伴う収益性の高まりで、増加を見込む。不動産は引き続き横ばいを予定している。

２６年度の相場見通し（レンジと年度末）は以下の通り。

日本国債１０年物利回り　２．６０―３．４０％（年度末３．００％）

米１０年債利回り　　　　４．５０─５．５０％（同５．００％）

日経平均　　　　　　　　５万８０００─７万８０００円（同７万２０００円）

米ダウ　　　　　　　　　４万５０００─６万００００ドル（同５万５０００ドル）

ドル／円　　　　　　　　１４０―１６５円（同１５０円）

ユーロ／円　　　　　　　１６０―１８５円（同１７０円）

items.body:
9月百貨店売上4.2％増、早めの秋やインバウンド好調で＝百貨店協会
10/23 15:18 配信

デパートのショーウィンドウ。２０１４年１１月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Yuya Shino

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 日本百貨店協会が２３日に発表した９月の全国百貨店売上高は、総額４４３４億円で、店舗数調整後の前年同月比は４．２％増と９カ月連続のプラスとなった。気温低下による秋物商材の需要拡大に加え、高額品を中心に国内・インバウンド需要がともに好調だった。大型連休で国内需要が高まったことや、アジア各国の祝日に伴う訪日客の増加も売上増に寄与した。

例年より早い秋の到来でニットやジャケットが伸長したほか、雨天が多く雨傘やレインシューズの売れ行きが好調だった。高額商材も引き続き堅調。

国内は２．１％増で３カ月連続のプラス。インバウンド（免税売上）は２５．３％増で７カ月連続のプラス。インバウンドの購買客数は５．９％増と２カ月ぶりに前年を上回り、売上高・購買客数ともに９月として過去最高を記録した。韓国・台湾・香港が祝日連休と円安を背景に大幅伸長。中国は購買客数が約１５％減となったが、客単価の上昇により売上高は約７％増だった。

items.title: インド総合ＰＭＩ、10月は4カ月ぶり高水準　雇用ほぼ停滞
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ベンガルール ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルがまとめた１０月のインドのＨＳＢＣ総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭ...
items.body:
インド総合ＰＭＩ、10月は4カ月ぶり高水準　雇用ほぼ停滞
10/23 14:34 配信

製鉄所の作業員。１月、インドのアフマダーバード郊外で撮影。REUTERS/Amit Dave

[ベンガルール ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルがまとめた１０月のインドのＨＳＢＣ総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は、受注の増加を背景にサービス業が主導し、４カ月ぶりの高水準となった。

ただ、企業が業務量の増加に既存の人員で対応したため、雇用の伸びはほぼ停滞した。

・総合ＰＭＩ速報値は５６．７と、９月の確定値５５．９から上昇し、ロイター調査の予想中央値５６．１も上回った。景気拡大と縮小の分かれ目となる５０を上回り、堅調な成長を示したが、２０２６年の平均は下回っている。

・サービス業ＰＭＩは５５．２から５６．２に上昇し、民間部門全体の生産拡大ペースを加速させる主因となった。需要は強まったものの、雇用は横ばいとなり、９カ月連続の増加が途切れた。

・製造業の生産は小幅に増加したが、雇用の伸び鈍化が総合的な景況を示す製造業ＰＭＩを押し下げ、５５．１から５４．９に低下した。

・企業は、既存の人員で業務量に対応できると回答した。全体の受注残は、過去約６年半で最速に並ぶペースで減少した。

・海外需要も支えとなり、輸出受注全体は６カ月ぶりの高い伸びとなった。ただ、改善は製造業に集中し、サービス業の海外からの新規受注の伸びは鈍化した。

・価格圧力は両部門で緩和した。投入コストの上昇率は約１年ぶりの低水準に鈍化し、販売価格の上昇率は２０２５年３月以来の低さとなった。

・企業の先行きに対する信頼感は５月以来の高水準に回復したが、２６年の平均は下回った。

items.title: ＨＳＢＣ、プラチナとパラジウムの26年予想価格引き下げ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣは２２日の調査リポートで、市場ファンダメンタルズの変化や投資家のポジション...
items.body:
ＨＳＢＣ、プラチナとパラジウムの26年予想価格引き下げ
10/23 14:16 配信

ＨＳＢＣのロゴのイメージ。１月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２２日 ロイター] - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣは２２日の調査リポートで、市場ファンダメンタルズの変化や投資家のポジション解消を理由に、２０２６年のプラチナおよびパラジウムの平均価格予測を引き下げた。ただ、両者とも回復の余地はあるとしている。

プラチナは２６年の平均価格予想を１オンス＝１９２５ドルに引き下げた一方、２７年の予測は同２１９５ドルに据え置いた。従来の２６年予想はリポートに記されていない。

２６年のパラジウム平均価格予想は従来の１オンス＝１５４６ドルから１４３６ドルに引き下げ、２７年は１５９５ドルに維持した。

リポートによるとプラチナ価格は、中東での紛争を背景に、自動車需要の低迷、宝飾品需要の不振、上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）などのポジション解消が圧迫要因。パラジウム市場にも同様の要因が見られる。

プラチナの需給については、２６年が３４万４０００オンス、２７年が８２万５０００オンスの供給不足になると予想した。

南アフリカ、ロシア、ジンバブエの生産者が障害に直面しているため、プラチナの鉱山供給制約は依然として極めて大きいと指摘。また、金価格の上昇や現物資産に対する投資家需要の再燃がプラチナ価格を下支えする可能性があるとした。

パラジウムについては、ロシアと北米で今年の生産予想が低下しており、鉱山供給の制約が価格上昇の鍵を握ると指摘。自動車需要は低迷しているが、割安な水準に達しつつある可能性があるとの見方を示した。

items.title: ロレアル、第3四半期売上高が予想上回る　高級美容品が需要けん引
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dominique Patton

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランスの化粧品大手ロレアルが２２日発表した第３・四...
items.body:
ロレアル、第3四半期売上高が予想上回る　高級美容品が需要けん引
10/23 14:12 配信

ロレアルのロゴ。２０２１年５月、パリ近郊ルヴァロワ・ペレのオフィスで撮影。REUTERS/Christian Hartmann

Dominique Patton

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランスの化粧品大手ロレアルが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が調整後既存店ベースで前年同期比７．７％増の１１５億６０００万ユーロ（１２９億５０００万ドル）となり、伸びはビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の５．９％増を上回った。高価なヘアケア製品や高級スキンケア製品に対する購入意欲が追い風となった。

ロレアルはスキンケア製品「セラヴィ」やイタリアのブランド「プラダ」の香水を手がけている。近年はプレミアム商品の展開に力を入れており、大ヒットを誇る有名ブランドのラインアップに高級香水を追加するとともに、ヘアサロン向けブランド「ケラスターゼ」から新たなヘアケア製品を展開している。

同社の高級化粧品部門はグループ売上高全体の３分の１以上を占めている。第３・四半期の既存店売上高は前年同期比７％増となり、市場予想の４．５％増を大幅に上回った。中国における高級スキンケア製品や、「プラダ・パラダイム」などの売れ筋香水への堅調な需要に支えられた。

同社は化粧品と香水の両部門における強固な事業基盤により、高級ブランドへの需要が加速している中国を含め、世界的に拡大する美容関連消費の恩恵を受けている。

二コラ・イエロニムス最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「世界の美容市場は、厳しい状況下においても再び回復力を証明した。当社は引き続き市場平均を大幅に上回る成長を維持した」と述べた。

items.title: Leading French supermarket retailer faces up to €200 million hit from riots, looting
items.summary: A leading French supermarket retailer, Carrefour, has warned that riots, looting and curfews across France could cost it between €80 million and €200 million in operating income, forcing it to cut its ...
items.body:
Leading French supermarket retailer faces up to €200 million hit from riots, looting A leading French supermarket retailer, Carrefour, has warned that riots, looting and curfews across France could cost it between €80 million and €200 million in operating income, forcing it to cut its annual earnings forecast amid disruptions to store operations, according to a Reuters report.
ANI | Updated: 23-10-2026 17:42 IST | Created: 23-10-2026 17:42 IST

Visual from the protest in France (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

A leading French supermarket retailer, Carrefour, has warned that riots, looting and curfews across France could cost it between €80 million (USD 90 million) and €200 million (USD 225 million) in operating income, forcing it to cut its annual earnings forecast amid disruptions to store operations, according to a Reuters report. The retailer has lowered its outlook for 2026 adjusted earnings per share (EPS) to stable or slight growth, compared with its earlier forecast of growth in the high single digits. It also expects free cash flow to decline slightly compared with 2025.
According to Reuters, around 50 stores were attacked during the first day of unrest, with several looted and damaged. The company said the damage was considerable, while employees and business partners faced distressing situations. The unrest has disrupted trading at a critical time for the retail sector, as the fourth-quarter shopping period begins. Consumer confidence was already weak due to high fuel prices, and the ongoing disturbances have further affected customer footfall at stores.
The retailer's finance chief said the direct costs included stolen or destroyed merchandise, damage to stores and equipment, and losses arising from outlets being forced to close. The company also expects continued disruption in the coming weeks, with some stores operating for shorter hours because of curfews. Reuters reported that many of the retailer's approximately 6,000 stores across France were closed in anticipation of further unrest, including on Sunday and Monday. The company did not disclose the total number of outlets shut.
Costs have also risen as stores strengthened security arrangements, including hiring external security guards. The retailer was among those significantly affected because of its extensive network of convenience stores in major cities such as Paris, Lyon and Marseille. The company's chief executive called for improved security during the next round of planned protests on October 24, while acknowledging that further business disruption could not be ruled out.
The impact of the unrest has also prompted the retailer to reduce its investment plans in France. It lowered its capital expenditure forecast for 2026 to €1.6 billion (USD 1.80 billion) from €1.7 billion (USD 1.91 billion). The company had been preparing to launch its Black Friday sales events in the coming days, adding to concerns over the timing of the disruption, Reuters reported. (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: 米ロードアイランド州がメタ提訴、詐欺広告を容認したと主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jeff Horwitz　Katie Paul

[２２日 ロイター] - 米ロードアイランド州は２２日、「フェイスブッ...
items.body:
米ロードアイランド州がメタ提訴、詐欺広告を容認したと主張
10/23 14:07 配信

メタのロゴ。２０２５年６月、パリのポルト・ド・ヴェルサイユ展示場で撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Jeff Horwitz　Katie Paul

[２２日 ロイター] - 米ロードアイランド州は２２日、「フェイスブック」、「インスタグラム」、「ワッツアップ」の各プラットフォーム上で詐欺広告を容認したとして、メタ・プラットフォームズを州裁判所に提訴した。

ネロンハ州司法長官は、メタが数十億ドル規模の詐欺広告の作成に加担し、そこから不法に利益を得ていたと非難。同社は数十億人のユーザーに対し、ユーザー保護のために懸命に取り組んでいると保証していたにもかかわらず、このような行為を行っていたとしている。

米国の州がメタを相手取って提起した初の詐欺関連訴訟となる。５月にはカリフォルニア州サンタクララ郡が同様の訴訟を提起した。

訴状では、州法違反の各事案に対する民事制裁金、消費者への賠償、不正に得た利益の返還に加え、プラットフォーム上で作成・配信する詐欺広告から利益を得るのではなく、これに対処するようメタに命じることを求めている。

「訴状で主張されている通り、メタは脆弱なユーザーを詐欺に故意にさらし、それによって莫大な利益を得た。大小を問わず、企業がロードアイランド州の消費者を搾取する場合、当オフィスは権限の範囲内であらゆる手段を講じて、その責任を追及する」とネロンハ氏はプレスリリースで述べた。

一方メタは、この訴訟を「根拠がない」として争う意向を示し、同社が詐欺ネットワークを摘発するために法執行機関と定期的に連携していると主張。広報担当者は「州司法長官は、ロードアイランド州民を詐欺から守るための当社の取り組みについて協議することを拒否し、その代わりに州外の民間法律事務所を雇い、われわれが日々詐欺対策として行っているあらゆる取り組みを無視した訴訟をでっち上げた」とする声明を出した。

メタが過去１年間だけで１億５９００万件以上の詐欺広告を削除し、フェイスブックでの不審な友達リクエストを警告するアラート、広告主の認証プロセスの拡充、ワッツアップでの危険なデバイス連携リクエストに関する警告など、新たな詐欺対策ツールを導入したと強調した。

items.title: 仏ケリング、主力ブランド「グッチ」売上高6％減　再建計画に打撃
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tassilo Hummel　Alessandro Parodi

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランス高級ファッシ...
items.body:
仏ケリング、主力ブランド「グッチ」売上高6％減　再建計画に打撃
10/23 14:04 配信

グッチの衣装。5月16日、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Tassilo Hummel　Alessandro Parodi

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランス高級ファッショングループのケリングが２２日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期決算は、主力ブランドであるイタリアの「グッチ」の売上高が前年同期比６％減の１２億９０００万ユーロ（１４億４０００万ドル）となった。昨年就任したルカ・デメオ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の指揮下での急速な成長回復への期待は打ち砕かれた。

グループ全体の売上高は１％減った。発表を受け、ケリングの米国預託証券（ＡＤＲ）は１１％下落した。

デメオ氏は利益率倍増を目指す５カ年計画でケリングの立て直しを図っている。しかし、混迷する中東情勢、中国での需要低迷、米国での勢いの鈍化が壁となっている。

アルメル・プールー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はメディア向けの電話会議で、年内に全体的な成長軌道への復帰が今も目標なのかとの質問に、通期決算の発表を理由にしてコメントを差し控えた。

ケリングによると、グッチの主な問題は特に中国における客足の減少で、同ブランド売上高は３年以上にわたり減少を続けている。北米でもグッチの売上高はわずかに減った。

プールー氏は「当社は最大限の規律を持って計画を続ける」と強調。これまでに小売店舗網を１０５店舗削減しており、来年末までに１２５店舗の閉鎖を目指していると表明した。

デメオ氏はコスト削減、さらなる店舗閉鎖、サプライチェーン（供給網）の合理化を推進することで利益率を２５年の１１．１％から２０年代末までに倍増させることを目指している。ただアナリストは、ブランドの魅力を失った事業を立て直すには単なる効率化対策だけでは不十分だと指摘している。

items.title: China's Baidu tests robotaxi on London streets
items.summary: US-based Lyft unit Freenow and Baidu's Apollo Go unveiled the Chinese company's RT6 autonomous vehicle in London on Thursday and said they hope to launch a driverless robotaxi service in the city ...
items.body:
China's Baidu tests robotaxi on London streets
Reuters | Updated: 23-10-2026 17:30 IST | Created: 23-10-2026 17:30 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US-based Lyft unit Freenow and Baidu's Apollo Go unveiled the Chinese company's RT6 autonomous vehicle in London on Thursday and said they hope to launch a driverless robotaxi service in the city in 2027.
The two companies began testing vehicles in London with safety drivers in the summer and hope to have fully driverless vehicles in the city next year, aiming for a commercial launch in 2027. The partnership between San Francisco-based ride-hailing firm Lyft and China's Baidu in London comes as the US Senate is working to pass a permanent ban on Chinese cars in the United States, pushing more companies to focus on Europe.
Competition between robotaxi developers in London is heating up. UK self-driving vehicle startup Wayve and Lyft rival Uber launched a robotaxi service in London in September, initially with a human safety driver behind the wheel. US robotaxi company Waymo, a unit of Google parent Alphabet , aims to launch a fully driverless ride-hailing service in London by the end of this year.
LONDON STREETS OFFER CHALLENGING TEST Freenow UK general manager Danny O'Gorman said London was a particularly good testing ground, with lots of speed bumps, narrow streets and many roads limited to 20 miles per hour.
"So the car is going through the phase of learning the rules of the road much like you would do if you're trying to pass your own driving test," O'Gorman told Reuters during a demonstration ride. O'Gorman said the company was working closely with Transport for London and expected regulatory guidelines in the coming week. He recognised new technology "can sometimes be scary" but most Londoners were excited about the prospect
He said robotaxis were not trying to replace London's famous black cabs. The firm is talking about "tens of vehicles in the next year or two" as it tests the market. "In terms of the taxi in London, the iconic black cab, this is not a replacement for that service," he said. "Black cabs are a fundamental part of London."

items.summary: Defence Secretary said, our exports have reached an all-time high of 38,424 crores, which is about 3.6 billion euros, and I was reading a Bloomberg report yesterday, which said that suddenly over the ...
items.body:
India became third-largest exporter of arms to Europe: Defence Secretary RK Singh Defence Secretary said, our exports have reached an all-time high of 38,424 crores, which is about 3.6 billion euros, and I was reading a Bloomberg report yesterday, which said that suddenly over the last year, India became the third largest exporter of arms to Europe, mainly because of the Rearm Europe initiative.
ANI | Updated: 23-10-2026 17:15 IST | Created: 23-10-2026 17:15 IST

Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh (Photo/ANI). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

India

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh on Friday asserted that India has rapidly emerged as the third-largest arms exporter to Europe, driven by surging demand under the "Rearm Europe" initiative and a broadening domestic manufacturing base. In the Agrasar Bharat Manch Event on Friday, Singh emphasised that in India, our intention is to build up our defence industrial base, which traditionally used to be focused on some 16 odd public sector companies, government-owned companies, to a much wider defence industrial base, including the private sector, the small and medium sector, as well as the startup ecosystem that is becoming very strong in India.
Defence Secretary stated that the tangible economic and operational dividends of this transition are already materialising on a global scale. He said, "In India, on the other hand, for the last 10 years, we've seen tremendous growth in our defence ecosystem. We have some, besides the 16 large public sector companies. We now have almost 840 odd companies with industrial licenses that are large and medium-sized, and some 17,000 small and medium enterprises, including startups. And the result of this diversified industrial base is becoming visible in terms of the value of domestic sales, which are now almost 17 billion euros."
Reflecting on recent trade reports, the Defence Secretary noted that international market dynamics have shifted drastically in India's favour over the past year. "Our exports have reached an all-time high of 38,424 crores, which is about 3.6 billion euros, and I was reading a Bloomberg report yesterday, which said that suddenly over the last year, India became the third largest exporter of arms to Europe, mainly because of the Rearm Europe initiative. As a result, a lot of standard ammunition of different types, artillery shells, and large- and small-calibre ammunition started getting exported to Europe in significant numbers," Singh stated.
"We now export to more than 80 countries, and the in terms of policy, what we try to do is ensure that 75% of our capex every year, which is somewhere between 20 to 25 billion dollars every year, gets spent within the country, and we try to prioritise what we call IDDM, which is Indian-designed, developed and manufactured, to ensure technological sovereignty," he added. According to Secretary Singh, the nation's military exports have scaled to an all-time high, distributing defence products to more than 80 countries globally. Beyond heavy artillery and ammunition, Indian defence shipments range from tactical gear like helmets and bulletproof jackets to small arms.
Emphasising that Indian defence shipments span a diverse spectrum of tactical goods and combat platforms, Singh said, "I mentioned that suddenly out the globe, we become the third largest whatever arms to Europe, one, mainly because of the artillery. In addition, we export a variety of equipment, including everything from bulletproof jackets and helmets to small arms.  A lot of buyers, particularly in Southeast Asia, have contracts that are all in public negotiations. So here's a whole gammate of different types of defence components. Small arms of different types, artillery, gun systems of different types." "These are the main platforms that we export to over 80 countries," he added.
"We used to rely on Russia as its largest defence supplier. We still have a lot of our equipment that is of Russian origin, but over time that dependence has come down and we diversified; we already have fairly strong bilateral relations with some European countries, France in particular. But also with several other countries as well. After Russia, France has the largest share of defence Imports, about 15% or so, they and Israel are almost equal in defence.  I've just been on a visit to Greece and Cyprus, which are countries with whom we see a lot of strategic alignment. They are also recent partners; this is also our gateway," the Secretary stated. Singh emphasised that this diversification allows India to scale up production rapidly to meet international procurement demands.
He said, "India intends to increasingly take part in Europe's arms procurement program. Not directly, but by setting up joint ventures in Europe. And of course, European Partners to set up joint ventures in India to access our defence market, and for us to set up joint ventures in Europe to access the European government programmes." "Foreign entities aiming to tap into India's domestic procurement programs will continue to face local manufacturing compliance mandates, though officials acknowledge structural similarities in regional offset frameworks. While European firms are welcome to tap into India's lucrative procurement pipelines, officials emphasised that foreign entities must strictly comply with local manufacturing benchmarks, noting structural parallels between regional regulatory frameworks," Defence Secretary added.
Singh further stated that European countries can also take part in India's arms procurement programme, but they will have to meet our Make in India. He said, "European countries can also take part in India's arms procurement programme, but they will have to meet our Make in India. Now when we want to go to Europe, we understand that we have you have similar norms, except that yours are a bit lighter. I think it's 25% localisation. requirements is there as against a minimum 50% here, but the spirit of these programmes is similar. And I hope that this partnership agreement can lay the base for a situation where the supply chains between European and Indian defence manufacturers become increasingly integrated, and that is what we sort of intend to work on." (ANI)

items.title: Gold set for steep weekly loss as rising oil prices bolster Fed rate hike bets
items.author: Noel John, Anushree Mukherjee
items.creator: Noel John, Anushree Mukherjee
items.summary: Gold fell to a three-month low on Friday and was headed for its steepest weekly decline in over four months as higher energy prices fueled inflation concerns and reinforced US rate hike expectations ahead of next week's Federal Reserve meeting.
items.body:
Gold fell to a three-month low on Friday and was headed for its steepest weekly decline in over four months as higher energy prices fueled inflation concerns and reinforced US rate hike expectations ahead of next week's Federal Reserve meeting.
Spot gold fell 0.6% to $3,998.35 an ounce by 11:20 a.m. EDT (1520 GMT), slipping below the $4,000 mark for the first time since mid-July and touching a session low of $3,975.23.
Bullion has fallen 4% this week, putting it on track for its worst week since June.
US gold futures for December delivery settled 1.3% lower at $4,007.90 per ounce.
Brent crude touched a more than five-month high, after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concern over further disruption to energy supplies.
"Heightened inflation concerns suggest that major central banks of the world won't be able to ease monetary policies as quickly as they want to. All that's working against the gold and silver market bulls at present," said Jim Wyckoff, a market analyst at American Gold Exchange.
The selloff in technology stocks has also led to margin calls for equity traders and investors, prompting them to sell gold and silver assets, Wyckoff said.
The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq touched their lowest in five weeks on Friday as caution prevailed after a sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks.
Meanwhile, traders largely expect the Fed to leave interest rates unchanged at its October 27-28 meeting, although stronger-than-expected US [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer"] and [USN:L1N4610KT TEXT:"producer"] inflation data released last week bolstered the case for tighter monetary policy later this year.
They see a 92% chance of the Fed leaving rates unchanged next week and a 78% probability of a December hike, according to CME's FedWatch Tool. FEDWATCH
The US Personal Consumption Expenditures report, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, on October 29 could offer further insight.
Elsewhere, gold buying picked up in India this week as lower prices during the major Dussehra festival boosted purchases and lifted premiums, while physical demand in top consumer China was steady even as cautious consumers continued to curb jewellery spending. [GOL/AS]
Among other metals, spot silver slid 1% to $53.97 per ounce, and palladium dropped 0.5% to $1,048.31, hitting their lowest since November 2025 and June 2025 respectively. Spot platinum fell 0.9% to $1,555.84 per ounce, its lowest since July.
All three metals were headed for weekly declines.

Quality is one of the most overused words in investing. But what makes a stock a quality stock?
For Keith Buchanan, one clue is the dividend, and whether a company can keep paying it.

In the latest episode of Ticker Take , I spoke with Buchanan of GLOBALT Investments about how he uses that idea to find quality companies, which leads him to a number of opportunities beyond popular sectors like tech.
In Buchanan’s view, quality companies have steady, recurring revenue, pricing power, and enough cash to keep paying and raising dividends in good times and bad. Dividends, in his opinion, are a kind of receipt that the business model is working.
At the same time, Buchanan warns that high dividend yields can look like quality marks, when in fact they are the opposite. When a stock falls, its yield rises even if the company never pays an extra cent, so an unusually big yield can be the market warning you that the payout is in trouble.
For that reason, Buchanan would rather own a company that can grow a smaller dividend than one that looks generous right before it has to cut.
Here are six stocks he used to show how to assess quality companies. We have included some of the analyst recommendations, as measured by Bloomberg. As always, this is not financial advice.
Delta Air Lines ( DAL ) Airlines have a rough history with investors: capital intensive, boom and bust, famous for adding too many seats at the wrong time. However, Buchanan says this cycle is different, with fewer and more global players showing real discipline. He says Delta in particular has been out front on a premium, loyalty-driven model, anchored by its American Express partnership. Delta cut its dividend during the pandemic, before bringing it back in 2023. He thinks the company can keep raising it. And he’s not alone in his bullishness. Nearly every analyst who covers the stock rates it a buy.
Waste Management ( WM ) There is nothing glamorous about garbage, but trash leads to cash. Whether the economy grows or not, people and businesses keep producing waste, which gives Waste Management steady demand and real pricing power. Buchanan points to the recurring cash that has funded more than 20 straight years of dividend increases. About two-thirds of analysts rate it a buy.
JPMorgan Chase ( JPM ) Wall Street is split on JPMorgan, with only about half of analysts calling it a buy, but that suits Buchanan just fine. He is willing to pay a premium for the biggest U.S. bank because of the cash the Chase franchise generates and the interest income he expects over the next few years. JPMorgan raised its dividend again this fall, and he says its commitment to that payout has held through every kind of cycle.
Devon Energy ( DVN ) Energy is about as cyclical as it gets, and producers have little say over the prices they receive, so Buchanan focuses on the people running the company. He liked Devon’s merger with Coterra this year, which created a bigger producer with strong assets and a management team he trusts to ride out the swings and keep returning cash. Devon raised its dividend by roughly a third after the deal closed, and about nine out of every ten analysts rate it a buy.
Hasbro ( HAS ) Hasbro’s dividend has been flat since 2022, so it would fail a strict dividend-growth screen, but Buchanan keeps it for where he thinks it is headed. The draw is the intellectual property, with franchises such as Magic: The Gathering offering better economics than traditional toys. Pair that with a solid balance sheet, he says, and Hasbro has the capacity to start growing its payout again. According to Bloomberg, more than 90 per cent of the street currently recommends the stock.
Automatic Data Processing ( ADP ) ADP has raised its dividend for 50 years in a row, which is the longest streak on this list. While most analysts are not recommending the stock, it handles payroll for many leading businesses and throws off plenty of free cash flow. Buchanan notes it is not a direct AI winner, though it can use AI inside its own operations to widen margins.
The Ticker Take Regardless of whether it’s an airline or a garbage business, Buchanan hunts for companies that generate cash and have the discipline to keep paying shareholders. That, to him, is the definition of quality.
Jon Erlichman is a BNN Bloomberg contributor and the host of Ticker Take on YouTube .

items.title: Euro sinks on French debt worries, yen gains for week on AI rout
items.author: Karen Brettell
items.creator: Karen Brettell
items.summary: The euro fell on Friday and was on track for a weekly loss against both the US dollar and the yen as a selloff in French government bonds pushed the country's debt risk premium to its highest level since the euro zone sovereign debt crisis in 2011.
items.body:
The euro fell on Friday and was on track for a weekly loss against both the US dollar and the yen as a selloff in French government bonds pushed the country's debt risk premium to its highest level since the euro zone [USN:L6N4680QK TEXT:"sovereign debt crisis"] in 2011.
The Japanese yen was headed for a weekly increase against the greenback as it benefited from safe-haven flows from the selloff in AI stocks on Thursday. The dollar index was little changed on the week.
The euro was hit by concerns about growing unrest in France and the country's worsening budget problems. France will deploy 70,000 police backed by specialist units for protests [USN:L1N4690GR TEXT:"on Saturday"], Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said. The country also faces the threat of a [USN:L8N4682H3 TEXT:"rating downgrade"] by Moody’s on Friday.
"The pressure in the European bond market has eased today, but Moody’s review of France’s debt rating late today poses a challenge, and although the Macron government has threatened military assistance to quell the social unrest, more activity is likely this weekend," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex.
The euro was last down 0.21% at $1.1191 , set to end the week 0.43% lower. It fell more sharply against the yen, touching its lowest level since October 2025 at 175.08 yen . It was last down 0.11% against the Japanese currency and on track for a weekly decline of 1.1%.
The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, rose 0.25% to 101.82 and was headed for a weekly gain of 0.03%.
The yen weakened 0.1% to 156.9 per dollar and was on track for a weekly gain of around 0.7%, its best week since mid-September.
"The yen has continued to trade at stronger levels at the end of this week, encouraged by more risk-off trading conditions," said Lee Hardman, senior currency analyst at MUFG.
CENTRAL BANK POLICY MEETINGS IN FOCUS Traders are looking to next week's policy meetings at the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. All three are expected to leave rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on the future path of policy.
Fed funds futures traders trimmed bets on a December hike after Thursday's stock market selloff, though they still see an 81% chance of such a move, according to LSEG data.
Traders see a 66% chance of an ECB hike in December. Investors will scrutinize any hint of the [USN:L8N4651KP TEXT:"rate outlook"] after ECB President Christine Lagarde said in late September that a moderate policy response to inflation was appropriate.
Purchasing Managers' Index data showed private-sector growth in the euro zone slowed in October to its [USN:L6N4690J4 TEXT:"weakest pace"] in four months, hurt by a renewed contraction in France.
"The drop brings the PMIs back in line with other growth indicators, in our view, rather than suggesting downside risks from here," Giada Giani, an economist at Citi, said. "France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area remains resilient."
In Japan, data on Friday showed annual core consumer inflation [USN:L4N46724Q TEXT:"exceeded"] the central bank's 2% target in September for the first time in nine months. The reading points to broadening price pressures and strengthens the case for a near-term rate hike, analysts said.
Traders are pricing in 61% odds of a BOJ hike in December.

items.title: Stocks mixed, day after AI-related selloff; oil prices rise again
items.author: Caroline Valetkevitch, Marc Jones
items.creator: Caroline Valetkevitch, Marc Jones
items.summary: Stock indexes were mixed on Friday, with tech shares edging higher after the previous day's selloff, while Brent crude oil rose to its highest in more than five months after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia.
items.body:
Stock indexes were mixed on Friday, with tech shares edging higher after the previous day's selloff, while Brent crude oil rose to its highest in more than five months after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia.
The Nasdaq was up 0.2% after starting the day lower, while the Dow was last down about 1%.
An index of semiconductors (.SOX) was up about 1%. It posted its biggest daily percentage drop since June on Thursday after a report from Meta Platforms (META.O) reignited worries about the AI trade.
It's been "a very volatile week," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B. Riley Wealth in Boston.
"After Meta's report, there's still anxiety over the AI trade to a certain extent," he said. "But also, we continue to be in a place where things look like they're getting worse, not better, in the Middle East. That moves energy prices higher, which is obviously going to end up being a significant headwind for economic activity."
Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia [USN:L1N46903W TEXT:"fanned fears"] over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East, where United Arab Emirates authorities also reported an oil spill.
US crude rose 2.56% to $102.02 a barrel and Brent climbed to $116.27 per barrel, up 2.74%. European natural gas prices jumped.
AMEX, TELECOM SHARES FALL Investors were digesting corporate earnings news. American Express (AXP.N) shares fell 3.5% after it [USN:L4N4690WS TEXT:"reported"] results and its CEO said the company had good momentum, but needed to become a more "agile and efficient" organization.
Telecom company shares, including Verizon (VZ.N) , dropped after a Bloomberg News [USN:L4N4682CX TEXT:"report"] that SpaceX (SPCX.O) was in talks with cellular infrastructure companies about launching a US wireless carrier program.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) fell 476.25 points, or 0.9%, to 52,391.73, the S&P 500 (.SPX) eased 11.14 points, or 0.14%, to 7,652.96 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) rose 52.51 points, or 0.21%, to 26,062.75.
MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe (.MIWD00000PUS) fell 1.64 points, or 0.15%, to 1,121.29.
The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) index fell 0.4%.
Asia's bourses steadied overnight, with South Korea's KOSPI (.KS11) ending its session higher after shedding as much as 4% earlier.
US Treasury yields rose a day after the benchmark 10-year yield registered its biggest one-day drop in nearly four years, but remained under 5%.
The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note was last up 3.7 basis points at 4.992%. The 10-year yield is down about 11 basis points on the week and on pace for a third straight week of declines, its longest run lower since June.
EURO FALLS The euro fell and was on track for a weekly loss against both the US dollar and the yen, while euro zone bonds stabilized after recent volatility. Investors' focus has been on concerns over France's finances.
French yields , which were down 5 basis points at 5.04%, have risen nearly 27 bps this week, the most of any major euro zone country and the most in a week since late May.
A selloff in French government bonds this week pushed the country's debt risk premium to its highest level since the euro zone sovereign debt crisis in 2011.
France [USN:L1N4690GR TEXT:"will deploy"] 70,000 police backed by specialist units for protests on Saturday, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said. The country faces the threat of a rating downgrade by Moody’s later on Friday.
The euro was last down 0.12% at $1.12 , set to end the week 0.35% lower.

items.title: Oil prices jump $3 on Houthi attacks, oil spill, highest settlement since April
items.author: Nicole Jao
items.creator: Nicole Jao
items.summary: Oil prices settled more than $3 higher on Friday, their highest in nearly six months after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East, where UAE authorities also reported an oil spill.
items.body:
Oil prices settled more than $3 higher on Friday, their highest in nearly six months after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East, where UAE authorities also reported an oil spill.
Brent crude futures settled at $116.72 a barrel, up $3.55 or 3.14%, their highest since April 29. US West Texas Intermediate crude closed at $103.27 a barrel, up $3.80 or 3.8%.
Brent finished the week up 6% and WTI ended 2.3% higher.
"Fears of supply disruptions drove the advance after Iranian-backed Houthi rebels carried out a series of attacks across Saudi Arabia, including on energy infrastructure," said Adam Turnquist, chief cross-asset strategist for LPL Financial.
On Thursday, Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) [USN:L1N46809Q TEXT:"ordered the evacuation"] of its headquarters in Dhahran on the Gulf near Bahrain, Reuters reported. Fighting intensified between Saudi Arabia, the world's largest crude exporter and Yemen-based Houthis.
An oil spill from a tanker [USN:L1N469029 TEXT:"was detected"] off the UAE coast of Umm Al Quwain, the United Arab Emirates Ministry of Climate Change and Environment said. It did not say what caused the spill and authorities have not identified the tanker involved.
ATTACKS ON VESSELS Shipping sources said on October 9 that the Gem No. 2 supertanker was [USN:L1N45V0GU TEXT:"struck"] by an unidentified projectile 13 nautical miles (24 km) west of Al Jazeera in the UAE.
"The market is concerned about these continued Iranian attacks on tankers that we've seen increase over the last week," said Andrew Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates. "While there has been an increase in oil transiting out of the Strait of Hormuz, that could change at any minute."
Clashes between the Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition that backs Yemen's internationally recognised government have raged since the Iran-aligned Houthis pushed towards Bab el-Mandeb Strait last month, a shipping chokepoint at the mouth of the Red Sea.
October has been the [USN:L8N4682UH TEXT:"worst month for attacks on commercial shipping"] in the Strait of Hormuz and nearby waterways, according to data compiled by a Washington-based think tank that has tracked maritime security incidents worldwide since 2017.
President Donald Trump said on Friday the US could [USN:L6N469109 TEXT:"end the war with Iran quickly"], but said perhaps Washington should allow the conflict to gradually wind down.
STRATEGIC RESERVE RELEASES The US Department of Energy said it had [USN:L1N4690OW TEXT:"authorized"] an emergency exchange of up to 400,000 barrels of crude oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to address a supply disruption affecting Phillips 66's Lake Charles refinery in Louisiana.
The SPR is already at the lowest level since 1982 after President Donald Trump tapped it as the US war on Iran disrupted supply lines. Trump's predecessor, President Joe Biden, also tapped the SPR following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
Elsewhere, Germany's national oil stockpiling agency EBV circulated a tender [USN:L6N469129 TEXT:"to sell"] diesel, heating oil and crude oil volumes from strategic reserves.
This marks Germany's first oil releases from strategic reserves since G7 countries, under pressure from Trump, agreed to do so at the start of October.
On Thursday, the head of Libya's National Oil Corp told Reuters that an oil pipeline valve from the Hamada and Tahara oilfields to Zawiya port had been shut, leading to a reduction in production at both fields.
Ship tracking data showed the first Russian diesel [USN:L1N4690EB TEXT:"bound for the US"] since Moscow and Washington reached an export agreement was aboard a tanker heading for New York.
Trump announced the [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"deal"] this month as part of efforts to bring down soaring diesel prices ahead of US midterm elections on November 3.
US energy firms this week kept the total rig count unchanged for a second week in a row, energy services firm Baker Hughes (BKR.O) said in its closely followed report on Friday. The total oil and gas rig count, an early indicator of future output, held steady at 603 during the week ended October 23.

items.title: Pakistan forces face allegations of abuse, cash seizure during Nushki operation
items.summary: Residents of Nushki district in Balochistan have accused Pakistan’s Frontier Corps (FC) personnel of mistreating civilians during a security operation and withholding cash seized during their ...
items.body:
Pakistan forces face allegations of abuse, cash seizure during Nushki operation Residents of Nushki district in Balochistan have accused Pakistan’s Frontier Corps (FC) personnel of mistreating civilians during a security operation and withholding cash seized during their detention, as reported by The Balochistan Post.
ANI | Updated: 23-10-2026 13:05 IST | Created: 23-10-2026 13:05 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Residents of Nushki district in Balochistan have accused Pakistan’s Frontier Corps (FC) personnel of mistreating civilians during a security operation and withholding cash seized during their detention, as reported by The Balochistan Post. According to The Balochistan Post, several residents of Killi Faqiran were detained on suspicion following a shooting on the bypass road near the Deputy Commissioner’s residence two days earlier.
The individuals were subsequently released after questioning. In a written complaint submitted to the Inspector General of FC Balochistan and the Corps Commander, the affected residents alleged that security personnel entered their homes, verbally abused them and instructed all men to assemble at a designated location. The complainants claimed that personnel confiscated their mobile phones, wallets and cash. They said they counted the money they were carrying before handing it over to the security personnel. The residents further alleged that their shirt hems were tied together before they were taken to FC headquarters and compelled to raise slogans during the journey.
Although their phones and wallets were reportedly returned after their release, the cash allegedly remained missing. When they sought the return of their money, personnel allegedly dismissed their concerns. The complainants have urged the Corps Commander, the FC Inspector General and other senior officials to conduct an impartial investigation into the alleged mistreatment, damage to their homes and disappearance of their money. They have also demanded legal proceedings and departmental action against those found responsible.
The residents stated that alleged high-handedness against ordinary citizens could further aggravate public resentment in Nushki, where security concerns and tensions remain significant, as highlighted by The Balochistan Post. The allegations come amid similar complaints from other parts of Balochistan. In September, residents of Kasano in Tump, Kech district, accused Pakistani forces of conducting house searches, taking valuables, physically abusing residents and setting fire to a house belonging to Ikram Baloch, as reported by The Balochistan Post. (ANI)

items.title: Apple's foldable iPhone hits stores with $2,000 price tag and scarce supply
items.author: Aditya Soni, Christine Chen, Will Russell
items.creator: Aditya Soni, Christine Chen, Will Russell
items.summary: Apple's first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, hit stores around the world on Friday with a price tag of about $2,000 and less of the fanfare that accompanied previous iPhone launches.
items.body:
Apple's (AAPL.O) first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, hit stores around the world on Friday with a price tag of about $2,000 and less of the fanfare that accompanied previous iPhone launches.
From Singapore and Shanghai to London and San Francisco, demand was strong but with sales rationed, there were fewer of the round-the-block queues and overnight camp-outs that once marked new iPhone days.
Competitors such as Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and Huawei Technologies have sold premium foldable phones for years and the Duo is a test of whether Apple can reinvent the small foldable mobile market the way the iPhone did for smartphones.
It is also an early challenge for Apple's new CEO John Ternus, the former hardware chief who unveiled the phone barely a week after taking charge in September.
Apple's estimated delivery dates for the Duo had slipped to late January within minutes of pre-orders opening a week ago, as demand outpaced supply. The US company called the response "nothing short of extraordinary".
Apple capped pre-orders at two handsets per customer and limited sales to walk-in shoppers. In China, France, Hong Kong, India and Japan they were only available to those who had ordered online.
In Sydney, where the first Apple store began selling the new passport-shaped phones on Friday, a queue formed outside before opening at 8 a.m. local time (2100 GMT).
"This is a bit of a luxury item for me, because it's so expensive, but I just think, you know what? Life's too short," said Simon Krishnan, a 48-year-old engineer who paid A$3,899 ($2,734) for a 512GB Duo.
CEO Ternus played greeter at a store in Austin, Texas, throwing open the doors and high-fiving customers as they streamed in, a video posted on X by CBS Austin showed.
A known car enthusiast, Ternus's Austin visit coincides with this weekend's Formula 1 US Grand Prix in the city, with Apple holding exclusive US broadcast and streaming rights to the racing series.
At Apple's Fifth Avenue store in New York, marketing head Greg Joswiak opened the doors to a crowd of customers, social media posts showed. Some posts said people had camped outside the store since as early as 4 a.m. local time (0800 GMT).
Mohit Chandel, a 32-year-old San Francisco resident and consultant, had promised his father in Singapore an iPhone Duo for his retirement but forgot to pre-order one.
So when he spotted a dozen people lining up outside an Apple store around 11 p.m. Thursday, he joined them, ordered a bench and pillow from Walgreens and settled in for the night.
"He doesn't know that. All the pre-orders are gone. He's expecting a Duo sometime in the mail so now I have to buy it," Chandel said.
In China, a soft consumer market and rising memory costs have led to [USN:P8N44H02N TEXT:"six straight quarters"] of declining smartphone shipments, although Apple's market share has rebounded as some buyers trade up to premium devices.
Liu Wei, a 26-year-old healthcare professional, already has a foldable phone from Xiaomi (1810.HK) , but still queued outside a Shanghai store from 6 a.m. for Apple's first foldable.
"I've used Apple products for many years and I have more trust (in the brand), so I bought one on launch day to try it out," he said.
Many queued to pick up pre-orders, while others hoped for limited stock or to browse display models.
Others were resellers.
In Hong Kong, May, 38, who declined to give his full name, bought a 256GB iPhone Duo, priced at HK$17,499 ($2,231.73), in an online pre-sale and planned to resell it for a profit of around HK$4,000. "A few meals' worth of money," he joked.
Paul Francis, 53, was one of several dozen fans who queued overnight outside London's Regent Street store in pouring rain.
"Some people think it was mad. Including myself," the charity manager said.
MIXED REVIEWS Early reviews have praised the Duo's design as well as its sturdy and barely visible hinge, a major feat for phones whose prominent creased screen has long been a drawback and potential deterrent for buyers.
But reviewers said camera compromises, including no telephoto lens, and third-party apps still to be reworked for the new display size could disappoint some buyers.
They also said the folded Duo is less handy for the quick tasks most users do daily and several prominent reviewers recommended against it for many Apple customers.
"It's been a lot of fun trying the Duo out for a week, but it feels like I've gotten to use an extraordinarily polished prototype — not a finished product that I'd want to buy and carry," wrote longtime Apple commentator John Gruber.
Tech commentator Marques Brownlee said in a YouTube review that for a regular person who mostly texts and browses, "it is probably a no. But if the $2,000 doesn't mean much to you, and you like the idea, after the learning curve and getting used to not having facial identification, it is a really fun phone."
In Berlin, YouTube content creator Patrick Wolter was impressed that the Duo works as a phone and an iPad in one.
"I've always found it a hassle to carry around a separate tablet, especially since I already have a laptop and other gear," he said. "In the long run, this will likely end up replacing those other devices."
TOUGH TO FIND Apple's entry into the relatively niche foldables market could bring the format to a much broader audience, said Francisco Jeronimo, vice president at market researcher IDC.
IDC expects Apple will take 44% of the foldable market value in 2026 on 31% of units. By 2027, it will become the market leader both in value and units shipped, IDC forecast.
"Apple has made a convincing case for this form factor," Jeronimo said after spending a week with the Duo.
"Now comes the next test: turning excitement into availability, adoption and a lasting new chapter for the smartphone market," Jeronimo said.
($1 = 1.4257 Australian dollars)
($1 = 7.8410 Hong Kong dollars)

Trump says LeBron James showed disrespect during US national anthem

FAST

US President Donald Trump criticised NBA superstar LeBron James on Thursday (Oct 23) for what he called disrespectful behaviour during the singing of the national anthem at a recent NBA game.
"While listening to our National Anthem, LeBron James disrespects our Country," Trump said in a Truth Social post accompanied by a video showing James moving his body during the singing of the anthem. "LeBron James should apologise to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag, and all that our Country stands for!"
The clip Trump shared showed James standing in line with the members of the Philadelphia 76ers, swinging his arms in a warmup-type stretch and performing basketball shooting movements.
A representative for the 76ers did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Trump has repeatedly criticised athletes for their behaviour during pre-game renditions of the US national anthem, notably beginning with NFL quarterback Colin Kaepernick's kneeling protest in support of racial justice.
Trump cancelled a planned White House visit of the Super Bowl champions Philadelphia Eagles in 2018 after the team disagreed with his call for players to stand during the anthem.
James became a leading voice in the Black Lives Matter movement in 2020 and has frequently supported progressive issues as he ascended to the top of the NBA's all-time scoring list.

items.title: BOJ to raise rates to 1.50% in December, sticking to quarterly pace: Reuters poll
items.author: Satoshi Sugiyama
items.creator: Satoshi Sugiyama
items.summary: The Bank of Japan will raise interest rates in December to 1.50%, following June and September increases, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll, keeping up a quicker pace in a campaign that started with just one rate rise a year.
items.body:
The Bank of Japan will raise interest rates in December to 1.50%, following June and September increases, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll, keeping up a quicker pace in a campaign that started with just one rate rise a year.
Rising energy and import costs, worsened by a weak yen and the war in the Middle East, are adding to inflation pressure in Japan, and there are more forecasters expecting at least two more rate rises to 2.0% by the middle of next year.
A period of relative stability in the yen, which spent most of the year under crushing selling pressure, triggering interventions from the Japanese authorities as well as the US Treasury, also supports the case for a December increase.
[USN:L1N46101P TEXT:"Last week,"] board member Junko Koeda said the central bank should not become overly cautious about raising rates, at their highest in [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"31 years"], given the significant upside risks to inflation.
Nearly 70% of economists, 54 of 78, in the October 13-19 survey expected the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5% this quarter, almost double the share in the [USN:L4N44Z0P0 TEXT:"previous poll"].
Of the 54 respondents who specified a month, about 80% chose December, while only 2% chose the BOJ's next two-day policy meeting, which concludes on October 30.
"With rate hikes in the United States and Europe looking likely before year-end, there is a risk that yen selling could accelerate if the BOJ postpones its move until the new year," said Kazutaka Maeda, senior economist at Meiji Yasuda Research Institute.
The BOJ is unlikely to raise rates this month, while the [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"US Federal Reserve"] and the [USN:L6N45U0QU TEXT:"European Central Bank"] are expected to raise borrowing costs in December, separate Reuters polls found.
"The economy is not overheating to the extent that would warrant consecutive rate hikes, and price developments are also within the BOJ's expected range," said Takeshi Minami, chief economist at Norinchukin Research Institute.
[USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"Sources"] have told Reuters many BOJ officials prefer to assess more data on how previous increases have affected financial conditions.
RATES TO REACH 2% OR HIGHER Looking into next year, 39 of 65 analysts, or 60%, expected the policy rate to reach 1.75% by end-June, a median unchanged from the September poll.
Almost half of 41 respondents who answered an additional question said 1.75% would be the terminal rate. But the share expecting it to reach 2.00% or more rose to 51%, from 40% in September and 36% in August.
In September, two board members nominated by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi who support looser fiscal policy opposed the decision to raise rates to 1.25%.
Traders saw the dissent as a sign the BOJ's rate-hike plans could continue to face opposition from Takaichi's administration, briefly pushing the yen lower.
Nearly three-quarters of respondents, or 23 of 32, said further dissenting votes when the Policy Board next raises rates could weigh on the yen, which is only about 4% stronger than its 2026 low of around 164 per dollar.
"If the dissenting vote were cast in particular by a board member appointed under the Takaichi administration, it could be interpreted as the administration's attempt to restrain rate hikes, potentially heightening concerns that future policy tightening could fall behind the curve," said Kei Fujimoto, senior economist at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Asset Management.
BOND ISSUANCE SEEN BELOW 40 TRILLION YEN Japanese government bond (JGB) yields have risen recently alongside a global market rout, but also on expectations of further BOJ rate hikes and concerns Takaichi's big spending and tax-cut plans will worsen the country's already strained finances.
Takaichi has said the government aims to keep new bond issuance at around 40 trillion yen ($251 billion) for the fiscal 2027 budget. She reiterated on Monday Tokyo would "appropriately" control the size of its debt issuance.
Nearly two-thirds of economists surveyed, 15 of 23, said new issuance would be kept below 40 trillion yen.
"The government is likely keen to increase JGB issuance as a source of funding for growth investment," said Junya Takemoto, senior economist at Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation.
"However, as it becomes more conscious of rising interest rates in the market, it may seek to contain issuance by undertaking a full-scale review of budgets for existing subsidies and funds, ensuring that JGB issuance does not differ markedly from historical levels."
([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Reuters global economic poll)

items.title: Phoenix Tailings to build $375M rare earth plant in New York
items.author: Marina Meireles
items.creator: Marina Meireles
items.summary: The facility will produce over 4,400 tons of annual rare earths oxides by 2028 and will create at least 90 new jobs in the region.
items.body:
Phoenix Tailings to build $375M rare earth plant in New York 

Marina Meireles | October 20, 2026 | 9:56 am
Critical Minerals   Intelligence   China   USA   Rare Earth   Rare Earths  

( Image: Phoenix Tailings. )

Phoenix Tailings announced Tuesday it will build a $375-million commercial-scale rare earths processing facility in Rochester, New York, as the US looks to loosen China’s grip on minerals. 

The plant, called Freedom Separation, will process more than 18,000 tons of both mined and recycled rare earth feedstock annually, producing over 4,400 tons per year of separated rare earth oxides at its full capacity. Production is expected to ramp up in 2027 before reaching full capacity in 2028. 

“Technology can give America control over its critical supply chains, but it takes skilled, determined people to turn that promise into production,” Phoenix Tailings CEO and co-founder Nick Myers said in a statement . “Rochester has those people. They know how to build, how to innovate, and how to run world-class industrial operations.”  

Phoenix Tailings selected Eastman Business Park in the city of Rochester for the 500,000-square-foot facility, citing its existing industrial infrastructure and local expertise in engineering, manufacturing, chemical processing and operations.  

New York governor Kathy Hochul said the state will provide $3 million in performance-based tax credits for the project, Reuters reported.  

“I am committed to supporting innovative projects and companies that are ready to invest in New York and bring good-paying jobs,” Hochul said. “Phoenix Tailings will not only create at least 90 new jobs at Eastman Business Park, further supporting our state’s innovation economy, but they will also play a critical role in bolstering our national security by building a supply chain for rare earth elements in New York.” 

Federal backing   

The Rochester facility forms part of Phoenix Tailings’ $1.2 billion Freedom project, a separation and metallization platform designed to close the gap in US midstream rare earth processing capacity. 

The broader initiative is slated to generate more than 500 jobs across New York, Massachusetts and New Hampshire. 

The Freedom Project has secured a $500-million conditional loan commitment from the Department of War’s Office of Strategic Capital. Phoenix’s new facility is also backed by democratic NY state governor and US Senator Chuck Schumer. 

Rare earth refiner gets $500M loan from Pentagon to build ‘Freedom Facility’  

“This is critical for reducing our reliance on foreign processors and protecting our national security,” Schumer said. “I’ve long championed Eastman Business Park as a hub for manufacturing and am glad that new companies are recognizing what I have long known: Upstate New York is a prime destination for new manufacturing investments.” 

(With files from Reuters)

For the AI infrastructure boom , the winning formula was to borrow heavily to build quickly. That strategy backfired on CoreWeave Inc. CRWV . Shares fell 6.4% to $65.25 by 9:40 a.m. ET on Friday, putting the stock on track for a weekly loss of about 22%. A close at that level would be its lowest since May 2025.
CoreWeave’s five-year credit default swaps — contracts that insure investors against a missed debt payment — hit a record 1,194.5 basis points on Thursday, according to ICE Data Services data reported by Bloomberg.
That price implies a more than 60% chance of default within five years, by standard market calculations.
Its 9.75% notes due October 2031 slipped to 81.80 cents on the dollar on Friday, yielding 15.08%. Two months ago, the same bonds yielded about 12%.

Read Also: EXCLUSIVE: Is AI Growth Slowing Down? Memory Industry Expert Says It's 'Too Early' To Tell
Why Higher Rates Hit CoreWeave First
CoreWeave rents out Nvidia-powered computing capacity to AI developers. It buys the chips and builds the data centers before the rent arrives, and it borrows to fill the gap.
In the second quarter, it generated $679 million in operating cash flow while spending about $6.4 billion on equipment. Net interest expense more than doubled to $640 million.
That model worked when money was cheap.
On Friday, the 10-year Treasury yield rose 4 basis points to 5.12%. The 30-year rose 3 basis points to 5.45%, and the 2-year held at 4.76%.
Wednesday’s hotter-than-expected inflation report raised the odds of another Federal Reserve rate hike on Oct. 28. CoreWeave fell 15.5% that day.
‘Darwin Moment’
"Data centre bonds are having their Darwin moment, where the weakest credits struggle to survive," Ludovic Subran , chief investment officer at German insurer Allianz, told the Financial Times this week.
Rival neocloud Nebius Group N.V. NBIS is down about 20% this week.
Bank of America’s Michael Hartnett sees the pressure moving up the food chain.
"We continue to lean risk-off next 3-4 weeks," the chief investment strategist said in his weekly Flow Show note.
He cited 3% inflation-adjusted yields, the Nov. 3 midterms and weak trading in AI "spenders and lenders."
The spenders are CoreWeave’s customers: Amazon , Alphabet , Meta , Microsoft and Oracle . The lenders include private credit firms, banks and bondholders.
Their AI spending is expected to reach $807 billion this year. As a result, their combined free cash flow is forecast to swing from $191 billion in 2025 to minus $63 billion this year, according to consensus estimates compiled by Bank of America.
Signal to Watch
"A rollover in semi prices signals further tightening of AI credit," Hartnett said, expecting an October Fed hike to restore credibility. Consumer prices have run above the Fed’s 2% target for 66 consecutive months.
In his view, a hike could pull long-term Treasury yields down another 20 basis points and limit losses in risky assets.
The question now is which companies can afford to finance the AI race at elevated interest rates.

items.title: テンセントがオラクルからAI半導体10万個をリース、70億ドル規模－FT
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、東南アジアでオラクルから先端のAI半導体を借り受けることで合意した。テンセントにとってAI半導体のリース契約としては過去最大規模となる。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）が事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、テンセントは、5年間の契約の一環として10万個の半導体を利用できるようになる。契約額は70億ドル（約1兆1000億円）に上るという。

中国のAI開発企業は米国の輸出規制を回避するため、米エヌビディア製など中国国内では入手できないAIアクセラレーターを海外で借りて利用している。中国のテクノロジー企業は、東南アジアのデータセンターの最大顧客層の一つとなっている。

テンセントとオラクルの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

原題：Tencent Leases AI Chips From Oracle
